articles.title: Nazca infant had rare, fatal birth defect that left her with one central eye 1,600 years ago
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists in Peru have discovered the skeleton of an infant with a rare birth defect that left only one central eye socket in the child's skull. DNA analysis of the remains confirmed a chromosomal abnormality caused the deadly condition in the infant over 1,600 years ago, according to a new study.
paras.zh: 秘鲁的考古学家发现了一具婴儿的骨骼，该婴儿患有罕见的先天缺陷，导致孩子的头骨中只剩下一个中央眼窝。一项新的研究表明，对遗骸的 DNA 分析证实，染色体异常导致了 1600 多年前婴儿的致命状况。

paras.en: "We cannot really say how long this individual survived," study co-author Lars Fehren-Schmitz, an anthropologist at the University of California, Santa Cruz, told Live Science in an email. But "the burial of this infant suggests that the Nasca treated this individual in death like most other infants."
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的人类学家拉尔斯·费伦-施密茨在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》：“我们确实无法确定这个人存活了多久。”但“这个婴儿的埋葬表明纳斯卡人像对待大多数其他婴儿一样对待这个人的死亡。”

paras.en: The skeleton of this female infant was discovered alongside a second one inside a ceramic urn at the archaeological site of Jauranga in Peru's Palpa Valley, where numerous geoglyphs known as the Nazca Lines have been found. Archaeologists uncovered several dozen other burials dated to the Middle Nazca (also spelled Nasca) period (A.D. 325 to 440) at the site, but one of the co-buried infants had an extremely rare condition, researchers wrote in a study published Monday (Nov. 9) in the journal PNAS.
paras.zh: 在秘鲁帕尔帕谷贾兰加考古遗址的一个陶瓷瓮内，发现了这具女婴的骨架和第二具女婴的骨架，那里发现了许多被称为纳斯卡线的地质符号。研究人员在周一（11 月 9 日）发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）杂志上的一项研究中写道，考古学家在该遗址还发现了几十个可以追溯到中纳斯卡时期（公元 325 年至 440 年）的其他墓葬，但其中一个共同埋葬的婴儿患有极其罕见的疾病。

paras.en: The infant had a very small skull and a single eye socket in the middle of her face, along with other developmental issues of the cranial bones. These traits match modern clinical descriptions of cyclopia, a lethal condition that occurs when the front part of a fetus's brain fails to divide into left and right hemispheres.
paras.zh: 这名婴儿的头骨非常小，脸部中央只有一个眼窝，还有颅骨的其他发育问题。这些特征符合现代临床对独眼症的描述，独眼症是一种致命疾病，当胎儿大脑的前部无法分为左半球和右半球时就会发生这种情况。

paras.en: This condition can also cause alterations in the nasal structures, resulting in a missing nose or a tube-like nose above the single eye.
paras.zh: 这种情况还会导致鼻结构的改变，导致鼻子缺失或单眼上方出现管状鼻子。

paras.en: "The cause of the malformation was present at fertilization, but manifestation occurs around the fourth to fifth week in utero [in the womb], when the frontal lobe of the brain has to divide," study first author Elsa Tomasto-Cagigao, an archaeologist at the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、秘鲁天主教大学考古学家埃尔莎·托马斯托-卡吉高 (Elsa Tomasto-Cagigao) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“畸形的原因是在受精时出现的，但在子宫内的第四周到第五周左右就会出现畸形，此时大脑额叶必须分裂。”

paras.en: Cyclopia is a rare condition, occurring in about 1 out of every 100,000 births. To learn more about the infant's short life, the researchers sequenced her genome. (DNA suggested the infant carried two X chromosomes, typical of a female.)
paras.zh: 独眼症是一种罕见的疾病，大约每 10 万名新生儿中就有 1 人发生这种情况。为了更多地了解婴儿短暂的生命，研究人员对她的基因组进行了测序。 （DNA 显示婴儿携带两条 X 染色体，这是女性的典型特征。）

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The team detected an extra copy of chromosome 13, meaning the infant had a genetic condition called trisomy 13, or Patau syndrome. It's known to be a major chromosomal cause of cyclopia; that said, only a small percentage of trisomy 13 cases involve cyclopia.
paras.zh: 研究小组检测到了 13 号染色体的额外副本，这意味着婴儿患有一种称为 13 三体症或帕陶综合症的遗传病。众所周知，它是造成独眼症的一个主要染色体原因。也就是说，13 三体病例中只有一小部分涉及独眼。

paras.en: While trisomy 13 is associated with advanced maternal age, it is not clear whether that was the case for this infant, Fehren-Schmitz said.
paras.zh: Fehren-Schmitz 说，虽然 13 三体性与高龄产妇有关，但尚不清楚该婴儿的情况是否如此。

paras.en: "This condition has been documented in historic and modern anatomical collections, but to my knowledge this is the first archaeological example of this developmental abnormality," Siân Halcrow, a bioarchaeologist at the University of Otago in New Zealand who was not involved in the study, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “这种情况在历史和现代解剖学收藏中都有记录，但据我所知，这是这种发育异常的第一个考古例子，”未参与这项研究的新西兰奥塔哥大学生物考古学家 Siân Halcrow 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: The researchers' estimate of the infant's age at death suggests she may have survived for several weeks or months after birth, Halcrow pointed out. "This raises important questions about how infants with profound congenital differences were cared for and treated in past societies," she said.
paras.zh: 哈尔克罗指出，研究人员对婴儿死亡年龄的估计表明，她可能在出生后存活了几周或几个月。她说：“这提出了一个重要问题，即在过去的社会中如何照顾和治疗具有巨大先天差异的婴儿。”

paras.en: The infant was buried in a ceramic urn, the researchers noted in the study, which was a common burial method in the Nazca period, along with a second female infant who had no skeletal abnormalities. "The baby with cyclopia was at the bottom of the jar, while the other baby was on top. Nevertheless, it appears that they were interred in a single event," Tomasto-Cagigao said. The genetic analysis showed that the two infants did not have the same mother.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中指出，这名婴儿被埋在陶瓷瓮中，这是纳斯卡时期常见的埋葬方法，还有第二名没有骨骼异常的女婴。托马斯托-卡吉高说：“患有独眼症的婴儿位于罐子的底部，而另一个婴儿则位于罐子的顶部。尽管如此，他们似乎是在一次事件中被埋葬的。”基因分析显示，这两个婴儿并非同一母亲所生。

paras.en: A burial of two infants in one urn is unusual for this culture, the researchers said, but there is not enough archaeological evidence to conclude that the infant with cyclopia was given a different type of burial.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，在一个瓮中埋葬两个婴儿对于这种文化来说是不寻常的，但没有足够的考古证据可以得出结论，独眼婴儿的埋葬方式不同。

paras.en: "The fact that the individual was buried with a 'healthy' individual in a regular cemetery, without any special grave goods, suggests that, to some extent, the individual was not treated differently in death, even though it had such a rare condition," Fehren-Schmitz said. "It was neither 'excluded' because of it nor treated in a 'special' way."
paras.zh: 费伦-施米茨说：“这个人与‘健康’人一起埋葬在一个普通的墓地，没有任何特殊的陪葬品，这一事实表明，在某种程度上，这个人在死亡时并没有受到区别对待，尽管他的病情如此罕见。” “它既没有因此被‘排除’，也没有被以‘特殊’的方式对待。”

paras.en: In ancient Andean societies, some people with disabilities took on special societal roles, such as ones associated with religious practices. "If that reflects Nasca society as a whole, we can't say based on one case," Fehren-Schmitz said, "but it does reflect the community this infant was part of, even if only briefly."
paras.zh: 在古代安第斯社会，一些残疾人承担着特殊的社会角色，例如与宗教活动相关的角色。费伦-施米茨说：“如果这反映了整个纳斯卡社会，我们不能根据一个案例来判断，但它确实反映了这个婴儿所属的社区，即使只是短暂的。”

paras.en: Tomasto-Cagigao, E., Reindel, M., Isla Cuadrado, J., Lund Valle, M., Kassadjikova, K., Harkins, K., Fehren-Schmitz, L. (2026). A Nasca-period perinatal burial reveals cyclopia associated with trisomy 13 in southern Peru. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. https://www.pnas.org/cgi/doi/10.1073/pnas.2625042123
paras.zh: Tomasto-Cagigao, E.、Reindel, M.、Isla Cuadrado, J.、Lund Valle, M.、Kassadjikova, K.、Harkins, K.、Fehren-Schmitz, L. (2026)。纳斯卡时期的围产期墓葬揭示了秘鲁南部与 13 三体有关的独眼。美国国家科学院院刊。 https://www.pnas.org/cgi/doi/10.1073/pnas.2625042123

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Iran war helps fuel global drop in fossil fuel emissions — but there’s a catch
articles.author: Chris Simms

paras.en: The world's carbon emissions from oil, gas and coal are projected to decrease by 0.4% this year, driven partly by the expansion of solar and wind power capacity and the price increases caused by the Iran conflict, according to a new report.
paras.zh: 一份新报告称，今年全球石油、天然气和煤炭的碳排放量预计将减少 0.4%，部分原因是太阳能和风能发电能力的扩张以及伊朗冲突造成的价格上涨。

paras.en: The 2026 Global Carbon Budget report was published in the journal Earth System Science Data Nov. 10 and is due to be presented at the U.N. Climate Change Conference's COP31 meeting in Antalya, Turkey, this week.
paras.zh: 2026 年全球碳预算报告于 11 月 10 日发表在《地球系统科学数据》杂志上，并将于本周在土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国气候变化大会 COP31 会议上提交。

paras.en: It is the first time annual carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from fossil fuels have fallen since the coronavirus pandemic in 2020. But the overall emissions picture suggests the world is still likely to miss key climate goals.
paras.zh: 这是自 2020 年冠状病毒大流行以来，化石燃料的年度二氧化碳 (CO2) 排放量首次下降。但总体排放情况表明，世界仍有可能无法实现关键的气候目标。

paras.en: "It is an encouraging sign that the growth of emissions is slowing and decarbonisation efforts are starting to make a difference," said Joeri Rogelj, a climate scientist at the Centre for Environmental Policy at Imperial College London who wasn't involved in the research. "However, at 0.4%, the projected decline is very small," Rogelj told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “这是一个令人鼓舞的迹象，表明排放量增长正在放缓，脱碳努力开始产生影响，”伦敦帝国理工学院环境政策中心气候科学家乔里·罗杰利（Joeri Rogelj）说，他没有参与这项研究。 “然而，0.4% 的下降幅度非常小，”Rogelj 在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》。

paras.en: The report projects 38.2 billion metric tons (42.1 billion U.S. tons) of emissions of the climate-warming greenhouse gas CO2 from fossil fuel sources this year. Greenhouse gases trap heat by absorbing the sun's radiation, and as their concentrations in the atmosphere increase, so do global average temperatures, leading to altered weather patterns and higher sea levels, as well as other major impacts.
paras.zh: 该报告预计，今年来自化石燃料的导致气候变暖的温室气体二氧化碳排放量将达到 382 亿吨（421 亿吨）。温室气体通过吸收太阳辐射来吸收热量，随着它们在大气中浓度的增加，全球平均气温也会增加，导致天气模式改变和海平面上升以及其他重大影响。

paras.en: Part of the 0.4% reduction in CO2 emissions is attributable to 40 countries that have cut emissions over the past decade while growing their economies. These include the U.S., Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, the United Kingdom, Japan and about 30 countries in the European Union, the researchers reported.
paras.zh: 二氧化碳排放量减少 0.4%，部分归功于 40 个国家在过去十年中在经济增长的同时减少了排放。研究人员报告称，这些国家包括美国、澳大利亚、新西兰、韩国、英国、日本和欧盟约 30 个国家。

paras.en: When it comes to some of the biggest emitters, annual CO2 emissions are projected to decrease by 0.9% in China, 1.3% in the U.S., 1.5% in the European Union and 1% in Japan, but India's annual CO2 emissions are projected to grow by 4.4%.
paras.zh: 就一些最大的排放国而言，中国的年二氧化碳排放量预计将减少0.9％，美国的1.3％，欧盟的1.5％和日本的1％，但印度的年二氧化碳排放量预计将增长4.4％。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Fossil-fuel-linked CO2 emissions from the rest of the world are projected to decrease by 0.7%, driven mainly by a 1.9% drop in oil emissions. The report authors suggested that this is a short-term response to the global supply constraints and increased prices triggered by the Iran conflict.
paras.zh: 世界其他地区与化石燃料相关的二氧化碳排放量预计将减少 0.7%，这主要是由于石油排放量下降 1.9%。报告作者认为，这是对伊朗冲突引发的全球供应限制和价格上涨的短期反应。

paras.en: "The war with Iran has resulted in restricted fuel availability and high prices, with a corresponding reduction in demand," Rogelj said.
paras.zh: 罗杰说：“与伊朗的战争导致燃料供应有限和价格高涨，需求相应减少。”

paras.en: While fossil fuel emissions and demand for oil are declining globally, overall demand for energy is actually increasing.
paras.zh: 尽管全球化石燃料排放量和石油需求正在下降，但能源总体需求实际上正在增加。

paras.en: "Based only on the demand for energy, which has grown, we would have expected an increase in fossil CO2 emissions by about 0.8 gigatonnes," said study co-author Judith Hauck, a biogeoscientist at the Alfred Wegener Institute, Helmholtz Centre for Polar and Marine Research in Germany.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、德国亥姆霍兹极地和海洋研究中心阿尔弗雷德韦格纳研究所的生物地球科学家朱迪思·豪克 (Judith Hauck) 表示：“仅根据不断增长的能源需求，我们预计化石二氧化碳排放量将增加约 0.8 十亿吨。”

paras.en: About two-thirds of that increase in demand is being met by solar and wind power and electric vehicles, showing that clean technologies are making a real difference in reducing global emissions, Hauck said. However, the hike in energy prices that resulted from the Iran conflict also decreased demand by 0.4%, she said.
paras.zh: 豪克说，约三分之二的需求增长是由太阳能、风能和电动汽车满足的，这表明清洁技术正在为减少全球排放发挥真正的作用。然而，她表示，伊朗冲突导致的能源价格上涨也导致需求下降了0.4%。

paras.en: "So only together with the energy crisis did we bring the change in emissions down to negative," Hauck told Live Science, adding that she expects CO2 emissions to rebound if the conflict ends, as they did after the temporary emissions drop caused by the lockdowns during the COVID-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: Hauck 告诉 Live Science，“因此，只有在能源危机的同时，我们才能将排放量的变化降至负值。”她补充说，她预计，如果冲突结束，二氧化碳排放量将会反弹，就像在 COVID-19 大流行期间的封锁导致排放量暂时下降之后那样。

paras.en: The exceptional circumstances that energy markets experienced this year make it clear that the small projected emissions decline is no reason to declare that emissions are now reducing, but there are hopeful signs, Rogelj said.
paras.zh: 罗杰说，今年能源市场经历的特殊情况清楚地表明，预计排放量的小幅下降并不是宣布排放量正在减少的理由，但也出现了充满希望的迹象。

paras.en: "Despite my muted enthusiasm about whether these lower emissions for 2026 represent the start of a long-term decline, the analysis shows encouraging signs of deeper long-term structural changes," he said. "But this shift must accelerate to ensure it is not outpaced by energy demand growth."
paras.zh: 他表示：“尽管我对 2026 年排放量下降是否代表长期下降的开始抱有热情，但分析显示了更深层次的长期结构性变化的令人鼓舞的迹象。” “但这种转变必须加速，以确保其不会被能源需求增长所超越。”

paras.en: The report found that clean energy growth isn't yet fast enough to drive a steady decline in global CO2 emissions attributable to fossil fuels. The study authors expect that to happen in the next few years, Hauck said, as long as there is a continued push to deploy solar and wind power, batteries and electric vehicles.
paras.zh: 报告发现，清洁能源增长速度还不够快，不足以推动化石燃料造成的全球二氧化碳排放量稳步下降。豪克表示，研究作者预计，只要继续推动太阳能和风能、电池和电动汽车的部署，这种情况就会在未来几年内发生。

paras.en: CO2 emissions from fossil fuels are just part of the picture, though. Because of increases in human-caused peat fires, deforestation and forest fires linked to dry El Niño conditions, total global CO2 emissions from all sources this year are projected to increase slightly from 42.8 billion metric tons (47.2 billion U.S. tons) last year to reach a record 43.3 billion metric tons (47.7 billion U.S. tons) this year, according to the report.
paras.zh: 不过，化石燃料产生的二氧化碳排放只是其中的一部分。报告称，由于人为造成的泥炭火灾、森林砍伐和与厄尔尼诺现象有关的森林火灾增加，今年全球所有来源的二氧化碳排放总量预计将从去年的 428 亿公吨（472 亿吨）略有增加，达到创纪录的 433 亿公吨（477 亿吨）。

paras.en: This means that the total budget of CO2 that can be emitted before global warming reaches 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) above preindustrial levels is now just 150 billion metric tons (165 billion U.S. tons) — equivalent to less than four years of emissions at the current rate.
paras.zh: 这意味着，在全球变暖达到比工业化前水平高 1.5 摄氏度（2.7 华氏度）之前，可排放的二氧化碳总预算目前仅为 1,500 亿公吨（1,650 亿美元）——按目前的速度相当于不到四年的排放量。

paras.en: Hauck, like many climate scientists, thinks we have already missed our chance to hit the 1.5 C target and could only get back to that level through extensive removal of CO2 from the atmosphere.?
paras.zh: 豪克和许多气候科学家一样，认为我们已经错过了实现 1.5 摄氏度目标的机会，只能通过大量清除大气中的二氧化碳来回到这一水平。

paras.en: "I'm still hopeful for something between 1.5 and 2 C [3.6 F]," Hauck said. "But for 1.5 degrees, we would need to see such a drastic strong drop in emissions. Based on what we've seen in the past years, even with this strong increase in avoided emissions, I don't think we can make that."
paras.zh: “我仍然对 1.5 到 2 C [3.6 F] 之间的温度抱有希望，”Hauck 说。 “但对于 1.5 度，我们需要看到排放量大幅下降。根据我们过去几年所看到的情况，即使避免的排放量大幅增加，我认为我们也无法做到这一点。”

paras.en: To halt global warming from increasing ever further, the world needs to be more ambitious in its planned emissions cuts, said Rogeli. We need to bring annual emissions down to zero to protect future generations from a double whammy of “having to try to transform economies so that they produce less climate pollution, while dealing with the impacts and damages of an increasingly adverse climate system," he said.
paras.zh: 罗格利说，为了阻止全球变暖进一步加剧，世界需要更加雄心勃勃地制定减排计划。他说，我们需要将年排放量降至零，以保护子孙后代免受双重打击，“必须努力转型经济，减少气候污染，同时应对日益不利的气候系统的影响和损害”。

paras.en: Chris Simms is a freelance journalist who previously worked at New Scientist for more than 10 years, in roles including chief subeditor and assistant news editor. He was also a senior subeditor at Nature and has a degree in zoology from Queen Mary University of London. In recent years, he has written numerous articles for New Scientist and in 2018 was shortlisted for Best Newcomer at the Association of British Science Writers awards.
paras.zh: 克里斯·西姆斯 (Chris Simms) 是一名自由撰稿人，曾在《新科学家》杂志工作了 10 多年，担任过首席副主编和助理新闻编辑等职务。他还是《自然》杂志的高级副编辑，并拥有伦敦玛丽女王大学动物学学位。近年来，他为《新科学家》撰写了大量文章，并于2018年入围英国科学作家协会奖最佳新人奖。

articles.title: Where Did Stonehenge's Mysterious, Six-Ton Altar Stone Really Come From? Geologists Rule Out the Scottish Hypothesis as the Search Deepens

paras.en: At the heart of Stonehenge on Salisbury Plain lies a flat, six-ton slab of sandstone whose origin has long baffled scientists. This mystery was seemingly solved in 2024 when the stone was linked to a potential source in northeast Scotland, at least 465 miles away by land. Now, a rigorous follow-up investigation has overturned that shocking conclusion, revealing that researchers were likely hunting across the wrong terrain.
paras.zh: 索尔兹伯里平原巨石阵的中心有一块重达六吨的平坦砂岩板，其起源长期以来一直困扰着科学家。这个谜团似乎在 2024 年得到了解决，当时这块石头与苏格兰东北部的一个潜在来源有关，距离陆地至少 465 英里。现在，一项严格的后续调查推翻了这一令人震惊的结论，表明研究人员可能在错误的地形上进行狩猎。

paras.en: A new study published this week in the Journal of the Geological Society compared the Altar Stone’s detailed geological signature with field samples gathered across the alleged origin site in Scotland’s Orcadian Basin. The findings determined that the slab’s true origin remains an unresolved puzzle, marking the latest chapter in an evolving scientific detective story about where distinctive 16-foot slab originated.
paras.zh: 本周《地质学会杂志》上发表的一项新研究将祭坛石的详细地质特征与在苏格兰奥卡迪亚盆地所谓的起源地点收集的现场样本进行了比较。研究结果表明，这块石板的真正起源仍然是一个未解之谜，这标志着关于独特的 16 英尺石板起源的不断发展的科学侦探故事的最新篇章。

paras.en: “This is the most comprehensive geological investigation of the Altar Stone ever undertaken,” Duncan Pirrie, an emeritus geologist at the University of South Wales who led the study, says in a statement.
paras.zh: 领导这项研究的南威尔士大学名誉地质学家邓肯·皮里 (Duncan Pirrie) 在一份声明中表示：“这是有史以来对祭坛石进行的最全面的地质调查。”

paras.en: He adds: “By combining a wide range of analytical techniques, we have built the clearest picture yet of the stone's composition and tested the leading theories about its origins. So far, none of the locations examined have the same set of characteristics as the Altar Stone. That tells us the search is not over, but we are now far better equipped to focus on the areas most likely to yield an answer.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“通过结合广泛的分析技术，我们对这块石头的成分有了最清晰的了解，并测试了有关其起源的主要理论。到目前为止，所检查的任何地点都没有与祭坛石相同的特征。这告诉我们搜索尚未结束，但我们现在更有能力专注于最有可能得出答案的区域。”

paras.en: Combining direct examinations of the Altar Stone with analyses of samples held in museum collections, researchers evaluated its sedimentology, geochemistry and mineralogy. In effect, they created a “geological fingerprint” of the slab, per the statement.
paras.zh: 研究人员将祭坛石的直接检查与博物馆藏品样本的分析相结合，评估了其沉积学、地球化学和矿物学。实际上，根据声明，他们创造了板块的“地质指纹”。

paras.en: The geologists then traveled across the Orcadian Basin looking for a potential match for this fingerprint. The fieldwork, however, proved formidable, like finding a needle in a haystack, Nick Pearce, an emeritus geochemist at Aberystwyth University and study co-author, tells the Guardian’s Steven Morris.
paras.zh: 随后，地质学家穿越奥卡迪亚盆地寻找与该指纹相匹配的潜在位置。然而，事实证明，实地考察是艰巨的，就像大海捞针一样，阿伯里斯特威斯大学的名誉地球化学家、该研究的合著者尼克·皮尔斯告诉《卫报》的史蒂文·莫里斯。

paras.en: “The problem is, it’s a very big area, thousands of square kilometers. The only way to do it is to get out there and find the samples,” Pearce explains. “We’ve taken about 70 samples, brought them back to laboratories and tested them.”
paras.zh: “问题是，这是一个非常大的区域，有数千平方公里。唯一的方法就是走出去寻找样本，”皮尔斯解释道。 “我们采集了大约 70 个样本，将它们带回实验室进行测试。”

paras.en: Laboratory evaluations of those 70 samples failed to produce a match, leading the team to conclude that it is very unlikely the Altar Stone came from northeast Scotland.
paras.zh: 实验室对这 70 个样本的评估未能得出匹配结果，导致研究小组得出结论，祭坛石不太可能来自苏格兰东北部。

paras.en: Despite the dead end, researchers insist that the negative result brings them closer to the truth. “In a geological detective story such as this, ruling out potential source areas is just as important as identifying new ones,” Pearce says in the statement. “The stone is unique among those at Stonehenge, and tracing its source would provide valuable new insights into its remarkable journey to Salisbury Plain thousands of years ago.”
paras.zh: 尽管出现了死胡同，研究人员坚持认为阴性结果让他们更接近真相。皮尔斯在声明中说：“在这样的地质侦探故事中，排除潜在的源区与识别新的源区同样重要。” “这块石头在巨石阵中是独一无二的，追踪它的来源将为了解数千年前它前往索尔兹伯里平原的非凡旅程提供有价值的新见解。”

paras.en: Constructed in several stages between 3000 B.C.E. and 1520 B.C.E., Stonehenge is composed of massive rock slabs that traveled over immense distances. While the massive sarsens came from nearby Marlborough Downs, the smaller bluestones were transported approximately 140 miles from the Preseli Hills in southwest Wales.
paras.zh: 公元前 3000 年之间分几个阶段建造公元前 1520 年，巨石阵由巨大的石板组成，这些石板经过了很长的距离。大量的萨尔森石来自附近的马尔堡丘陵，而较小的青石则是从威尔士西南部的普雷塞利山大约 140 英里处运来的。

paras.en: The Preseli Hills were long thought to be the origin of the Altar Stone, which lies flat and partially buried beneath the collapsed upright and lintel of the site’s largest trilithon. The 2024 theory of a Scottish origin dramatically expanded that range to more than 400 miles, igniting questions over whether Neolithic laborers dragged the stone south or sent it by water.
paras.zh: 长期以来，普雷塞利山一直被认为是祭坛石的起源，祭坛石平坦地躺着，部分埋在该遗址最大的三块石碑倒塌的立柱和门楣下面。 2024 年起源于苏格兰的理论将这一范围戏剧性地扩大到了 400 英里以上，引发了人们对新石器时代的工人是否将这块石头拖向南方还是通过水路运送的疑问。

paras.en: In 1620, landscape architect Inigo Jones suggested that the partially buried stone near the center of Stonehenge might have been used as an altar. It has been known as the Altar Stone ever since.
paras.zh: 1620 年，景观设计师 Inigo Jones 提出，巨石阵中心附近部分埋藏的石头可能被用作祭坛。从此以后，它就被称为祭坛石。

paras.en: Earlier this year, glaciologists modeled ancient ice sheets to evaluate whether glaciers could have transported the rock during the last Ice Age. Ice flows could theoretically have pushed Scottish boulders near Dogger Bank, a now-submerged landmass in the North Sea, but humans would have had to rescue the stone thousands of years before construction began at Stonehenge.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，冰川学家对古代冰原进行了建模，以评估冰川是否可以在上一个冰河时期运输岩石。从理论上讲，冰流可能会将苏格兰巨石推到北海现已被淹没的多格浅滩附近，但人类必须在巨石阵开始建造之前数千年才能拯救这块巨石。

paras.en: With northeast Scotland and southern Britain both ruled out, the search for the Altar Stone’s birthplace now pivots to alternative formations in northern England, other parts of Scotland or even Ireland.
paras.zh: 由于苏格兰东北部和英国南部都被排除在外，对祭坛石诞生地的搜寻现在转向英格兰北部、苏格兰其他地区甚至爱尔兰的其他地层。

paras.en: Pinpointing the true quarry remains essential for understanding the builders themselves. As Mike Pitts, an archaeologist who was not involved in the study, tells the Guardian, identifying the source “would greatly help fit the altar stone into the world of the people who moved it. We’d get to see the landscape through their eyes. To know exactly where the journey began.”
paras.zh: 查明真正的采石场对于了解建筑商本身仍然至关重要。正如未参与这项研究的考古学家迈克·皮茨 (Mike Pitts) 告诉《卫报》的那样，确定来源“将极大地帮助将祭坛石融入移动它的人的世界。我们可以通过他们的眼睛看到风景。准确地知道旅程从哪里开始。”

articles.title: Even Replacing Some of Your Dietary Dairy With Plant-Based Alternatives Can Lead to Nutrient Deficiencies, Study Suggests

paras.en: Alternative dairy products are widely available in many countries. Grocery stores and cafes frequently offer “milks” made from soy, almond, oat, rice or other crops. That’s good news for people who don’t consume dairy, as well as for our planet, since the production of plant-based milk is more environmentally friendly than regular milk.
paras.zh: 替代乳制品在许多国家随处可见。杂货店和咖啡馆经常提供由大豆、杏仁、燕麦、大米或其他农作物制成的“牛奶”。这对于不食用乳制品的人们以及我们的星球来说都是个好消息，因为植物奶的生产比普通牛奶更环保。

paras.en: But relying on these plant-based alternatives—even partially—might carry health risks. In a study published in the September issue of the journal Lancet Planetary Health, researchers ran computer simulations based on United Kingdom nutrition data and found that swapping standard dairy for vegan versions can lead to deficiencies of four vital nutrients. However, that could be combated by mandating that nutrients be added to plant-based dairy alternatives, as well as bread, making them fortified foods.
paras.zh: 但依赖这些植物性替代品——即使是部分依赖——可能会带来健康风险。在《柳叶刀行星健康》杂志九月号发表的一项研究中，研究人员根据英国营养数据进行了计算机模拟，发现将标准乳制品换成纯素食版本可能会导致四种重要营养素的缺乏。然而，可以通过强制将营养素添加到植物性乳制品替代品和面包中，使它们成为强化食品来解决这一问题。

paras.en: Vegan milks, cheeses, yogurts, ice creams and more are becoming increasingly popular as people turn to them for health or sustainability reasons. However, they often lack certain nutrients found in dairy.
paras.zh: 随着人们出于健康或可持续发展的原因转向纯素牛奶、奶酪、酸奶、冰淇淋等，它们变得越来越受欢迎。然而，它们通常缺乏乳制品中的某些营养素。

paras.en: To explore the potential public health implications, researchers pulled data from the U.K.’s National Diet and Nutrition Survey involving more than 3,500 people between the ages of 1.5 and 100 years old. They put that information into a computer model to simulate how swapping out regular milk, yogurt and cheese with commercially available plant-based versions affected intake of four micronutrients: iodine, calcium, riboflavin and vitamin B12.
paras.zh: 为了探索潜在的公共卫生影响，研究人员从英国全国饮食和营养调查中提取了数据，涉及3500多名年龄在1.5岁至100岁之间的人。他们将这些信息放入计算机模型中，以模拟用市售的植物性牛奶、酸奶和奶酪替代普通牛奶、酸奶和奶酪如何影响四种微量营养素的摄入：碘、钙、核黄素和维生素B12。

paras.en: The results weren’t great. Even replacing a modest amount of dairy caused a decline in intake of all analyzed micronutrients. Iodine took the biggest hit. Your thyroid gland needs iodine to make certain hormones, and it’s also crucial for brain development. The micronutrient is especially important for infants, adolescents and pregnant people.
paras.zh: 结果并不好。即使更换适量的乳制品也会导致所有分析的微量营养素的摄入量下降。碘受到的打击最大。您的甲状腺需要碘来产生某些激素，这对大脑发育也至关重要。微量营养素对于婴儿、青少年和孕妇尤其重要。

paras.en: The survey data revealed that 54 percent of girls ages 14 to 18 weren’t eating enough iodine. Replacing just 35 percent of dairy with plant-based alternatives would cause the deficiency to jump to 65 percent. Similarly, 32 percent of women ages 19 to 49 were iodine deficient at baseline, and it would rise to 42 percent after the same dairy swap.
paras.zh: 调查数据显示，14 至 18 岁的女孩中有 54% 的碘摄入不足。仅用植物性替代品替代 35% 的乳制品就会导致缺口跃升至 65%。同样，19 岁至 49 岁的女性中有 32% 在基线时缺碘，在更换相同的乳制品后，这一比例将上升至 42%。

paras.en: If dairy intake was completely replaced, 80 percent of teenage girls and 72 percent of teenage boys would be iodine deficient, according to the computer simulations.
paras.zh: 根据计算机模拟，如果完全替代乳制品摄入量，80% 的十几岁女孩和 72% 的十几岁男孩将缺碘。

paras.en: Did you know? Other drivers of iodine deficiency
paras.zh: 你可知道？碘缺乏的其他驱动因素

paras.en: In recent years, many people have been replacing their typical table salt with trendier versions, like Himalayan, sea and kosher. However, that’s contributing to a rise in iodine deficiency, since table salt is often fortified with the micronutrient.
paras.zh: 近年来，许多人开始用喜马拉雅盐、海盐和犹太盐等更时尚的盐来代替传统的食盐。然而，这导致了碘缺乏症的增加，因为食盐通常含有微量营养素。

paras.en: “A strength of the study is that it looks at partial replacement rather than only a complete switch, which better reflects how most people actually change their diets. It also breaks the results down by age and sex, which shows clearly who is most at risk,” says Ian Givens, director of the University of Reading’s Institute for Food, Nutrition and Health in England and a registered nutritionist, in an expert reaction compiled by the Science Media Centre.
paras.zh: 英国雷丁大学食品、营养与健康研究所所长、注册营养师伊恩·吉文斯在科学媒体中心汇编的专家评论中表示：“这项研究的优点在于，它着眼于部分替代，而不仅仅是完全改变，这更好地反映了大多数人实际上如何改变饮食。它还按年龄和性别对结果进行了细分，这清楚地表明了谁的风险最大。”

paras.en: However, “there are limitations,” adds Givens, who wasn’t involved in the study. “The findings are based on modeled reduction of dairy intake, so they show a risk of inadequacy rather than confirming deficiency but are still valuable data.”
paras.zh: 然而，“存在局限性”，没有参与这项研究的吉文斯补充道。 “这些发现是基于乳制品摄入量减少的模型，因此它们显示了不足的风险，而不是确认缺乏，但仍然是有价值的数据。”

paras.en: Next, the researchers investigated whether fortification of vegan dairy products, as well as the staple food bread, might help avoid these predicted micronutrient deficiencies. The strategy worked. Computer simulations suggested that adding iodine to both types of food caused iodine deficiency to drop to 37 percent among teenage girls at 20 percent dairy replacement. And at a complete dairy swap, deficiency was projected to be at 43 percent among adolescent girls.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究人员调查了纯素乳制品以及主食面包的强化是否有助于避免这些预测的微量营养素缺乏症。这个策略奏效了。计算机模拟表明，在这两种食物中添加碘，在乳制品替代量为 20% 的情况下，少女的碘缺乏率下降至 37%。在一次完整的乳制品交换中，预计青春期女孩的缺陷率为 43%。

paras.en: Ultimately, the team’s findings indicate that more foods should have fortification requirements.
paras.zh: 最终，该团队的研究结果表明，更多的食品应该有强化要求。

paras.en: “Nutrition policy must evolve in tandem with environmental targets,” study co-author Katie Nicol, a human nutrition researcher at the University of Surrey in England, says in a statement. “However, it is important that shifts towards more sustainable diets do not compromise on public health. Fortification of foods is one way that this could be achieved; however, government policy is needed to make this happen.”
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、英国萨里大学人类营养研究员凯蒂·尼科尔在一份声明中表示：“营养政策必须与环境目标同步发展。” “然而，重要的是，转向更可持续的饮食不会损害公共健康。食品强化是实现这一目标的一种方式；然而，需要政府政策来实现这一目标。”

paras.en: The good news is that some companies are already doing this.
paras.zh: 好消息是一些公司已经在这样做了。

paras.en: “For anyone choosing plant-based milk, I’d recommend checking the label and choosing one fortified with iodine, such as Alpro,” Nichola Ludlam-Raine, a registered dietitian and spokesperson for the British Dietetic Association, who did not participate in the study, tells the Guardian’s Ian Sample. She notes that organic drinks don’t contain added nutrients.
paras.zh: “对于任何选择植物奶的人，我建议检查标签并选择一种加碘的奶，例如 Alpro，”未参与这项研究的英国饮食协会注册营养师兼发言人 Nichola Ludlam-Raine 告诉《卫报》的 Ian Sample。她指出，有机饮料不含添加营养素。

paras.en: And all of Oatly’s unflavored, non-organic oat drinks contain added nutrients, including iodine, calcium, riboflavin and vitamin B12, says Caroline Orfila Jenkins, the company’s vice president for science and technology, to the outlet. “This research underlines the importance of appropriate fortification as diets become more plant-based.”
paras.zh: 该公司负责科技的副总裁卡罗琳·奥菲拉·詹金斯 (Caroline Orfila Jenkins) 向媒体表示，Oatly 的所有无味、非有机燕麦饮料都添加了营养成分，包括碘、钙、核黄素和维生素 B12。 “这项研究强调了随着饮食变得更加以植物为基础，适当强化的重要性。”

articles.title: Humans May Have Been Getting High on Weed 2,800 Years Ago. Cannabis Seeds and Hair With Traces of THC Were Found in an Ancient Tomb

paras.en: Cannabis is one of the world’s most widely used psychoactive plants, with millions of people inhaling and ingesting it for its mind-altering effects. But new research suggests our current relationship with weed is nothing new.
paras.zh: 大麻是世界上使用最广泛的精神活性植物之一，数百万人因其改变精神的作用而吸入和摄入它。但新的研究表明，我们目前与杂草的关系并不是什么新鲜事。

paras.en: A study published November 5 in the journal Science suggests humans have been getting high on weed for at least 2,800 years—centuries longer than previously thought. The findings seem to offer the earliest direct evidence of cannabis use.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日发表在《科学》杂志上的一项研究表明，人类吸食大麻的历史至少有 2800 年，比之前认为的要长几个世纪。这些发现似乎提供了大麻使用的最早直接证据。

paras.en: Researchers have long been interested in how ancient people used cannabis. Yet studying it has proven tricky because plants are rarely preserved over long periods of time. Since cannabis has many uses, including the production of oil and fiber, it’s even more challenging to determine whether and when individuals were using it specifically to get high.
paras.zh: 研究人员长期以来对古代人如何使用大麻感兴趣。然而，研究它被证明是很棘手的，因为植物很少能长期保存。由于大麻有多种用途，包括生产油和纤维，因此确定个人是否以及何时专门使用大麻来获得快感更具挑战性。

paras.en: In 2017, archaeologists digging in southern Siberia discovered a huge 2,800-year-old tomb that contained the remains of several high-status individuals. The site, called Tunnug 1, is associated with the Scythians, a nomadic, horse-riding culture that occupied the Eurasian steppe from the ninth to the third century B.C.E.
paras.zh: 2017年，考古学家在西伯利亚南部挖掘发现了一座有2800年历史的巨大坟墓，里面有几具高地位个人的遗骸。这个名为Tunnug 1的遗址与Scythians有关， Scythians是一种游牧的骑马文化，从公元前9世纪到公元前3世纪占领了欧亚大草原。

paras.en: Excavations turned up numerous artifacts, from weapons and animal statues to pieces of gold jewelry and horse gear. But the researchers also found nearly 1,500 whole or partial cannabis seeds at the site, as well as preserved human hair, which allowed them to explore whether the Scythians might have been getting high.
paras.zh: 挖掘工作中发现了许多文物，从武器和动物雕像到黄金首饰和马具。但研究人员还在现场发现了近 1,500 颗完整或部分大麻种子，以及保存完好的人类头发，这使他们能够探索斯基泰人是否可能吸毒了。

paras.en: “It’s only so often as an archaeologist that you get to drug test a person that’s been dead for nearly 3,000 years,” lead author Gino Caspari, an archaeologist at the University of Bern in Switzerland and the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology in Germany, tells the New York Times’ Annie Roth.
paras.zh: 主要作者、瑞士伯尔尼大学和德国马克斯·普朗克地质人类学研究所的考古学家吉诺·卡斯帕里（ Gino Caspari ）告诉《纽约时报》的安妮·罗斯（ Annie Roth ） ： “作为一名考古学家，你经常会对一个已经死了近3000年的人进行药物测试。”

paras.en: Radiocarbon dating traced the seeds to the early eighth century B.C.E., around the same time the burial site is believed to have been constructed. The hair, meanwhile, tested positive for pot. Specifically, the strands contained cannabinol (CBN), a byproduct of tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), the primary psychoactive compound in the plant. It also contained weaker chemical signatures consistent with THC.
paras.zh: 放射性碳测年将这些种子追溯到公元前八世纪初，据信大约在同一时间建造了墓地。与此同时，头发的大麻检测结果呈阳性。具体来说，这些线含有大麻酚（CBN），它是四氢大麻酚（THC）的副产品，而四氢大麻酚是植物中主要的精神活性化合物。它还含有与 THC 一致的较弱的化学特征。

paras.en: Caspari tells the Associated Press’ Jamey Keaten and Philipp Jenne that it’s “extremely rare” for archaeologists to find “both preserved plant parts and human soft tissue with the active compounds in it in the same context.”
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里告诉美联社的杰米·基滕和菲利普·詹尼，考古学家“极其罕见”地发现“在同一环境中发现保存完好的植物部分和含有活性化合物的人体软组织”。

paras.en: Together, the results suggest the Scythians were using cannabis for its intoxicating properties. The researchers also believe they intentionally deposited the seeds in the tomb, likely because they viewed cannabis as important.
paras.zh: 总而言之，这些结果表明斯基泰人使用大麻是因为大麻具有令人陶醉的特性。研究人员还认为，他们故意将种子埋在坟墓中，可能是因为他们认为大麻很重要。

paras.en: “Things of value in the world of the living often made it into the burial context as an offering in this region,” Caspari tells Reuters’ Will Dunham.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里告诉路透社记者威尔·邓纳姆：“生者世界中有价值的东西经常作为该地区的祭品进入墓葬环境。”

paras.en: The idea is further supported by a historic description of Scythian funeral practices. Per the Times, the Greek historian Herodotus wrote in 440 B.C.E. that the Scythians “take some of this hemp seed and, creeping under the felt coverings, throw it upon the red-hot stones; immediately it smokes and gives out such a vapor as no Greek vapor bath can exceed; the Scyths, delighted, shout for joy.”
paras.zh: 对斯基泰葬礼习俗的历史描述进一步支持了这一想法。据《泰晤士报》报道，希腊历史学家希罗多德于公元前 440 年写道：斯基泰人“取一些大麻籽，爬到毛毡覆盖物下面，把它扔到烧红的石头上；它立即冒烟，散发出希腊蒸气浴无法比拟的蒸气；斯基泰人高兴极了，欢呼雀跃。”

paras.en: Caspari tells Reuters that researchers were always “quite hesitant” to believe Herodotus’ writings, because he tended to “drift into the fantastic.” However, based on their recent findings, they now know that “at least some of his descriptions about the steppe peoples had some truth,” he adds.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里告诉路透社，研究人员总是“相当犹豫”是否相信希罗多德的著作，因为他倾向于“陷入幻想”。然而，根据他们最近的发现，他们现在知道“至少他对草原民族的一些描述是有一定道理的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Did you know? Earliest evidence of habitual drug use
paras.zh: 你可知道？习惯性吸毒的最早证据

paras.en: In September, researchers reported the earliest evidence for habitual drug use ever discovered. In a cave in Indonesia, they found the teeth of an individual who appears to have habitually sucked on betel nuts roughly 16,000 to 25,000 years ago, possibly to soothe a toothache.
paras.zh: 九月，研究人员报告了迄今为止发现的习惯性吸毒的最早证据。在印度尼西亚的一个洞穴中，他们发现了一个人的牙齿，该人似乎在大约 16,000 至 25,000 年前习惯性地吮吸槟榔，可能是为了缓解牙痛。

paras.en: Until now, the earliest evidence of cannabis use came from a 2,500-year-old burial site in western China, where archaeologists discovered the remains of charred cannabis with high levels of THC. However, ancient people there may not have been using cannabis to get high—it’s possible they were burning it for some other reason, such as to mask the smell of death.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，大麻使用的最早证据来自中国西部一处拥有 2500 年历史的墓地，考古学家在那里发现了含有高含量 THC 的烧焦大麻遗骸。然而，那里的古人可能并没有使用大麻来获得快感——他们可能出于其他原因燃烧大麻，比如掩盖死亡的气味。

paras.en: The new paper, with its analysis of both cannabis seeds and pot-laced human hair, provides a “smoking gun of evidence” that humans were using the plant for its intoxicating properties, Caspar Meyer, an archaeologist at Bard College who was not involved with the paper, tells Scientific American’s Mary Randolph.
paras.zh: 巴德学院的考古学家卡斯帕·迈耶（Caspar Meyer）没有参与这篇论文，他告诉《科学美国人》的玛丽·伦道夫，这篇新论文对大麻种子和盆栽人类头发进行了分析，提供了“确凿的证据”，证明人类利用这种植物是因为它具有令人陶醉的特性。

paras.en: Others are skeptical, though. Volker Auwärter, a forensic toxicologist at the Medical Center-University of Freiburg in Germany, tells the AP that the hair analysis is “scientifically weak” and that the strands could’ve picked up traces of cannabis from the surrounding plant material.
paras.zh: 但其他人则持怀疑态度。德国弗莱堡大学医学中心的法医毒理学家沃尔克·奥瓦特 (Volker Auwärter) 告诉美联社，头发分析“在科学上是站不住脚的”，这些头发可能从周围的植物材料中发现了大麻的痕迹。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the research team is continuing to investigate the Scythians’ cannabis use and cultivation practices, such as whether they were choosing to grow plants that had high levels of mind-altering THC. “We have already begun sequencing some of the plant samples,” Caspari says in a statement. “DNA preservation is excellent in this case. This will help us learn more about the history of the domestication and spread of this crop soon.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究小组仍在继续调查斯基泰人的大麻使用和种植实践，例如他们是否选择种植含有高水平的改变精神的四氢大麻酚的植物。 “我们已经开始对一些植物样本进行测序，”卡斯帕里在一份声明中说。 “在这种情况下，DNA 保存得很好。这将帮助我们尽快了解更多关于这种作物的驯化和传播的历史。”

paras.en: It’s also unclear whether the Scythians used cannabis exclusively during funerals, or whether getting high was more of a regular, everyday practice. One possibility, the researchers speculate, is that cannabis use helped ease some of the tension surrounding burials, which may have involved human sacrifice. The surface of the tomb at Tunnug 1, for instance, is littered with horse and human bones.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚斯基泰人是否只在葬礼上使用大麻，或者吸毒是否更常见。研究人员推测，一种可能性是大麻的使用有助于缓解埋葬过程中的一些紧张气氛，埋葬可能涉及活人献祭。例如，Tunnug 1 号坟墓的表面散落着马骨和人骨。

paras.en: “Since we have dozens of sacrificed horses and some potential human sacrifices, it might also have been used to sedate the victims before something bad happened to them—but we cannot prove that,” Caspari tells CNN’s Jack Guy.
paras.zh: 卡斯帕里告诉美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）的杰克·盖伊（Jack Guy）：“由于我们有数十匹被牺牲的马匹和一些潜在的人类牺牲品，因此它也可能在受害者发生不幸事件之前被用来镇静受害者，但我们无法证明这一点。”

articles.title: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information
articles.author: Isabella Ward

paras.en: A security researcher has found more than 100 serious vulnerabilities in publicly available UK government code, putting sensitive data at risk as a result of poor cyber hygiene.
paras.zh: 一名安全研究人员在公开的英国政府代码中发现了 100 多个严重漏洞，由于网络卫生状况不佳，敏感数据面临风险。

paras.en: The UK government has defaulted to openly publishing code it produces with public money for around a decade because it’s transparent, and making it easier for code to be reused is cost-efficient. This includes within the Department of Health and Social Care, and the Home Office, as well as local authorities.
paras.zh: 大约十年来，英国政府一直默认公开发布用公共资金生成的代码，因为它是透明的，并且使代码更容易重用具有成本效益。这包括卫生和社会保障部、内政部以及地方当局。

paras.en: But funding squeezes have left departments neglecting maintenance and improvement of their technology estate. While ControlPlane security researcher Chris Nesbitt-Smith found the vulnerabilities using Claude’s Opus and Sonnet AI models, he says that he used consumer-grade models on a laptop and that many of the issues could have been caught by a routine IT health check. “None of this is the level of sophistication that general media is worried about in terms of cyber attacks,” he tells WIRED. “It’s all daft stuff.”
paras.zh: 但资金紧张导致各部门忽视了技术资产的维护和改进。虽然 ControlPlane 安全研究员 Chris Nesbitt-Smith 使用 Claude 的 Opus 和 Sonnet AI 模型发现了这些漏洞，但他表示，他在笔记本电脑上使用了消费级模型，并且许多问题可以通过例行 IT 健康检查发现。他告诉《连线》杂志：“这一切都不是一般媒体所担心的网络攻击的复杂程度。” “这都是愚蠢的事情。”

paras.en: In the most serious case he identified, the Planning Inspectorate, which handles land-use matters across England, had failed to fully remove a login after it accidentally committed them to public repository GitHub. The fact the credentials gave such wide access—and seemingly didn’t expire—compounded with the agency’s accidental publication of them, “made it particularly dangerous for them.”
paras.zh: 在他发现的最严重的案例中，负责处理英格兰各地土地使用事务的规划监察局在不小心将登录信息提交到公共存储库 GitHub 后未能完全删除登录信息。事实上，这些凭证提供了如此广泛的访问权限，而且似乎没有过期，再加上该机构意外公布了这些凭证，“这对他们来说尤其危险”。

paras.en: The complete Microsoft Entra ID would have given “god-tier” read and write access to all SharePoint sites and private employee OneDrive accounts, according to Nesbitt-Smith, including HR records. It also would have given access to sensitive libraries which safeguard evidence under legal hold for statutory planning inquiries and appeals, according to the security researcher who found it. “The option for ransomwaring them, for encrypting all the data, or just stealing all the data, was abundantly there,” Nesbitt-Smith says.
paras.zh: Nesbitt-Smith 表示，完整的 Microsoft Entra ID 将赋予对所有 SharePoint 站点和私人员工 OneDrive 帐户（包括 HR 记录）的“上帝级”读写访问权限。据发现它的安全研究人员称，它还可以访问敏感图书馆，这些图书馆可以合法保存法定规划查询和上诉的证据。 “勒索、加密所有数据或窃取所有数据的选项非常多，”内斯比特-史密斯说。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Planning Inspectorate told WIRED its cyber monitoring tools immediately detected Nesbitt-Smith’s activity in August and that it had already been handling this as a cyber incident when ControlPlane made contact. The agency identified and fixed this vulnerability within 20 minutes of the report and verified that no data breach occurred. “We have reviewed and strengthened our systems and processes to prevent this type of issue recurring and we are grateful for the researcher’s work and for alerting us to it,” they told WIRED.
paras.zh: 规划监察局的一位发言人告诉《连线》杂志，其网络监控工具立即检测到 Nesbitt-Smith 在 8 月份的活动，并且在 ControlPlane 联系时已将其作为网络事件进行处理。该机构在报告后 20 分钟内识别并修复了该漏洞，并确认没有发生数据泄露。他们告诉《连线》杂志：“我们已经审查并加强了我们的系统和流程，以防止此类问题再次发生，我们感谢研究人员的工作并提醒我们注意这一点。”

paras.en: The Planning Inspectorate issue “isn’t about open source but internal housekeeping when using public tools,” Amanda Brock, chief executive officer of nonprofit industry group OpenUK. “That data was exposed because of a failure not to follow good process,” she adds. “That’s not an open source security issue.”
paras.zh: 非营利行业组织 OpenUK 的首席执行官阿曼达·布洛克 (Amanda Brock) 表示，规划监察局的问题“与开源无关，而是在使用公共工具时的内部管理问题”。 “这些数据之所以被曝光，是因为没有遵循良好的流程，”她补充道。 “这不是开源安全问题。”

paras.en: In around two-thirds of the 349 public sector codebases across 33 organizations Nesbitt-Smith scanned, he said he found vulnerabilities. Several of these were found in the Department of Education’s code, including in a procurement service used by schools, in a teacher application service containing personal details, qualifications, employment history and identity documents, and England’s main register of government-funded training providers and apprenticeships. He also found a vulnerability in a Scottish Government open data portal which would have allowed any visitor to read administrative account information and to change site configuration. The organizations have since dealt with the issues.
paras.zh: Nesbitt-Smith 表示，他扫描了 33 个组织的 349 个公共部门代码库，其中约三分之二发现了漏洞。其中一些在教育部的代码中被发现，包括学校使用的采购服务、包含个人详细信息、资格、工作经历和身份证件的教师申请服务，以及英格兰政府资助的培训机构和学徒的主要登记册。他还在苏格兰政府开放数据门户中发现了一个漏洞，该漏洞允许任何访问者读取管理帐户信息并更改站点配置。此后，这些组织已着手处理这些问题。

paras.en: Recently, there have been arguments for public sector departments to stop publishing source code in the open, now that AI has accelerated vulnerability discovery. The NHS reportedly ordered technology teams to transition away from open source code in May amid security concerns about the impact of AI models.
paras.zh: 最近，由于人工智能加速了漏洞发现，有人主张公共部门停止公开发布源代码。据报道，出于对人工智能模型影响的安全担忧，NHS 在 5 月份下令技术团队放弃开源代码。

paras.en: Doing this without immediately fixing the underlying issues would be the “worst case scenario,” according to Nesbitt-Smith, as it prevents researchers like him from finding them, and it’s likely that an adversary has already mirrored these repositories and so will maintain access to them. “Unless you’re going to go and fix all of the problems, if anything, you’re probably drawing more attention to it by closing it,” says Nesbitt-Smith, “because you’re like, ‘Here be dragons over this space. Don’t look here though, please.’”
paras.zh: 内斯比特-史密斯表示，在不立即解决根本问题的情况下执行此操作将是“最坏的情况”，因为这会阻止像他这样的研究人员找到它们，而且对手很可能已经镜像了这些存储库，因此将继续访问它们。内斯比特-史密斯说：“除非你要去解决所有问题（如果有的话），否则你可能会通过关闭它来吸引更多的注意力，因为你会想，‘这里有龙。但请不要看这里。’”

articles.title: NTSB recovers cockpit voice recorder from Florida Learjet crash

paras.en: Nov. 9 (UPI) -- Federal investigators announced Monday evening that the cockpit voice recorder from the Learjet that crashed near a Florida intersection earlier this month, killing all nine people aboard, has been recovered.
paras.zh: 11 月 9 日（UPI）——联邦调查人员周一晚间宣布，本月早些时候在佛罗里达州十字路口附近坠毁、机上 9 人全部遇难的里尔喷气式飞机的驾驶舱录音机已被找到。

paras.en: The device, known as a black box, was recovered from the site of initial impact, the National Transportation Safety Board said in a social media statement announcing the recovery. It was not clear what data, if any, was captured on the device.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会在社交媒体上宣布回收的声明中表示，该设备被称为黑匣子，已从最初撞击地点回收。目前尚不清楚该设备捕获了哪些数据（如果有的话）。

paras.en: "The CVR is being evaluated in the NTSB Vehicle Recorders Laboratory in Washington, D.C.," the NTSB said.
paras.zh: NTSB 表示：“华盛顿特区的 NTSB 车辆记录仪实验室正在对 CVR 进行评估。”

paras.en: "The excavation work at the impact site has been completed."
paras.zh: “撞击地点的挖掘工作已经完成。”

paras.en: En route from Austin, Texas, to the Bahamas, the Learjet 60 slammed into the ground near Greenacres, Fla., a around 12:50 p.m. EST on Nov. 1.
paras.zh: 在从德克萨斯州奥斯汀飞往巴哈马的途中，里尔 60 于中午 12 点 50 分左右坠入佛罗里达州格林埃克斯附近的地面。美国东部时间 11 月 1 日。

paras.en: Dashcam footage of the crash from nearby vehicles shows the jet plunging into the ground and erupting into a fireball.
paras.zh: 附近车辆的行车记录仪拍摄的坠机画面显示，飞机坠入地面并喷发出火球。

paras.en: Among those aboard the private jet were Texas tech entrepreneur Adam Robinson, his wife, Helen Sharp and their children, Emma and Charlie, as well as the children's nanny, Anita Maria Ramirez Cetina, and friends of the family Rachel Reed and Rowan "Charmi" Fehr Toews. The pilot was Jeffrey Gregory, and the co-pilot Nathalia Filgueiras.
paras.zh: 私人飞机上的乘客包括德克萨斯州科技企业家 Adam Robinson、他的妻子 Helen Sharp 和他们的孩子 Emma 和 Charlie，以及孩子们的保姆 Anita Maria Ramirez Cetina，以及家人的朋友 Rachel Reed 和 Rowan“Charmi” Fehr Toews。飞行员是杰弗里·格雷戈里（Jeffrey Gregory），副驾驶是娜塔莉亚·菲尔盖拉斯（Nathalia Filgueiras）。

paras.en: The cause of the crash remains under investigation.
paras.zh: 坠机原因仍在调查中。

paras.en: The announcement of the black box's recovery comes a day after the NTSB said it had completed its on-site investigation with the exception of the excavation of the impact site, which was ongoing.
paras.zh: 就在宣布黑匣子已被打捞的一天前，国家运输安全委员会表示已完成现场调查，但撞击现场的挖掘工作仍在进行中。

paras.en: Investigators were able to recover and identify portions of the aircraft, including components from both wings, both engines, the flight deck and vertical stabilizer, among others, some of which were transported to Washington, D.C., to the NTSB lab for further inspection.
paras.zh: 调查人员成功找到并识别了飞机的部分部件，包括两个机翼、两个发动机、飞行甲板和垂直安定面等部件，其中一些部件被运到华盛顿特区的 NTSB 实验室进行进一步检查。

paras.en: It was earlier reported that parts of the plane were found nearly 4 miles away from the crash site.
paras.zh: 早些时候有报道称，飞机的部分部件在距坠机地点近 4 英里的地方被发现。

articles.title: Trump: Jensen Huang had 'no idea' woman was Chinese spy

paras.en: Nov. 9 (UPI) -- President Donald Trump said Monday that Nvidia's embattled CEO Jensen Huang "had absolutely no idea" that a woman with whom he allegedly had an affair was a suspected Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 11 月 9 日（UPI）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示，陷入困境的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋“完全不知道”一名据称与他有染的女子是一名疑似中国间谍。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters in a surprise White House press briefing on Monday alongside Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White, Trump said he spoke with Huang earlier in the day to "see if he's feeling alright."
paras.zh: 周一，特朗​​普与终极格斗锦标赛首席执行官达纳·怀特(Dana White)一起在白宫举行的一场出人意料的新闻发布会上对记者表示，他当天早些时候与黄进行了交谈，“看看他是否感觉还好”。

paras.en: "I asked him that question: 'Did you have any idea that she was a spy?' He said, 'I had no idea that she was a spy,' and I really believe him," Trump said.
paras.zh: “我问他这个问题：‘你知道她是间谍吗？’他说，‘我不知道她是间谍’，我真的相信他，”特朗普说。

paras.en: The press conference was held after Nvidia, a world leader in semiconductor design, announced Sunday night that it had opened an investigation into reports that Huang, the U.S. company's co-founder and CEO, was the target of a foreign intelligence operation.
paras.zh: 此次新闻发布会是在全球半导体设计领域的领导者英伟达周日晚间宣布，该公司已对有关美国公司联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报机构目标的报道展开调查。

paras.en: The New York Times and the Financial Times have reported that Huang had an intimate relationship with Alice Huang, a top executive with Singapore-based Megaspeed. According to The Times, a U.S. intelligence memo circulated among Trump administration policymakers last spring alleged that Alice Huang had been recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the Nvidia chief.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》和《金融时报》报道，黄与新加坡 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 关系密切。据《泰晤士报》报道，去年春天在特朗普政府决策者中流传的一份美国情报备忘录称，中国国家安全部招募了爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）来监视英伟达首席执行官。

paras.en: Huang, who is married, has admitted to having an affair but did not name the other woman. Nvidia has said it has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised.
paras.zh: 已婚的黄承认有外遇，但没有透露另一名女子的名字。英伟达表示，没有理由相信国家安全或英伟达机密遭到泄露。

paras.en: Nvidia designs some of the world's most advanced artificial intelligence chips that are subject to U.S. export restrictions to China over concerns they could be used to advance Beijing's military, surveillance and artificial intelligence sectors.
paras.zh: 英伟达设计了一些世界上最先进的人工智能芯片，这些芯片受到美国对中国的出口限制，因为担心这些芯片可能被用来推进北京的军事、监视和人工智能领域的发展。

paras.en: "The 'Chinese spy' allegation is purely unsubstantiated and directed at smearing China," Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun told reporters during a regularly scheduled press conference on Monday.
paras.zh: “‘中国间谍’指控纯属毫无根据，旨在抹黑中国，”外交部发言人郭家琨在周一的例行记者会上对记者表示。

paras.en: Asked when he was informed of concerns about Huang and the alleged affair, Trump said "not too long ago."
paras.zh: 当被问及他何时得知对黄和所谓的婚外情的担忧时，特朗普说“不久前”。

paras.en: Responding to a question about whether he had read the intelligence memo that had circulated in the spring, Trump said: "Well, I'd certainly check with the intelligence people. It could have been mentioned. Certainly, it didn't make much of an impact on me."
paras.zh: 在回答有关他是否阅读了春季流传的情报备忘录的问题时，特朗普说：“嗯，我当然会向情报人员核实。这本来可以被提及。当然，这对我没有太大影响。”

paras.en: Trump, who is a close associate with Huang, also said the FBI was "looking into it in terms of something else," but did not elaborate.
paras.zh: 与黄的关系密切的特朗普也表示，联邦调查局正在“从其他方面调查此事”，但没有详细说明。

paras.en: Nvidia said that Huang will continue to lead the company amid the investigation.
paras.zh: 英伟达表示，黄将在调查期间继续领导公司。

paras.en: "I know Jensen very well," Trump said. "I just think he's a very honorable man. I mean, he's built a great company, American company, and I think he's a very honorable guy, and I feel very confident that he'll be in good shape."
paras.zh: “我非常了解詹森，”特朗普说。 “我只是认为他是一个非常值得尊敬的人。我的意思是，他建立了一家伟大的公司，美国公司，我认为他是一个非常值得尊敬的人，我对他会保持良好的状态非常有信心。”

articles.title: Three more charged in human-smuggling case that killed 7

paras.en: Nov. 10 (UPI) -- Federal prosecutors have charged three more people and expanded charges against 11 others in a human-smuggling case involving the deaths of seven migrants last spring, six of whom were found dead in a shipping container on a train in Texas.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日（UPI）——去年春天，联邦检察官在一起人口走私案件中对另外 3 人提出指控，并扩大了对另外 11 人的指控，该案件涉及 7 名移民的死亡，其中 6 人被发现死在德克萨斯州一列火车的集装箱内。

paras.en: The superseding indictment announced Monday charges people prosecutors say are in the country illegally, three other non-U.S. citizens and four U.S. citizens for their alleged roles in a conspiracy to smuggle migrants into the United States for profit.
paras.zh: 周一公布的替代起诉书指控检察官称非法居留美国的人、另外三名非美国公民和四名美国公民，涉嫌串谋将移民偷运到美国以获取利润。

paras.en: According to court documents, the defendants are alleged to have run a human-smuggling operation from at least April 2023 through May 12, when authorities in Del Rio arrested Mayra Alejandra Huerta and two days after the seven victims were discovered.
paras.zh: 根据法庭文件，被告被指控至少在 2023 年 4 月至 5 月 12 日期间从事人口走私活动，当时德尔里奥当局逮捕了 Mayra Alejandra Huerta，七名受害者被发现两天后。

paras.en: "By allegedly orchestrating this deadly human smuggling scheme, these defendants showed no regard for the value of human life and put people in harm's way to pad their own pockets," Assistant Attorney General A. Tysen Duva of the Justice Department's Criminal Division said Monday in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国司法部刑事司助理总检察长 A. 泰森·杜瓦 (A. Tysen Duva) 周一在一份声明中表示，“这些被告据称策划了这一致命的人口走私计划，他们不顾人类生命的价值，为了中饱私囊而将人们置于危险之中。”

paras.en: Prosecutors allege that the migrants or their families paid smugglers between $1,500 and $10,000 each to bring them into the United States.
paras.zh: 检察官称，这些移民或其家人向走私者支付了每人 1,500 至 10,000 美元的费用，以便将他们带入美国。

paras.en: The organization is accused of using multiple smugglers who worked in concert with other smuggler groups to use each other's routes, guides, stash houses and drivers.
paras.zh: 该组织被指控利用多名走私者，这些走私者与其他走私团伙合作，利用彼此的路线、向导、藏匿处和司机。

paras.en: Once the migrants were in the United States, the smugglers allegedly loaded them into shipping containers to transport them further into the U.S. interior.
paras.zh: 据称，一旦移民到达美国，走私者就会将他们装入集装箱，以便将他们进一步运送到美国内陆地区。

paras.en: In February, the defendants began arranging to smuggle at least seven migrants, including a 14-year-old Honduran, into Del Rio, Texas.
paras.zh: 今年 2 月，被告开始安排将至少 7 名移民（其中包括一名 14 岁的洪都拉斯人）偷运到德克萨斯州德尔里奥市。

paras.en: After bringing the seven migrants illegally into the United States from Mexico, the smugglers transported them to an area near the Union Pacific train tracks in Del Rio, where, at about 1:20 p.m. local time on May 9, they used red bolt cutters to allegedly cut the lock off a stationary shipping container's door, loaded the migrants inside and then closed the door.
paras.zh: 走私者将这七名移民从墨西哥非法带入美国后，将他们运送到德尔里奥联合太平洋铁路附近的一个地区，下午 1 点 20 分左右，他们在该地区被偷运。当地时间5月9日，他们据称使用红色断线钳剪断了一个固定集装箱的门锁，将移民装进里面，然后关上了门。

paras.en: Stacked on top of another container and without ventilation or a cooling system, the migrants were trapped inside as outside temperatures reached 92 degrees Fahrenheit.
paras.zh: 这些移民堆放在另一个集装箱的顶部，没有通风或冷却系统，当室外温度达到 92 华氏度时，移民被困在里面。

paras.en: The train carrying the shipping container arrived in San Antonio, where smugglers opened the door to find the migrants in "peril," the Justice Department said, adding that the smugglers fled the scene, leaving one migrant deceased near the railroad tracks.
paras.zh: 司法部表示，载着集装箱的火车抵达圣安东尼奥，走私者打开车门，发现移民处于“危险”之中，并补充说，走私者逃离了现场，导致一名移民死在铁轨附近。

paras.en: The train then departed the next day for Laredo, where on May 10 a worker at the Union Pacific Rail Yard noticed a leg sticking out from a shipping container.
paras.zh: 火车第二天出发前往拉雷多，5 月 10 日，联合太平洋铁路站的一名工人注意到一条腿从集装箱中伸出。

paras.en: An inspection of the shipping container revealed the six bodies.
paras.zh: 对集装箱的检查发现了六具尸体。

paras.en: The victims were identified as four Mexican nationals and three Honduran nationals, including a 14-year-old child.
paras.zh: 受害者被确认为 4 名墨西哥国民和 3 名洪都拉斯国民，其中包括一名 14 岁的儿童。

paras.en: The three newly charged defendants are Juan Alvaro Membreno-Contreras, 40, Yuri Julissa Cuaresma Paredes, 34, and Mavis Aleyda Escalante Peraza, 38, all from Honduras.
paras.zh: 新指控的三名被告分别是 40 岁的胡安·阿尔瓦罗·门布雷诺-孔特雷拉斯 (Juan Alvaro Membreno-Contreras)、34 岁的尤里·朱利莎·夸雷斯马·帕雷德斯 (Yuri Julissa Cuaresma Paredes) 和 38 岁的梅维斯·阿莱达·埃斯卡兰特·佩拉萨 (Mavis Aleyda Escalante Peraza)，均来自洪都拉斯。

paras.en: According to prosecutors, seven of the 14 defendants are in the United States illegally.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，14 名被告中有 7 人非法居留美国。

paras.en: The superseding indictment charges 12 of the defendants with offenses related to the deaths of the seven migrants, including conspiracy and aiding and abetting their transportation. If convicted, they could face life in prison.
paras.zh: 替代起诉书指控 12 名被告犯有与 7 名移民死亡相关的罪行，包括共谋以及协助和教唆他们的运输。如果罪名成立，他们可能面临终身监禁。

paras.en: Eleven of the defendants also face seven counts of helping bring migrants into the United States illegally. Conviction on at least three counts carries a minimum sentence of five years in prison and a maximum of 15 years.
paras.zh: 其中 11 名被告还面临七项帮助非法移民进入美国的罪名。至少三项罪名成立，可判处最低 5 年监禁、最高 15 年监禁。

paras.en: Twelve of the defendants were also charged with conspiracy to bring migrants to the country in a manner that caused serious injury and endangered lives, while 11 face charges of conspiracy to commit money laundering. Both offenses carry maximum sentences of 20 years in prison.
paras.zh: 其中 12 名被告还被指控串谋以造成严重伤害和危及生命的方式将移民带入该国，另有 11 人面临串谋洗钱的指控。这两项罪行最高可判处 20 年监禁。

articles.title: Latin Grammys 2026 Special Awards: Best Quotes From Lila Downs, Chichí Peralta & More Honorees
articles.author: Sigal Ratner-Arias

paras.en: The Latin Recording Academy celebrated Monday afternoon (Nov. 9) the contributions of six outstanding performers who have left their mark in Latin music throughout their fruitful careers.
paras.zh: 周一下午（11 月 9 日），拉丁唱片学院庆祝了六位杰出表演者的贡献，他们在其卓有成效的职业生涯中在拉丁音乐中留下了印记。

paras.en: Spanish-Mexican singer Alaska, Cuban-Mexican musician Francisco Céspedes, Mexican singer-songwriter Lila Downs, Brazilian artist Daniela Mercury and Dominican singer-songwriter Chichí Peralta received Lifetime Achievement Awards for their creative contributions of outstanding artistic value to Latin music. Meanwhile, Panamanian hitmaker Omar Alfanno received the Trustees Award, which recognizes individuals who have made significant contributions to Latin music, not necessarily through performance.
paras.zh: 西班牙裔墨西哥歌手阿拉斯加、古巴裔墨西哥音乐家弗朗西斯科·塞斯佩德斯、墨西哥歌手兼作曲家莉拉·唐斯、巴西艺术家丹妮拉·墨丘利和多米尼加歌手兼作曲家奇奇·佩拉尔塔因其对拉丁音乐杰出艺术价值的创造性贡献而获得终身成就奖。与此同时，巴拿马热门音乐制作人奥马尔·阿尔凡诺 (Omar Alfanno) 获得了受托人奖，该奖项旨在表彰对拉丁音乐做出重大贡献（不一定是通过表演）的个人。

paras.en: “Today, we pay tribute to a group of extraordinary artists, timeless artists with their work, their great talent and their legacy, who have left an indelible mark on our culture,” said Manuel Abud, CEO of the Latin Recording Academy, as he opened the ceremony in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: “今天，我们向一群杰出的艺术家、永恒的艺术家致敬，他们的作品、伟大的才华和遗产，在我们的文化中留下了不可磨灭的印记，”拉丁唱片学院首席执行官曼努埃尔·阿布德在拉斯维加斯举行的颁奖典礼开幕式上说道。

paras.en: The event was hosted by Dominican merengue singer Milly Quezada and featured Erika Ender as one of the presenters. It preceded the 2026 Latin Grammy Awards gala, which will take place on Thursday (Nov. 12) at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas and will be broadcast live on Univision at 8 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 该活动由多米尼加梅伦格歌手 Milly Quezada 主持，Erika Ender 担任主持人之一。这场颁奖典礼先于 2026 年拉丁格莱美颁奖典礼，该颁奖典礼将于周四（11 月 12 日）在拉斯维加斯米高梅花园球馆举行，并于晚上 8 点在 Univision 上进行现场直播。等。

paras.en: Below are the best quotes from the honorees as they received their Special Awards:
paras.zh: 以下是获奖者在获得特别奖时的最佳引言：

paras.en: Alaska, on being an artist full of contradictions: “I understand that I am a rare artist, difficult to classify, with one foot in the mainstream and the other in the underground, who knows what it’s like to have a No. 1 hit and what it’s like to release her own albums, and who has one foot in America [despite being Spanish], because I was born in Mexico.”
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加谈到自己是一位充满矛盾的艺术家时说：“我知道我是一位罕见的艺术家，很难归类，一只脚踩在主流，另一只脚踩在地下，谁知道成为冠军是什么感觉，发行自己的专辑是什么感觉，而且一只脚踩在美国（尽管是西班牙人），因为我出生在墨西哥。”

paras.en: Omar Alfanno, on the importance of songwriters: “Songwriters are the fuel of this industry. There is no singer without a songwriter. That’s why I ask you to create songs that endure, not just ones that are hits.”
paras.zh: 奥马尔·阿尔凡诺 (Omar Alfanno) 在谈到词曲作者的重要性时表示：“词曲作者是这个行业的燃料。没有词曲作者就没有歌手。这就是为什么我要求你们创作经久不衰的歌曲，而不仅仅是热门歌曲。”

paras.en: Francisco Céspedes, on the ultimate purpose of his music: “If you ever had a romantic or intimate moment while listening to my songs, that was my goal.”
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯科·塞斯佩德斯 (Francisco Céspedes) 谈到他音乐的最终目的时说：“如果你在听我的歌曲时曾有过浪漫或亲密的时刻，那就是我的目标。”

paras.en: Lila Downs, with tears and a trembling voice, on fulfilling her childhood dream: “Today, as I receive this recognition, I think of that 6-year-old girl who sang in the mountains of Oaxaca and I want to tell her: ‘Yes, it was worth dreaming.’ Thank you, Oaxaca, for giving me roots. Thank you, Mexico, for giving me identity, strength and so many stories to sing.”
paras.zh: 莉拉·唐斯 (Lila Downs) 泪流满面，声音颤抖地谈及儿时梦想的实现：“今天，当我获得这一认可时，我想起了那个在瓦哈卡山区唱歌的 6 岁女孩，我想告诉她：‘是的，这是值得梦想的。’谢谢瓦哈卡给了我根。谢谢墨西哥，给了我身份、力量和这么多可以唱的故事。”

paras.en: Daniela Mercury, on making inclusive music: “We sing for our people, to see our people dance, celebrate and love each other… My music stands against discrimination and in favor of joy and the rights of the LGBT community. Long live freedom and democracy. No more authoritarianism.”
paras.zh: Daniela Mercury 在谈到制作包容性音乐时表示：“我们为我们的人民歌唱，看到我们的人民跳舞、庆祝和彼此相爱……我的音乐反对歧视，支持 LGBT 群体的欢乐和权利。自由和民主万岁。不再有独裁主义。”

paras.en: Chichí Peralta, on the human essence of creativity: “Sometimes you have to try, fail and start over, and maybe that’s the most beautiful part of creating: discovering that there’s always another possibility. But creativity isn’t just about producing something that previously only existed in our imagination. And that capacity to feel, imagine and transform our experiences into art is profoundly human. No technology will ever replace its essence.”
paras.zh: Chichi Peralta 在谈到创造力的人类本质时说道：“有时你必须尝试、失败并重新开始，也许这就是创造中最美丽的部分：发现总是存在另一种可能性。但创造力不仅仅是创造出以前只存在于我们想象中的东西。感受、想象并将我们的经验转化为艺术的能力是人类的本质。任何技术都无法取代其本质。”

articles.title: Nick Cannon Reflects on Eminem Feud After He Dissed Mariah Carey: ‘You Can’t Come at My Woman & Not Expect to Get This Work’
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Nick Cannon joined the On Par With Maury Povich podcast on Monday (Nov. 9), where he reflected on his feud with Eminem, which was sparked by Slim Shady dissing Cannon’s ex-wife, Mariah Carey, in 2009.
paras.zh: 尼克·坎农 (Nick Cannon) 于周一（11 月 9 日）加入了 On Par With Maury Povich 播客，在播客中他反思了自己与阿姆 (Eminem) 的不和，这场争执是由斯利姆·谢迪 (Slim Shady) 在 2009 年对坎农前妻玛丽亚·凯莉 (Mariah Carey) 的不满引发的。

paras.en: “He disrespected my woman, man,” Cannon told former Maury host. “You can’t come at my wife and don’t expect to get this work. I think he and Mariah had a professional relationship, which he professed to be a personal relationship.”
paras.zh: “他不尊重我的女人，伙计，”坎农告诉前莫里主持人。 “你不可能在找我妻子的时候就别指望能得到这份工作。我认为他和玛丽亚有一种职业关系，而他声称这是一种私人关系。”

paras.en: Cannon continued: “So that was way before me. So then by the time we got married, he had some harsh words because I guess he was still in his feelings. I couldn’t stand for that at the time. At the dignity of my woman, I had to fight for my relationship, my love.”
paras.zh: 坎农继续说道：“这件事就发生在我面前。所以当我们结婚时，他说了一些严厉的话，因为我猜他仍然沉浸在自己的感情中。当时我无法忍受这一点。为了我女人的尊严，我必须为我的关系、我的爱而战。”

paras.en: Cannon and Carey tied the knot in 2008. Em implied that he previously was romantically involved with the pop star on 2009’s “Bagpipes From Baghdad.” The Wild ‘N Out creator addressed Em in a since-deleted Tumblr post.
paras.zh: Cannon 和 Carey 于 2008 年喜结连理。Em 暗示，他之前曾在 2009 年的《巴格达风笛》中与这位流行歌星有过恋情。这位 Wild ‘N Out 的创作者在 Tumblr 上发表的一篇帖子中向 Em 发表了讲话，该帖子后来被删除。

paras.en: Many believe Carey’s response came with her “Obsessed” single later that year, which saw her play a man resembling Slim Shady in the top 10 Billboard Hot 100 hit’s visual. Em appeared to reply to Carey and Cannon on “The Warning” in July 2009.
paras.zh: 许多人认为凯莉的回应来自她那年晚些时候的单曲“Obsessed”，她在公告牌热门 100 热门歌曲的前 10 名中扮演了一个类似斯利姆·谢迪 (Slim Shady) 的男人。 Em 似乎在 2009 年 7 月的“警告”中回复了凯里和坎农。

paras.en: Carey and Cannon’s divorce was finalized in November 2016 and all was quiet on the feud front with Eminem — that is, until the Drumline star’s appearance on T.I.’s Expeditiously podcast, which revived the beef with the Detroit rapper. Eminem seemingly jabbed at Cannon with his verse on Fat Joe’s “Lord Above.”
paras.zh: 凯里和坎农的离婚于 2016 年 11 月敲定，与埃米纳姆之间的争执也归于平静——直到这位 Drumline 明星出现在 T.I. 的 Expeditiously 播客上，这才重新恢复了与这位底特律说唱歌手的争执。阿姆 (Eminem) 似乎用胖子乔 (Fat Joe) 的《上主》(Lord Over) 中的歌词来攻击坎农 (Cannon)。

paras.en: Cannon proceeded to unleash a trifecta of diss tracks taking aim at Eminem in December 2019: “The Invitation,” “Pray for Him” and “Canceled: Invitation,” the latter of which attempted to paint Em as a racist with old remarks.
paras.zh: 2019 年 12 月，Cannon 发布了三首针对 Eminem 的 diss 歌曲：《The Invitation》、《Pray for Him》和《Canceled: Invitation》，后者试图用陈旧的言论将 Em 描绘成种族主义者。

paras.en: Eminem didn’t dip his pen to respond on wax or in the studio, but only with a short reply on X as their feud heated up.
paras.zh: 阿姆没有用笔在蜡上或在工作室里做出回应，只是在他们的不和升温时在 X 上做了简短的回应。

paras.en: Cannon spoke about beefing with Em during an interview with Billboard in April 2020. “I was defending myself once again. He keeps bringing it up for decades,” he said. “I’m one of those cats that matches energy. I don’t do it — I overdo it. Even in high school, I was a little guy, but if you made fun of me, I was gonna make fun of you, your momma, and that’s the same energy of Wild ‘N Out.
paras.zh: 坎农在 2020 年 4 月接受 Billboard 采访时谈到了对埃姆的不满。“我再次为自己辩护。几十年来他一直在提起这件事，”他说。 “我是那些与能量相匹配的猫之一。我不这样做——我做得太过分了。即使在高中，我也是一个小家伙，但如果你取笑我，我也会取笑你，你的妈妈，这也是《Wild ‘N Out》的能量。

paras.en: The multi-hyphenate entertainer added: “It was a month of social commentary, but if you’ve ever heard me speak on this matter, I always give that dude his props as an icon in hip-hop. I think he knows better now. If he keeps talking about me, I’m gonna keep talking back.”
paras.zh: 这位多联艺人补充道：“这是一个月的社会评论，但如果你听过我谈论过这件事，我总是把他作为嘻哈偶像的道具。我认为他现在更了解了。如果他继续谈论我，我会继续回嘴。”

paras.en: Watch the full interview with Nick Cannon below. Talk about his feud with Eminem takes place around the eight-minute mark.
paras.zh: 请观看下面对尼克·卡农的完整采访。谈论他与埃米纳姆的不和发生在八分钟左右。

articles.title: Fatboy Slim, PNAU Lead Sydney Mardi Gras Party 2027 Lineup
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Fatboy Slim and PNAU will lead Australia’s 2027 Mardi Gras Party as the Sydney event moves into a new underground home beneath Allianz Stadium.
paras.zh: Fatboy Slim 和 PNAU 将领导澳大利亚 2027 年狂欢节派对，悉尼活动将移至安联体育场下方的新地下场地。

paras.en: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras announced Tuesday (Nov. 10) that Fatboy Slim, PNAU, ELKKA and Griffin Maxwell Brooks will headline the March 6 event, which will run from 10 p.m. until 6 a.m.
paras.zh: 悉尼同性恋狂欢节于周二（11 月 10 日）宣布，Fatboy Slim、PNAU、ELKKA 和 Griffin Maxwell Brooks 将成为 3 月 6 日活动的主角，该活动将于晚上 10 点至晚上 10 点举行。直到早上 6 点

paras.en: For the first time, the tunnels underneath Allianz Stadium will be transformed into a dance venue, with three stages, multiple dancefloors and hidden spaces spread throughout the site.
paras.zh: 安联体育场下方的隧道将首次转变为舞蹈场地，拥有三个舞台、多个舞池和遍布整个场地的隐藏空间。

paras.en: The location sits at the end of the Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade route, creating a direct transition from the parade into the official after-party.
paras.zh: 该地点位于悉尼同性恋狂欢节游行路线的尽头，实现了从游行到官方余兴派对的直接过渡。

paras.en: Fatboy Slim will lead the main room, while Australian electronic act PNAU will perform a DJ set.
paras.zh: Fatboy Slim 将主持主厅，而澳大利亚电子乐队 PNAU 将表演 DJ 表演。

paras.en: The lineup also includes Cat & Calmell, who will perform a DJ set, D. Tiffany, dameeeela, Jaguar, MikeQ, Kito, Stereogamous, Merve, Samantha Togni, Bitter Babe, Woody Cook and more.
paras.zh: 阵容还包括将进行 DJ 表演的 Cat & Calmell、D. Tiffany、dameeeela、Jaguar、MikeQ、Kito、Stereogamous、Merve、Samantha Togni、Bitter Babe、Woody Cook 等。

paras.en: Woody Cook, a DJ and producer in his own right, will appear on the same bill as his father, Fatboy Slim.
paras.zh: 伍迪·库克 (Woody Cook) 本身就是一名 DJ 兼制作人，他将与他的父亲 Fatboy Slim 出现在同一账单上。

paras.en: The event is being presented by Bizarro and Kicks Entertainment, with Sydney queer nightlife institutions GiRLTHING and FLASH each curating a stage.
paras.zh: 该活动由 Bizarro 和 Kicks Entertainment 主办，悉尼酷儿夜生活机构 GiRLTHING 和 FLASH 分别策划了一个舞台。

paras.en: The Mardi Gras Midnight Community Show will also return above ground at the Allianz Stadium forecourt, featuring drag performers, dancers and other artists tied to the festival’s 2027 HYPERBLOOM theme.
paras.zh: 狂欢节午夜社区秀也将在安联体育场前院回归地面，届时将有变装表演者、舞者和其他与狂欢节 2027 年 HYPERBLOOM 主题相关的艺术家表演。

paras.en: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras CEO Jesse Matheson said the new venue was designed to connect the energy of the parade directly with the party.
paras.zh: 悉尼同性恋狂欢节首席执行官杰西·马西森 (Jesse Matheson) 表示，新场地的设计旨在将游行的能量与派对直接联系起来。

paras.en: “We’re carrying the energy of the Parade directly into the subterranean depths of Allianz Stadium for a Mardi Gras PARTY unlike any other,” Matheson said in a statement.
paras.zh: 马西森在一份声明中表示：“我们将游行的能量直接带入安联体育场的地下深处，举办一场与众不同的狂欢节派对。”

paras.en: The 2027 event follows the absence of Mardi Gras PARTY from the 2026 festival and arrives as organizers prepare for the 50th anniversary of Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras in 2028.
paras.zh: 2027 年的活动是在 2026 年狂欢节缺席狂欢节 PARTY 之后举办的，组织者正在为 2028 年悉尼同性恋狂欢节 50 周年做准备。

paras.en: The wider 2027 program will run for 24 days, from Feb. 12 through March 7. Mardi Gras members and Allianz Stadium members already have access to tickets. Public early access begins Nov. 12 at 11 a.m. AEDT, with general tickets going on sale Nov. 13 at 11 a.m. AEDT.
paras.zh: 2027 年更广泛的计划将从 2 月 12 日到 3 月 7 日持续 24 天。狂欢节会员和安联体育场会员已经可以获得门票。公众抢先体验将于 11 月 12 日上午 11 点（澳大利亚东部时间）开始，普通门票于 11 月 13 日上午 11 点（澳大利亚东部时间）开始发售。

articles.title: Inside James Gunn, Peter Safran’s DC Ouster: Exec Tensions and a Fateful David Ellison Visit
articles.author: Aaron Couch

paras.en: DC Studios heads James Gunn and Peter Safran were feeling pretty secure under the new Skydance regime.
paras.zh: DC 工作室负责人詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn) 和彼得·萨夫兰 (Peter Safran) 在新的 Skydance 政权下感到非常安全。

paras.en: After surviving a merger that claimed the jobs of celebrated Warner Bros. heads Mike De Luca and Pam Abdy, the duo were basking in the modest success of Clayface, a horror movie released Oct. 21 that passed $100 million globally on a $44 million budget. There was even talk of doing more spooky, slimmed-down DC movies.
paras.zh: 华纳兄弟著名负责人迈克·德·卢卡和帕姆·阿布迪在合并中幸存下来，之后他们正沉浸在《粘土脸》的小成功中，这部恐怖电影于 10 月 21 日上映，全球票房突破 1 亿美元，预算为 4,400 万美元。甚至有人讨论要制作更多恐怖、精简的 DC 电影。

paras.en: Gunn had also wrapped production on Man of Tomorrow, his sequel to Superman that is heading for a July 2027 release, and sources say he was in the midst of writing a third installment as part of plan to make a trilogy and release a Superman movie every two years, maybe even morphing the franchise into a Justice League teamup.
paras.zh: 冈恩还完成了他的《超人》续集《明日之人》的制作，该续集将于 2027 年 7 月上映，消息人士称，他正在编写第三部，作为制作三部曲并每两年发行一部超人电影的计划的一部分，甚至可能将该系列转变为正义联盟团队。

paras.en: Then came Friday, Nov. 6, when Skydance co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz arrived at Gunn and Safran’s offices on the Warner Bros. lot in Burbank. There, according to sources, the DC heads were told that despite previous assurances they would be part of the new Skydance mega-studio, Ellison and Kreiz had a change of plans. And now, after four years as two of the most visible faces in comic book films and TV, they were out.
paras.zh: 随后，11 月 6 日星期五，Skydance 联合首席执行官 David Ellison 和 Ynon Kreiz 抵达 Gunn 和 Safran 位于伯班克华纳兄弟地段的办公室。据消息人士透露，DC 负责人被告知，尽管之前曾保证他们将成为新的 Skydance 大型工作室的一部分，但埃里森和克雷兹改变了计划。如今，在成为漫画电影和电视中最引人注目的两张面孔四年后，他们却出局了。

paras.en: And their replacement was surprising. It wasn’t a splashy C-suiter or an exec recently ousted amid Hollywood consolidation.
paras.zh: 他们的替代者令人惊讶。他不是一位引人注目的首席高管，也不是一位最近在好莱坞整合过程中被赶下台的高管。

paras.en: It was Jeremy Latcham, a mild-mannered producer who was once a key member of Marvel Studios’ exec team before moving to Texas to go independent.
paras.zh: 他就是杰里米·拉查姆（Jeremy Latcham），一位性格温和的制片人，在搬到德克萨斯州独立之前，曾是漫威影业执行团队的关键成员。

paras.en: An occasional foray into big-budget moviemaking such as Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves notwithstanding, Latcham was focusing on inspirational movies such as the Wright Brothers feature Flyer, for the faith-focused studio Wonder Project, where he also helped make House of David, a TV show about the Biblical figure. The producer is known to be vocal about his Christian faith and his desire to make uplifting projects.
paras.zh: 尽管偶尔会涉足《龙与地下城：盗贼荣耀》等大预算电影制作，拉查姆还是专注于励志电影，如莱特兄弟的故事片《飞行者》，为专注于信仰的工作室 Wonder Project 制作，他还帮助制作了一部关于圣经人物的电视节目《大卫之家》。众所周知，这位制片人直言不讳地表达了他的基督教信仰和制作令人振奋的项目的愿望。

paras.en: “I had this nagging feeling that I needed to do more movies that had deeper meaning to me,” Latcham said of Wonder Project during an appearance on the Bible Bros podcast while promoting the Nate Bargatze comedy The Breadwinner. “Let’s be the HBO for the faith and family audience. Let’s try to make movies and television shows that restore faith in things worth believing in.”
paras.zh: “我有一种挥之不去的感觉，我需要拍更多对我来说更有意义的电影，”拉查姆在《圣经兄弟》播客上宣传内特·巴盖兹的喜剧《养家糊口的人》时，谈到《奇迹计划》时说道。 “让我们成为信仰和家庭观众的 HBO。让我们尝试制作电影和电视节目，以恢复人们对值得相信的事物的信心。”

paras.en: In a twist, Latcham was instrumental in Gunn’s rise, advocating for the niche director’s hiring on Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy, which turned Gunn into an A-list filmmaker who commands 8-figure paydays for his directing work.
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，拉查姆在冈恩的崛起中发挥了重要作用，他主张在漫威影业的《银河护卫队》中聘用这位小众导演，这使得冈恩成为了一位一线电影制片人，他的导演作品片酬高达八位数。

paras.en: One insider indicated the exec shuffle had been in the works since early fall and had been precipitated by a reachout to Latcham from Josh Greenstein, who co-chairs the Skydance Motion Picture Group with Dana Goldberg. The two first worked together nearly 20 years ago when Latcham was a rising Marvel exec and Greenstein was in the marketing department at Paramount, the studio that released Iron Man and Iron Man 2. They teamed again when Greenstein was at Sony and made Spider-Man: Homecoming with Marvel.
paras.zh: 一位内部人士表示，高管洗牌从初秋就开始了，乔什·格林斯坦 (Josh Greenstein) 与达纳·戈德堡 (Dana Goldberg) 共同担任 Skydance 电影集团联合主席，与拉查姆的接触促成了此次高管洗牌。两人第一次合作是在近 20 年前，当时拉查姆还是漫威的一位冉冉升起的高管，而格林斯坦则在派拉蒙电影公司的营销部门工作，该工作室曾发行《钢铁侠》和《钢铁侠 2》。当格林斯坦在索尼时，他们再次合作，并与漫威合作制作了《蜘蛛侠：英雄归来》。

paras.en: Sources point to several points of tension between DC’s Gunn and Safran and Skydance’s Greenstein and Goldberg. Before Skydance’s acquisition, Gunn and Safran reported directly to Warner Bros. CEO David Zaslav; their contracts stipulated they would maintain that kind of direct reporting structure in the event of a change of leadership, in this case Ellison. That set up a chafing with Greenstein and Goldberg, who are trying to consolidate all production of motion pictures under their leadership. Gunn and Safran, meanwhile, were accustomed to having strong control over every aspect of the rollout of DC products.
paras.zh: 消息来源指出了 DC 的 Gunn 和 Safran 以及 Skydance 的 Greenstein 和 Goldberg 之间的几个紧张点。在 Skydance 被收购之前，Gunn 和 Safran 直接向华纳兄弟首席执行官 David Zaslav 汇报；他们的合同规定，如果领导层（在本例中是埃里森）发生变动，他们将维持这种直接报告结构。这引起了格林斯坦和戈德堡的不满，他们正试图将所有电影制作整合到他们的领导下。与此同时，Gunn 和 Safran 习惯于对 DC 产品推出的各个方面进行强有力的控制。

paras.en: “They had the final word on movies, TV shows, and animation,” says one insider. They were not about to get layered in the reporting structure, multiple sources add.
paras.zh: “他们对电影、电视剧和动画拥有最终决定权，”一位内部人士表示。多个消息来源补充说，他们不打算在报告结构中分层。

paras.en: Another point of tension: sources say the DC heads were not forthcoming or were slow in sharing plans, slate details and footage with the Skydance movie heads. In the end, Greenstein and Goldberg prevailed and new hire Latcham will report to them.
paras.zh: 另一个紧张点是：消息人士称，DC 负责人没有及时与 Skydance 电影负责人分享计划、具体细节和镜头。最终，格林斯坦和戈德堡获胜，新员工拉查姆将向他们汇报。

paras.en: Another insider is more blunt in the assessment. Ellison never wanted DC to report directly to him in the first place and did not have time for studio politics, such as posturing between division heads.
paras.zh: 另一位内部人士的评价则更为直率。埃里森从一开始就不想让 DC 直接向他汇报，也没有时间参与工作室政治，比如在部门负责人之间摆架子。

paras.en: And then there was the matter of DC’s financials. The movies released were not great for business, while Supergirl was just a disaster, in the eyes of the new regime. Even Superman, which grossed $618 million worldwide and was profitable, did not net out, or have the kind of pop culture impact, in the way that kind of movie should, Skydance‘s thinking went.
paras.zh: 然后是 DC 的财务问题。上映的电影对商业不利，而《女超人》在新政权眼中只是一场灾难。 Skydance 认为，即使是全球票房 6.18 亿美元并实现盈利的《超人》也没有像这类电影那样产生净收益或产生流行文化影响。

paras.en: Latcham’s rise to the top of DC Studios began 22 years ago, during a very different era for superhero movies. In 2004, he was working as an assistant at Endeavor when exec David Maisel left to lead Marvel Studios as president and hired him as his assistant at the upstart studio. Latcham is said have been surprised and underwhelmed when he showed up to Marvel’s modest Santa Monica Blvd. offices to discover it wasn’t yet a real a studio, but rather an outfit for giving script notes to Hollywood studios making licensed movies based on Marvel characters.
paras.zh: 拉查姆在 DC 工作室的崛起始于 22 年前，当时的超级英雄电影正处于一个截然不同的时代。 2004 年，他在 Endeavour 担任助理，当时执行官大卫·梅塞尔 (David Maisel) 离职，担任漫威影业总裁，并聘请他作为这家新贵工作室的助理。据说，当拉查姆出现在漫威低调的圣莫尼卡大道时，他感到惊讶和不知所措。办公室发现它还不是一个真正的工作室，而是一个为好莱坞工作室提供剧本说明的机构，这些工作室制作基于漫威角色的授权电影。

paras.en: But a year and a half later, Maisel orchestarted a deal for Marvel to finance its own movies, starting with Iron Man. As Latcham shot through the ranks at Marvel, moving on to become Kevin Feige’s assistant and then his right-hand man, he was known for musing aloud about if his grandparents would like their movies. In other words, he asked, “Would this movie resonate with everyday people beyond Hollywood?” while walking the thin line in servicing what superfans would love.
paras.zh: 但一年半后，梅塞尔与漫威达成了一项协议，为自己的电影提供资金，从《钢铁侠》开始。随着拉彻姆在漫威的晋升，成为凯文·费奇的助手，然后是他的得力助手，他以大声思考他的祖父母是否会喜欢他们的电影而闻名。换句话说，他问道：“这部电影会引起好莱坞以外的普通人的共鸣吗？”同时在为超级粉丝所喜爱的服务中走细​​线。

paras.en: Sources affectionately describe Latcham as a down the middle shooter whose goal is to make hits for the masses and get people into movie theaters. If Gunn was the guy to deliver f-bombs and lesser known characters, Latcham is the guy to deliver what’s more in line with Ellison’s broader tastes, say multiple sources.
paras.zh: 有消息人士亲切地将拉查姆描述为一名中庸之徒，他的目标是为大众制作热门影片并吸引人们进入电影院。多个消息来源称，如果说冈恩是那个提供脏话和鲜为人知的角色的人，那么拉查姆就是那个提供更符合埃里森更广泛品味的人。

paras.en: Known as a family man who doesn’t care about the trappings of Hollywood, Latcham is expected to split time between Los Angeles and his home in Texas, where he lives with his wife and daughter, as well as his parents, who live on their property. He is not the kind of producer who has extensive relationships with agents, which may be detriment or benefit, depending on who you talk to. He is expected to be very hands on producer who likes to spend time on sets.
paras.zh: 拉查姆被认为是一个不关心好莱坞的顾家男人，预计他会在洛杉矶和德克萨斯州的家之间往返，他与妻子和女儿以及住在他们的房产上的父母住在一起。他不是那种与经纪人有广泛关系的制片人，这可能是有害的，也可能是有益的，取决于你与谁交谈。人们预计他会非常关心喜欢花时间在片场的制片人。

paras.en: Gunn and Safran will still have direct links to the studio, just less control. Safran is a prolific producer with a long relationship with Warner Bros. through The Conjuring movies, a franchise that is still very active.
paras.zh: 冈恩和赛峰集团仍将与工作室有直接联系，只是控制权较少。赛峰是一位多产的制片人，通过《招魂》电影与华纳兄弟建立了长期合作关系，该系列电影至今仍非常活跃。

paras.en: As for Gunn, those close to him note he’s somewhat relieved to go fully back to the creative side of the business.
