In an Instagram post on Monday, he wrote that executive life and the studio politics that surrounded it wasn’t always for him: “I will miss the people around me, and I will miss being the co-caretaker of these great characters, but I’m also incredibly relieved and excited to get back to pure filmmaking.”
paras.zh: 至于冈恩，与他关系密切的人指出，他对完全回归业务的创意方面感到有些欣慰。在周一的 Instagram 帖子中，他写道，高管生活和围绕它的工作室政治并不总是适合他：“我会想念周围的人，我会怀念成为这些伟大角色的共同照顾者，但我也对回到纯粹的电影制作感到无比的欣慰和兴奋。”

paras.en: Latcham is currently untangling himself from projects he was producing, including the big budget movie Naruto for Lionsgate and Sony.
paras.zh: 拉查姆目前正在摆脱他正在制作的项目，包括狮门影业和索尼的大预算电影《火影忍者》。

paras.en: By the time the news went public, Latcham and Gunn had not spoken about the DC transition, but were planning to speak by phone on Monday afternoon, according to sources.
paras.zh: 据消息人士透露，当消息公开时，拉查姆和冈恩尚未谈论华盛顿特区的过渡，但计划在周一下午通过电话进行交谈。

paras.en: It is unclear if Gunn will get the chance to finish any of his vision for Superman, let alone the DC slate he and Safran announced with great fanfare in 2022 — a slate that was just barely revving up in the eyes of some.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚冈恩是否有机会完成他对超人的任何愿景，更不用说他和赛峰在 2022 年大张旗鼓地宣布的 DC 计划了——这个计划在一些人看来只是刚刚起步。

paras.en: For DC fans, Monday’s tumult was another reminder how the franchise cannot catch a break in the 21st century. At this stage, the only movies on the horizon are Man of Tomorrow and The Batman Part II, which recently saw Steven Soderbergh step behind the camera to help Matt Reeves.
paras.zh: 对于 DC 粉丝来说，周一的骚乱再次提醒人们，这支球队在 21 世纪如何无法休息。在这个阶段，唯一即将上映的电影是《明日之人》和《蝙蝠侠2》，最近史蒂文·索德伯格站在镜头后面帮助马特·里夫斯。

paras.en: Whether or not fans will continue to invest in movies and actors before the rug is pulled out yet again is a real concern, said one source with knowledge of DC’s inner workings.
paras.zh: 一位了解 DC 内部运作的消息人士表示，在再次被撤下之前，粉丝们是否会继续投资电影和演员，这是一个真正令人担忧的问题。

articles.title: The Top 23 Holiday Gifts for Movie Lovers, From Retro Collectibles to Modern Tech
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Movies and the holidays have always made a good pairing. Whether it’s festive film marathons or cozy nights revisiting cult classics, there’s no shortage of reasons to make cinema part of the celebrations. It’s also a great time to surprise the film enthusiasts in your life with something that speaks to their love of the big screen.
paras.zh: 电影和假期总是很好的搭配。无论是节日电影马拉松还是重温邪教经典的舒适夜晚，都不乏让电影院成为庆祝活动的一部分的理由。这也是一个很好的时机，可以用一些表达他们对大银幕热爱的东西给你生活中的电影爱好者带来惊喜。

paras.en: Whether you’re shopping for a casual moviegoer or a devoted cineaste, this gift guide gathers finds across every budget and interest. From puzzles, artwork and collectibles to home entertainment tech, novelty games and practical movie-night essentials, these gifts range from $12 to well over $500.
paras.zh: 无论您是为休闲电影观众还是忠实电影迷购物，这本礼品指南都会收集各种预算和兴趣的礼物。从拼图、艺术品和收藏品到家庭娱乐技术、新奇游戏和实用的电影之夜必需品，这些礼物的价格从 12 美元到超过 500 美元不等。

paras.en: For the movie enthusiast who never knows what to watch next, this fill-in poster offers 1,500 cinematic recommendations spanning an impressive range of genres. From timeless romances to crime thrillers and unexpected horror favorites, it doubles as wall art and an interactive movie-watching challenge.
paras.zh: 对于永远不知道接下来要看什么的电影爱好者来说，这张填充海报提供了 1,500 部电影推荐，涵盖各种令人印象深刻的类型。从永恒的浪漫故事到犯罪惊悚片和意想不到的恐怖片，它既可以作为墙壁艺术，也可以作为互动电影观看挑战。

paras.en: Give their movie-night setup a nostalgic upgrade with this vintage-inspired popcorn bowl exclusively from Williams Sonoma. Its hand-painted design recreates the charm of a classic theater popcorn bucket while offering the durability of scratch-resistant earthenware.
paras.zh: 使用 Williams Sonoma 独家推出的这款复古风格的爆米花碗，为他们的电影之夜布置带来怀旧升级。其手绘设计再现了经典剧院爆米花桶的魅力，同时提供了防刮陶器的耐用性。

paras.en: Few directors have shaped modern cinema quite like Martin Scorsese. This beautifully presented retrospective book examines 26 feature films alongside his documentary work through insightful commentary and more than 200 photographs. Available in gray or black, it can also be personalized with engraving and gold or silver foil detailing.
paras.zh: 很少有导演能像马丁·斯科塞斯那样塑造现代电影。这本精美的回顾性书籍通过富有洞察力的评论和 200 多张照片回顾了 26 部故事片以及他的纪录片作品。有灰色或黑色可供选择，还可以通过雕刻和金箔或银箔细节进行个性化设计。

paras.en: Bring a little Hollywood history into someone’s home with this photograph of the iconic Hollywood Sign, captured from the streets of Los Angeles on Dec. 28, 1979. Available as a high-quality unframed print or with a black or white frame, prices range from $199 to $999 depending on size and presentation.
paras.zh: 这张 1979 年 12 月 28 日在洛杉矶街头拍摄的标志性好莱坞标志照片将好莱坞的一点历史带入某人的家中。可提供高品质无框印刷品或黑白框，价格从 199 美元到 999 美元不等，具体取决于尺寸和外观。

paras.en: Every film deserves a rating, especially when the viewer has plenty of opinions to share. This movie-themed journal includes 200 pages of structured review templates for recording genres, performances, cinematography and more.
paras.zh: 每部电影都值得评级，尤其是当观众有很多意见可以分享时。这本电影主题期刊包含 200 页结构化评论模板，用于记录类型、表演、电影摄影等。

paras.en: This Panasonic model offers Hi-Fi stereo playback, broadcast reception and a universal remote. With more collectors rediscovering physical tapes, having a dependable player is a welcome addition to any vintage home entertainment setup.
paras.zh: 这款松下型号提供高保真立体声播放、广播接收和通用遥控器。随着越来越多的收藏家重新发现实体磁带，拥有一台可靠的播放器对于任何老式家庭娱乐设置来说都是一个受欢迎的补充。

paras.en: This compact Sony player handles both DVD and CD playback while supporting additional media features. With over 500 Amazon purchases in the past month alone, physical media is clearly having a major comeback.
paras.zh: 这款紧凑型索尼播放器可处理 DVD 和 CD 播放，同时支持其他媒体功能。仅过去一个月，亚马逊的购买量就超过 500 笔，实体媒体显然正在卷土重来。

paras.en: With physical media making waves again among collectors, a growing movie collection needs somewhere to live. This three-pack storage set accommodates up to 84 DVD cases and also allows for Blu-ray discs, CDs, video games and VHS tapes.
paras.zh: 随着实体媒体再次在收藏家中掀起波澜，越来越多的电影收藏需要有地方存放。这款三件套存储套装最多可容纳 84 个 DVD 盒，还可以存放蓝光光盘、CD、视频游戏和 VHS 磁带。

paras.en: We would be remiss to overlook entertainment newspapers from the past in a gift guide for movie lovers.
paras.zh: 如果我们在电影爱好者的礼物指南中忽视过去的娱乐报纸，那就太失职了。

paras.en: This eBay listing features six original Hollywood Reporter newspapers from 1996 and 1997, offering an intriguing snapshot of the entertainment industry at the time. Explore other sellers, too, for archival publications documenting Hollywood’s biggest moments.
paras.zh: eBay 上列出了 1996 年和 1997 年六份原创的《好莱坞报道》报纸，提供了当时娱乐业的有趣快照。还可以探索其他卖家，寻找记录好莱坞最重要时刻的档案出版物。

paras.en: 50-Inch Art Mode Samsung Vision AI Smart TV
paras.zh: 50英寸艺术模式三星视觉AI智能电视

paras.en: Samsung’s Frame TV is designed to look like framed artwork, with customizable bezels and a matte display that gives digital images the appearance of a physical piece of art.
paras.zh: 三星的 Frame TV 的设计看起来像镶框艺术品，具有可定制的边框和哑光显示屏，使数字图像具有实体艺术品的外观。

paras.en: When not in use as a TV, Samsung’s Frame displays artwork through Art Mode, with access to the Art Store along with loads of free content. It also offers over 2,700 free channels, including 400-plus Samsung TV Plus channels, covering everything from news and sport to films and entertainment.
paras.zh: 当不用作电视时，三星的 Frame 通过艺术模式显示艺术品，可以访问艺术商店以及大量免费内容。它还提供 2,700 多个免费频道，其中包括 400 多个 Samsung TV Plus 频道，涵盖从新闻和体育到电影和娱乐的所有内容。

paras.en: Take the guesswork out of choosing the evening’s entertainment with this collection of 50 movie scratch-off cards. Each features a hint and a hand-drawn illustration inspired by an iconic film scene. Once scratched, the selection becomes the evening’s viewing assignment, turning an ordinary movie night into something more interactive.
paras.zh: 有了这组 50 张电影刮刮卡，您就可以不用再凭猜测来选择当晚的娱乐节目了。每个都有一个提示和一个手绘插图，其灵感来自于标志性的电影场景。一旦刮擦，选择就成为当晚的观看任务，将普通的电影之夜变成更具互动性的东西。

paras.en: Part movie checklist and part personal scrapbook, this scratch-off movie journal encourages recipients to work through 100 recommended films across different genres. Bound together in an aesthetic keepsake, the book also has space for rating each film as well as a section for notes and memorabilia.
paras.zh: 这本刮刮电影日记一半是电影清单，一半是个人剪贴簿，鼓励收件人浏览 100 部不同类型的推荐电影。这本书以美学纪念品的形式装订在一起，还留有对每部电影进行评级的空间以及笔记和纪念品的部分。

paras.en: Blockbuster Movies of the ’60s 1000-Piece Puzzle
paras.zh: 60 年代的卖座电影 1000 块拼图

paras.en: Classic cinema enthusiasts can revisit Hollywood’s golden moments with this 1960s film puzzle. Featuring a colorful collage of vintage movie poster artwork, this 1,000-piece challenge makes an entertaining activity over the holidays and includes a reference poster for guidance.
paras.zh: 经典电影爱好者可以通过这款 20 世纪 60 年代的电影拼图重温好莱坞的黄金时刻。这项包含 1,000 块作品的挑战以复古电影海报艺术品的彩色拼贴为特色，在假期中成为一项有趣的活动，并包含一张参考海报作为指导。

paras.en: XGIMI Elfin Flip Plus Portable Full HD Smart Projector
paras.zh: 极米Elfin Flip Plus便携式全高清智能投影仪

paras.en: With its stylish design, this portable smart projector looks just as good on display as it does in use. It features Google TV with licensed Netflix, 500 ISO lumens and projection sizes up to 200 inches. Its compact, book-sized design and integrated 150-degree rotating stand make it easy to move and position around the home.
paras.zh: 这款便携式智能投影仪设计时尚，显示效果与使用效果一样出色。它配备具有 Netflix 许可的 Google TV、500 ISO 流明和高达 200 英寸的投影尺寸。其紧凑的书本大小设计和集成的 150 度旋转支架使其可以轻松在家中移动和放置。

paras.en: The Denon Home 200 wireless speaker delivers detailed stereo sound with Dolby Atmos Music, which creates a more spacious, three-dimensional listening experience. Connect two compatible speakers for wider stereo sound or add them to a Denon home audio system for a more immersive surround sound setup. Available in black or stone gray.
paras.zh: Denon Home 200 无线扬声器通过杜比全景声 (Dolby Atmos) 音乐提供细腻的立体声，营造更宽敞的三维聆听体验。连接两个兼容扬声器以获得更宽广的立体声，或将它们添加到 Denon 家庭音响系统以获得更身临其境的环绕声设置。有黑色或石灰色可供选择。

paras.en: Luma 150 Ultra Mini Projector with Travel Case & Tripod
paras.zh: Luma 150 超迷你投影仪带旅行箱和三脚架

paras.en: A projector is always a big hit at home, but why limit movie nights to the living room? The Kodak Luma 150 makes it easy to enjoy the big-screen experience wherever you are because of its compact design that fits into a small backpack. Think camping trips, Christmas getaways in a cozy ski chalet or even a backyard cinema under the stars. We love that it only weighs 7.5 ounces and is an ultra-portable projector. It delivers vibrant visuals up to 100 inches, with versatile connectivity and rechargeable power for entertainment wherever life takes you.
paras.zh: 投影仪在家里总是很受欢迎，但为什么要把电影之夜限制在客厅呢？柯达 Luma 150 设计紧凑，可放入小背包中，让您无论身在何处都可以轻松享受大屏幕体验。想象一下露营旅行、在舒适的滑雪小屋中度过圣诞假期，甚至在星空下的后院电影院。我们喜欢它的重量仅为 7.5 盎司，是一款超便携式投影仪。它可提供高达 100 英寸的生动视觉效果，并具有多功能连接和可充电电源，让您无论生活在何处都能享受娱乐。

paras.en: Related: The 5 Best Home Projectors for Movie Buffs, From 4K to Portable Picks
paras.zh: 相关：最适合电影爱好者的 5 款家用投影仪，从 4K 到便携式选择

paras.en: Brass Monkey’s Poorly Explained Movies Party Trivia Game
paras.zh: 黄铜猴子的解释不清的电影派对问答游戏

paras.en: Movie knowledge meets hilariously questionable storytelling in this entertaining party game. Players identify familiar films from deliberately terrible descriptions, turning even the most recognizable titles into ridiculous guessing challenges. With 125 cards and competitive or casual play options for two to eight people, it’s an excellent stocking stuffer for film lovers.
paras.zh: 在这款有趣的派对游戏中，电影知识与令人捧腹的可疑故事相遇。玩家从故意可怕的描述中识别出熟悉的电影，甚至将最容易识别的标题变成了荒谬的猜测挑战。它有 125 张卡片，可供 2 至 8 人选择竞技或休闲游戏，是电影爱好者的绝佳圣诞礼物。

paras.en: Brass Monkey’s Poorly Explained Movies Y2K Edition Party Trivia Game
paras.zh: 黄铜猴子的解释不清的电影 Y2K 版派对问答游戏

paras.en: For anyone whose movie knowledge was shaped by early-2000s cinema, this nostalgic trivia edition deserves a spot under the tree. Featuring 125 hilariously misleading descriptions of Y2K-era films, it challenges players to identify familiar favorites through increasingly ridiculous clues.
paras.zh: 对于那些受 2000 年代早期电影影响的电影知识的人来说，这本怀旧问答版值得一读。它包含 125 个对千禧年电影的搞笑误导性描述，挑战玩家通过越来越荒谬的线索来识别熟悉的最爱。

paras.en: New to crochet? This Harry Potter Woobles bundle is a great place to start. With eight character kits ranging from Beginner to Beginner+ skill levels, you can learn at your own pace with step-by-step video tutorials for both righties and lefties. Each kit comes with all the materials you need, including beginner-friendly yarn and a pre-started piece to help you get stitching with confidence.
paras.zh: 钩针新手？这款《哈利·波特》Woobles 捆绑包是一个很好的起点。拥有从初级到初级+技能级别的八个角色套件，您可以按照自己的节奏通过适合右撇子和左撇子的分步视频教程进行学习。每个套件都配备了您需要的所有材料，包括适合初学者的纱线和预先开始的部件，可帮助您自信地进行缝纫。

paras.en: A nod to the era of video rental stores, this retro-inspired Blockbuster LED lightbox brings a touch of vintage film culture into the home and makes a fun decorative piece for movie lovers and anyone drawn to nostalgic pop culture design.
paras.zh: 这款复古风格的 Blockbuster LED 灯箱向视频租赁店时代致敬，将复古电影文化带入家居，为电影爱好者和任何被怀旧流行文化设计所吸引的人打造有趣的装饰品。

paras.en: This soundtrack trivia game puts their cinematic listening skills to the test with a companion app featuring thousands of hints. It includes a Bluetooth speaker, hand-painted game pieces and coasters, with customizable genres and decades for up to eight players or teams.
paras.zh: 这款配乐问答游戏通过具有数千个提示的配套应用程序来测试他们的电影听力技巧。它包括蓝牙扬声器、手绘游戏件和杯垫，可定制的游戏类型和数十年可供最多八名玩家或团队使用。

paras.en: TeeTurtle’s Reversible Clark Kent and Superman Plushie
paras.zh: TeeTurtle 的双面克拉克·肯特和超人毛绒玩具

paras.en: For fans of DC, these four-inch reversible plushies feature two characters in one — simply flip each toy to switch between the two designs. Choose from Clark Kent/Superman, Wonder Woman/Cheetah, Supergirl/Krypto and Batman/Joker. Each features embroidered details and a soft finish, making them a fun gift for DC fans of all ages.
paras.zh: 对于 DC 粉丝来说，这些 4 英寸双面毛绒玩具将两个角色合二为一 - 只需翻转每个玩具即可在两种设计之间切换。从克拉克·肯特/超人、神奇女侠/猎豹、女超人/氪星和蝙蝠侠/小丑中选择。每款均具有刺绣细节和柔软表面，是送给各年龄段 DC 粉丝的有趣礼物。

articles.title: Olivia Cooke Says ‘House of the Dragon’ Fandom Led to Her Social Media Break: “A Lot of Ugliness”
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Olivia Cooke is getting candid about one of the reasons she took a break from social media, saying there’s “a lot of ugliness” in House of the Dragon fandom.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·库克（Olivia Cooke）坦诚地讲述了她不再使用社交媒体的原因之一，称《龙之屋》粉丝群体中存在“很多丑陋的东西”。

paras.en: The actress, who plays controversial Queen Alicent Hightower in HBO’s Game of Thrones prequel series, recently chatted with GQ about the passionate yet intense fanbase that often theorizes about not only her character but sometimes herself and her relationship with directors.
paras.zh: 这位女演员在 HBO 的《权力的游戏》前传系列中饰演备受争议的艾莉森·海塔尔女王，她最近接受《GQ》杂志采访时谈到了热情而强烈的粉丝群，这些粉丝不仅经常对她的角色进行理论分析，有时还对她自己以及她与导演的关系进行理论分析。

paras.en: “I think some of those interpretations just catch fire, and they become something that bears no resemblance to what was shown on the screen at the time,” Cooke said. “There’s a lot of ugliness to that fandom as well. It’s steeped in misogyny. There’s a lot of racism. I try to let it take up minimal mental real estate.”
paras.zh: 库克说：“我认为其中一些解释很火，它们变得与当时屏幕上显示的内容完全不同。” “粉丝圈也有很多丑陋的地方。它充满了厌女症。有很多种族主义。我尽量让它占据最少的精神空间。”

paras.en: Eventually, the fan discourse on social media reached a point that was “not nourishing” for the actress, which is partly why she deactivated her social media accounts ahead of the House of the Dragon season three premiere in June.
paras.zh: 最终，社交媒体上的粉丝讨论达到了对这位女演员“没有营养”的地步，这也是她在六月份《龙之家》第三季首播之前停用社交媒体账户的部分原因。

paras.en: “I was just like, I’m on this too much. It’s not nourishing,” she said. “I think the celebri-fied nature of being an actor has now snowballed into this monster. And I just think we need to get off this train and realise that we make these TV shows and films, yes, for escapism, but also because it’s artful and it’s creative and it’s not for followers or for a brand deal or to get free shit. Even though that is nice sometimes.”
paras.zh: “我当时想，我对这个的关注太多了。这没有营养，”她说。 “我认为作为一名演员的名人本质现在已经像滚雪球一样变成了这个怪物。我只是认为我们需要下车并意识到我们制作这些电视节目和电影，是的，为了逃避现实，但也因为它是巧妙的，它是创造性的，它不是为了追随者或品牌交易或获得免费的东西。尽管有时这很好。”

paras.en: Cooke isn’t the only actor in the Game of Thrones universe to open up about the negative impact of social media. Sophie Turner, who played Sansa Stark in the original series starting at the age of 14, told Flaunt last year that it started to take a toll on her mental health as a young actress.
paras.zh: 库克并不是《权力的游戏》宇宙中唯一公开谈论社交媒体负面影响的演员。索菲·特纳 (Sophie Turner) 从 14 岁起就在原版剧集中扮演珊莎·史塔克 (Sansa Stark)，她去年告诉 Flaunt，作为一名年轻女演员，这开始对她的心理健康造成影响。

paras.en: “I think social media was just really becoming a big thing after I started on Game of Thrones, so I got a couple of years of peace and quiet and then I had to adjust. It had such a profound impact on my mental health, like more than I could tell you,” Turner said. “It almost destroyed me on numerous occasions.”
paras.zh: “我认为，在我开始拍摄《权力的游戏》之后，社交媒体才真正成为一件大事，所以我度过了几年的平静时光，然后我必须进行调整。它对我的心理健康产生了如此深远的影响，我无法告诉你，”特纳说。 “它有很多次几乎摧毁了我。”

articles.title: Trump’s C-SPAN call marks latest surprise post-midterm appearance

paras.en: President Donald Trump made an unexpected call into C-SPAN's evening broadcast Monday, extending a series of surprise appearances after Republicans' midterm election defeat.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周一出人意料地参加了 C-SPAN 的晚间广播，延续了共和党中期选举失败后的一系列出人意料的露​​面。

paras.en: "It looks like we've got a call from the White House," host Mimi Geerges told viewers as Trump joined the debut of "Washington Journal Primetime."
paras.zh: 当特朗普参加《华盛顿日报黄金时段》首播时，主持人咪咪·吉尔格斯对观众说：“看来我们接到了白宫的电话。”

paras.en: Trump congratulated Geerges on the launch before taking questions on immigration, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and the Iran war.
paras.zh: 特朗普对乔治斯的发射表示祝贺，然后就移民、国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯和伊朗战争提出了问题。

paras.en: Asked what he watches on C-SPAN, Trump said he follows viewer call-ins to gauge public sentiment.
paras.zh: 当被问及他在 C-SPAN 上看什么时，特朗普表示，他会通过观众的来电来衡量公众情绪。

paras.en: "I like to watch the call-ins because it gives me a little of an indication of where we are," he said.
paras.zh: “我喜欢观看电话会议，因为它让我知道我们所处的位置，”他说。

paras.en: The unannounced, eight-minute call followed another unexpected appearance earlier Monday, when Trump entered the White House briefing room alongside UFC CEO Dana White. Reporters were summoned so quickly that aides did not have time to attach the presidential seal to the podium, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，特朗普与 UFC 首席执行官达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 一起进入白宫简报室，随后又出人意料地出现了这次未经宣布的八分钟通话。据路透社报道，记者们被召集得如此之快，以至于助手们没有时间将总统印章贴在讲台上。

paras.en: It was Trump's first briefing room appearance in 198 days, according to a White House pool report. With the press secretary post vacant, Trump joked about offering White the job, to which the UFC chief declined.
paras.zh: 据白宫联合报告称，这是特朗普 198 天以来首次出现在简报室。由于新闻秘书职位空缺，特朗普开玩笑地表示要向怀特提供这份工作，但 UFC 主席拒绝了。

paras.en: Trump said he had been having "a very bad press day," as he floated White as his next press secretary.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他在任命怀特为下一任新闻秘书时，经历了“非常糟糕的媒体日”。

paras.en: Last Wednesday, a day after Republicans suffered substantial midterm losses, Trump also abruptly invited reporters to the construction site of his White House ballroom for his first public event since the election.
paras.zh: 上周三，在共和党中期选举惨败的第二天，特朗普还突然邀请记者前往他的白宫宴会厅的建筑工地，参加他自大选以来的首次公开活动。

paras.en: Trump spent more than 20 minutes discussing White House construction and renovation projects, including the ballroom's Corinthian columns, marble flooring and the helipad, before turning to the election results during questions from reporters.
paras.zh: 特朗普花了20多分钟讨论白宫的建设和改造项目，包括宴会厅的科林斯柱、大理石地板和直升机停机坪，然后在接受记者提问时转向选举结果。

paras.en: When asked whether he regretted how his campaign had ended, Trump distanced himself from the Republican losses.
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否对竞选的结束感到遗憾时，特朗普与共和党的失败保持了距离。

paras.en: "If I were on the ballot, we would have won," he said.
paras.zh: “如果我参加选票，我们就会获胜，”他说。

paras.en: Democrats won control of both the House and Senate in the Nov. 3 elections, dealing Trump a major political setback and setting up a divided government when the new Congress takes office in January.
paras.zh: 民主党在 11 月 3 日的选举中赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，这给特朗普带来了重大政治挫折，并在 1 月份新国会就职时建立了一个分裂的政府。

paras.en: Trump has long favored direct telephone contact with the media, including live calls to Fox News programs such as "Fox & Friends" during his first term.
paras.zh: 特朗普长期以来一直倾向于与媒体进行直接电话联系，包括在他的第一个任期内对福克斯新闻节目“福克斯与朋友”等进行现场通话。

paras.en: CBS News previously reported that Trump personally arranged one such television appearance, while The Associated Press has documented his habit of contacting journalists directly by cellphone to pitch stories and react to live coverage.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻此前报道称，特朗普亲自安排了一次这样的电视露面，而美联社则记录了他通过手机直接联系记者以宣传故事并对现场报道做出反应的习惯。

paras.en: — CNBC's Daniel Mangan contributed to this story.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的丹尼尔·曼根 (Daniel Mangan) 对本文做出了贡献。

articles.title: Trump says Iran war to end 'fairly soon,' plays down prospects of new strikes

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday that the war with Iran could end "fairly soon," adding that Tehran was "talking very politely" with Washington.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示，与伊朗的战争可能“很快”结束，并补充说德黑兰正在与华盛顿“非常礼貌地交谈”。

paras.en: Trump told reporters in the White House Monday, after a meeting with Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, that "We're seeing momentum toward the end of this conflict. I think it's going to be ending fairly soon."
paras.zh: 特朗普周一在白宫与卡塔尔总理谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼会面后对记者表示，“我们看到了结束这场冲突的势头。我认为它很快就会结束。”

paras.en: "Iran militarily is effectively over," Trump said, citing the destruction of its navy and surging inflation that he said has hollowed out its economy.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，“伊朗的军事实际上已经结束了”，他指出，伊朗海军遭到破坏，通胀飙升，导致其经济空心化。

paras.en: Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait would "prefer the status quo" which involves maintaining the naval blockade against Iran and "Operation Iron Gate" — a task force announced on Saturday aimed at preventing Iran from using ground routes to transport advanced weapons and other materials — Trump said in a Truth Social post.
paras.zh: 特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中表示，卡塔尔、沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、巴林、科威特将“更愿意维持现状”，其中包括维持对伊朗的海上封锁和“铁门行动”——周六宣布的一个特遣部队，旨在阻止伊朗利用地面路线运输先进武器和其他材料。

paras.en: He reiterated that Iran would not be allowed to have a nuclear weapon and kept the door open for potentially resuming strikes should circumstances change. "America is 'docked and loaded' and ready to go," he said, though caveating that new strikes were "quite unlikely."
paras.zh: 他重申，不会允许伊朗拥有核武器，并为如果情况发生变化可能恢复袭击敞开大门。他说：“美国已经‘靠岸装货’，准备出发。”不过他也警告称，新的袭击“不太可能发生”。

paras.en: The conflict, now in its ninth month, has driven a surge in fuel prices, hitting nearly every sector of the global economy.
paras.zh: 这场冲突现已进入第九个月，导致燃油价格飙升，几乎影响到全球经济的每个部门。

paras.en: The U.S. had reportedly planned for a potential increase in naval forces in the Middle East in the run-up to the midterm elections, with Trump hinting at escalating the conflict after the results.
paras.zh: 据报道，美国计划在中期选举前夕增加在中东的海军力量，特朗普暗示选举结果出来后将加剧冲突。

paras.en: The administration has since toned down the war rhetoric after bruising midterm election results that saw Republicans lose both chambers of Congress as voters expressed frustration with soaring living costs stemming from the war.
paras.zh: 中期选举结果惨淡，共和党失去参众两院，选民对战争导致的生活成本飙升表示失望，此后，政府淡化了战争言论。

paras.en: A diplomat briefed on the Qatar meeting told Axios that Trump told Al Thani that he wanted a deal and would give talks a chance, but could reverse course if Iran does not take the negotiations seriously.
paras.zh: 一位了解卡塔尔会议情况的外交官告诉 Axios，特朗普告诉阿勒萨尼，他希望达成协议，并将给谈判机会，但如果伊朗不认真对待谈判，他可能会改变立场。

paras.en: Iran has put forward a two-day proposal to the U.S. via Qatari mediators, Reuters reported, citing a senior Iranian official, demanding lifting of the sanctions imposed on Tehran and a new shipping route in the Strait of Hormuz. Washington was reviewing the proposal, according to the report.
paras.zh: 据路透社援引伊朗高级官员的话报道，伊朗已通过卡塔尔调解人向美国提出为期两天的提案，要求解除对德黑兰的制裁，并在霍尔木兹海峡开辟新航线。据报道，华盛顿正在审查该提案。

paras.en: Iranian officials have disputed that talks with Washington were underway. Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, reportedly said that Washington should stop "manufacturing fake news about imaginary talks."
paras.zh: 伊朗官员对与华盛顿正在进行的谈判提出异议。据报道，伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书莫森·雷扎伊表示，华盛顿应该停止“制造关于虚构会谈的假新闻”。

paras.en: Oil prices edged lower on Tuesday on the prospect of de-escalation, extending losses from the previous day. U.S. West Texas Intermediate dropped over 1% to $85.8 per barrel, after sliding more than 4% in the prior session. Brent futures dropped more than 1% to $91.56 a barrel, hovering near 10-week low levels.
paras.zh: 由于局势缓和的前景，周二油价小幅走低，延续前一天的跌幅。美国西德克萨斯中质原油价格下跌逾 1%，至每桶 85.8 美元，前一交易日下跌逾 4%。布伦特原油期货下跌逾 1%，至每桶 91.56 美元，徘徊在 10 周低位附近。

articles.title: SoftBank swings to $7 billion net loss in second quarter as tech selloff weighs on results

paras.en: SoftBank reported a fiscal second-quarter net loss of 1.12 trillion yen ($7 billion) on Tuesday, as investment losses and higher financing costs weighed on earnings.
paras.zh: 软银周二公布第二财季净亏损 1.12 万亿日元（合 70 亿美元），投资损失和融资成本上升拖累了盈利。

paras.en: Shares of the Japanese investment giant closed 13.9% higher on Tuesday. The gains came as Asian technology stocks, including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, rose following an overnight rebound on Wall Street.
paras.zh: 这家日本投资巨头的股价周二收盘上涨 13.9%。包括三星电子和SK海力士在内的亚洲科技股在华尔街隔夜反弹后上涨。

paras.en: Here's how SoftBank fared in the fiscal second quarter:
paras.zh: 以下是软银第二财季的表现：

paras.en: - Net loss of 1.12 trillion yen in the quarter compared with a net profit of 2.5 trillion yen a year earlier.
paras.zh: - 本季度净亏损 1.12 万亿日元，而去年同期净利润为 2.5 万亿日元。

paras.en: - Revenue stood at 2.22 trillion yen in the quarter, compared with LSEG estimates of 2.02 trillion yen.
paras.zh: - 本季度收入为 2.22 万亿日元，而 LSEG 预计为 2.02 万亿日元。

paras.en: Revenue rose 13.3% in the six months ended Sept. 30, supported by growth in telecommunications and AI computing businesses. The company said its SoftBank segment recorded higher sales across all businesses, while revenue at its AI computing segment increased.
paras.zh: 在电信和人工智能计算业务增长的支撑下，截至 9 月 30 日的六个月收入增长了 13.3%。该公司表示，软银部门所有业务的销售额均有所增长，而人工智能计算部门的收入也有所增加。

paras.en: SoftBank also recorded a 597.2 billion yen loss in the six-month period due to changes in procurement plans for power generation equipment for AI data center projects in the U.S.
paras.zh: 由于美国人工智能数据中心项目的发电设备采购计划发生变化，软银在这六个月期间还录得 5972 亿日元的亏损。

paras.en: The company's Vision Fund segment swung to a loss of 81.58 billion yen in the fiscal second quarter, compared with a profit of 2.38 trillion yen a year earlier. Vision Fund 1 recorded an investment loss of $20 million in the quarter, despite a $1.3 billion gain on ByteDance, as shares of publicly traded portfolio companies, including Coupang and Grab, declined.
paras.zh: 该公司的愿景基金部门在第二财季亏损 815.8 亿日元，而去年同期为利润 2.38 万亿日元。尽管字节跳动的收益为 13 亿美元，但由于 Coupang 和 Grab 等上市投资组合公司的股价下跌，Vision Fund 1 在本季度仍录得 2000 万美元的投资损失。

paras.en: The Vision Funds segment recorded investment gains of 85.45 billion yen, down sharply from 2.81 trillion yen in the year-earlier period. Vision Fund 2 posted investment gains of 89.26 billion yen, while Vision Fund 1 recorded a loss of 3.86 billion yen on its investments.
paras.zh: 愿景基金部门的投资收益为 854.5 亿日元，较上年同期的 2.81 万亿日元大幅下降。愿景基金2的投资收益为892.6亿日元，而愿景基金1的投资亏损为38.6亿日元。

paras.en: As of the end of September, SoftBank's cumulative investment in OpenAI stood at $54.6 billion, with a fair value of $99.6 billion and a cumulative investment gain of $45 billion, according to the company.
paras.zh: 截至9月底，软银对OpenAI的累计投资额为546亿美元，公允价值为996亿美元，累计投资收益为450亿美元。

paras.en: Ahead of its earnings release, SoftBank Group announced on Monday plans with Grab and Malaysia's PETROS to commit a combined $1.85 billion in initial capital to develop AI infrastructure in Malaysia, with a long-term target of at least five gigawatts of AI computing capacity.
paras.zh: 在发布财报之前，软银集团周一宣布，计划与 Grab 和马来西亚 PETROS 共同投入 18.5 亿美元的初始资本，用于在马来西亚开发人工智能基础设施，长期目标是至少 5 吉瓦的人工智能计算能力。

paras.en: This is a breaking news story. Please refresh for updates.
paras.zh: 这是一个突发新闻故事。请刷新以获取更新。

articles.title: Earth’s rocks have a missing layer spanning up to a billion years. Scientists finally know what happened to it

paras.en: Imagine opening a history book and finding several chapters torn out. This was what geologists looking into the rock records of Earth’s past discovered on several continents in the 1870s.
paras.zh: 想象一下打开一本历史书，发现有几章被撕掉了。这是 1870 年代地质学家在研究地球过去的岩石记录时在几个大陆上发现的结果。

paras.en: They dubbed it the Great Unconformity. Where layers of rock often stack up in a steady sequence from oldest to youngest, in many places around the world there is a gap of hundreds of millions of years.
paras.zh: 他们称之为“大不整合”。岩层通常从最古老到最年轻的顺序稳定地堆积起来，在世界上许多地方，岩石层之间存在数亿年的差距。

paras.en: For 150 years, nobody has known what erased those missing chapters. In new research published in Nature, we finally provide an explanation: deep processes inside Earth lifted some continents high above the sea, where their surfaces were scoured down by the grinding movement of enormous sheets of ice.
paras.zh: 150 年来，没有人知道是什么抹去了那些缺失的章节。在《自然》杂志上发表的新研究中，我们最终提供了一个解释：地球内部的深层过程将一些大陆抬高到海平面以上，它们的表面被巨大冰层的研磨运动冲刷下来。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Layers of rock often stack up in chronological order, with the oldest at the bottom and the youngest at the top.
paras.zh: 岩石层通常按时间顺序堆叠起来，最古老的位于底部，最年轻的位于顶部。

paras.en: Yet in some places, such as the Grand Canyon in North America, you can touch rock layers from two different ages, hundreds of millions of years apart. A flat layer of sedimentary rock, about 540 million years old or younger, rests directly atop a crystalline “basement” up to two billion years old.
paras.zh: 然而在某些地方，例如北美的大峡谷，您可以触摸到两个不同时代、相隔数亿年的岩层。一层平坦的沉积岩，大约有 5.4 亿年或更早的历史，直接位于长达 20 亿年历史的结晶“基底”之上。

paras.en: Somewhere in between, a considerable chunk (up to a quarter) of Earth’s history has simply vanished.
paras.zh: 在这两者之间的某个地方，地球历史的很大一部分（最多四分之一）就这样消失了。

paras.en: Important things happened in that time. The sedimentary layers on the younger side of the Great Unconformity appear at the same time as a huge diversification in the forms of life on Earth. This is the so-called Cambrian explosion, which began around 540 million years ago.
paras.zh: 那时发生了重要的事情。大不整合面较新一侧的沉积层与地球上生命形式的巨大多样化同时出现。这就是所谓的寒武纪大爆发，大约开始于5.4亿年前。

paras.en: Scientists have speculated entire continents were eroded during the Great Unconformity, which may have altered the chemical balance of seawater and allowed animal life to flourish.
paras.zh: 科学家推测，在大不整合期间，整个大陆都受到了侵蚀，这可能改变了海水的化学平衡，使动物得以繁衍生息。

paras.en: Geologists have found evidence of the Great Unconformity throughout North America and parts of northern China, as well as beneath younger rocks in northern Europe. Yet its origin has remained a puzzle.
paras.zh: 地质学家在整个北美和中国北部部分地区以及北欧较年轻的岩石下发现了大不整合面的证据。然而它的起源仍然是一个谜。

paras.en: Some scientists have argued it was caused by erosion by massive ice sheets during the Snowball Earth period between 720 million years and 635 million years ago. Others have pointed to the reshuffling of continental blocks, mountain-building processes, heat-induced movement inside the Earth, volcanic activity, or global sea level change.
paras.zh: 一些科学家认为，这是由7.2亿年前到6.35亿年前的雪球地球时期大量冰盖的侵蚀造成的。其他人则指出了大陆块的重新洗牌、造山过程、地球内部热引起的运动、火山活动或全球海平面变化。

paras.en: Testing these hypotheses has been a challenge because the primary evidence consists of missing rock. As a result, we need to work from what we already know to fill in the gaps.
paras.zh: 测试这些假设一直是一个挑战，因为主要证据包括缺失的岩石。因此，我们需要根据已知的知识来填补空白。

paras.en: We had a theory that the creation of the Great Unconformity might have been influenced by heat-driven motion in Earth’s mantle. The mantle is a 2,900-kilometer thick layer of hot solid rock that slowly moves over tens to hundreds of millions of years. Hot mantle rises from deep beneath and cold mantle sinks, pushing and pulling the surface above.
paras.zh: 我们有一个理论，认为大不整合面的形成可能受到地幔热驱动运动的影响。地幔是一层 2,900 公里厚的炽热固体岩石层，在数千万至数亿年的时间里缓慢移动。热地幔从地下深处升起，冷地幔下沉，推动和拉动上方的地表。

paras.en: This huge, slow movement can raise or lower the surface by hundreds of meters. Continents sit on top of the mantle and get pushed up and down by its motion.
paras.zh: 这种巨大而缓慢的运动可以使地表升高或降低数百米。大陆位于地幔顶部，并被地幔的运动上下推动。

paras.en: We used the Australian supercomputer Gadi to model how the movement of the mantle had affected continents over the past billion years.
paras.zh: 我们使用澳大利亚超级计算机 Gadi 来模拟过去十亿年来地幔运动如何影响大陆。

paras.en: Our results consistently showed that mantle convection caused ancient continental blocks Laurentia (which now makes up much of North America), Baltica (parts of northern Europe), and North China to be lifted up from around a billion years ago to 540 million years ago. Over the past 540 million years, they have been pulled downward.
paras.zh: 我们的研究结果一致表明，地幔对流导致古代大陆块劳伦西亚（现在构成北美的大部分地区）、波罗的海（北欧的部分地区）和华北从大约 10 亿年前抬升到 5.4 亿年前。在过去的5.4亿年里，它们一直被向下拉。

paras.en: This up-and-down movement is the ideal scenario for the formation and preservation of the Great Unconformity. When these continental blocks were lifted up, we see the crystalline underlayer was at the surface – and the layers of sediment above were eroded away. Then when the blocks sank, new layers of sediment began to form, which are preserved in rock to this day.
paras.zh: 这种上下运动是大不整合面形成和保存的理想情景。当这些大陆块被抬起时，我们看到结晶底层位于地表，而上面的沉积物层被侵蚀掉了。然后，当这些块体下沉时，新的沉积物层开始形成，这些沉积物至今仍保存在岩石中。

paras.en: Importantly, the uplift predicted by our models coincided with the Snowball Earth period. During this period, enormous ice sheets scraped over the surface of continents for tens of millions of years.
paras.zh: 重要的是，我们的模型预测的隆起恰逢雪球地球时期。在此期间，巨大的冰盖在大陆表面刮擦了数千万年。

paras.en: Glaciers and ice sheets are more efficient than rivers at eroding continents, even on gentle slopes. The ice sheets would have slowly slid downhill across the uplifted continents, eroding away everything in their path.
paras.zh: 在侵蚀大陆上，冰川和冰盖比河流更有效率，即使在缓坡上也是如此。冰盖会慢慢地滑下山坡，穿过隆起的大陆，侵蚀掉沿途的一切。

paras.en: In contrast to Laurentia, Baltica and North China, we found that Australia and South America experienced only two cycles of uplift and subsidence from 900 million years ago. This scenario is not conducive to the formation and preservation of the Great Unconformity – and indeed we see little evidence of it on these continents.
paras.zh: 与劳伦大陆、波罗的海和华北相比，我们发现澳大利亚和南美洲自9亿年前以来仅经历了两次隆起和沉降周期。这种情况不利于大不整合面的形成和保存——事实上，我们在这些大陆上几乎看不到任何证据。

paras.en: Our research suggests the missing pages in Earth’s geological archive may be due to slow mantle convection that gently lifted entire continents then made them subside over hundreds of millions of years.
paras.zh: 我们的研究表明，地球地质档案中缺失的页面可能是由于缓慢的地幔对流造成的，这种对流轻轻地抬升了整个大陆，然后使它们在数亿年的时间里下沉。

paras.en: In that sense, the Great Unconformity is the fingerprint of deep Earth processes. Forces deep beneath our feet have left planet-scale marks in the geological record, and shaped the environment in which complex life first evolved.
paras.zh: 从这个意义上说，大不整合面是地球深层过程的指纹。我们脚下深处的力量在地质记录中留下了行星规模的痕迹，并塑造了复杂生命最初进化的环境。

paras.en: This article was first published by The Conversation. Read the original article here.
paras.zh: 本文最初由《对话》发表。在这里阅读原文。

articles.title: NASA reveals new lunar rover, PROMISE, to launch to moon in 2028

paras.en: NASA officials on Saturday stressed that the agency is working to speed up testing and development of the hardware that will ensure human missions to the moon.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局官员周六强调，该机构正在努力加快硬件的测试和开发，以确保人类登月任务。

paras.en: The agency plans to have rovers and other infrastructure already waiting on the moon to greet any human crews when they do eventually arrive there. This is critical, according to NASA chief Jared Isaacman: “the missions themselves will help us characterize an environment that we’ve really not visited in a very long time,” he said at Saturday’s press event.
paras.zh: 该机构计划让漫游车和其他基础设施在月球上等待，以迎接最终抵达月球的人类宇航员。美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示，这一点至关重要：“任务本身将帮助我们描述我们已经很长时间没有访问过的环境，”他在周六的新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: “Every piece of equipment we learn to operate there brings that enduring presence a little bit closer to reality,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们在那里学习操作的每一件设备都让这种持久存在更接近现实，”他说。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: One of the biggest updates to that ambition is the decision to fly a rover, PROMISE (Polar Rover for Observation, Mapping and In-Situ Exploration), which is modeled after the Mars rovers Perseverance and Curiosity. Previously only proposed as a possibility by Isaacman, PROMISE will fly to the moon and land using a Blue Origin lander in late 2028 for an 18-month primary mission.
paras.zh: 这一雄心壮志的最大更新之一是决定驾驶火星车 PROMISE（用于观测、测绘和原位探索的极地漫游车），它是以火星漫游车“毅力号”和“好奇号”为蓝本的。此前仅由艾萨克曼提出，PROMISE 将在 2028 年底使用蓝色起源着陆器飞往月球并着陆，执行为期 18 个月的主要任务。

paras.en: “As the United States prepares to send humans back to the moon and onward to Mars, NASA Science is very busy getting ready to provide the ultimate interplanetary survival guide to help them on their way,” said Nicky Fox, NASA’s associate administrator for science.
paras.zh: “当美国准备将人类送回月球并前往火星时，美国宇航局科学部正忙于准备提供终极的星际生存指南，以帮助他们踏上旅程，”美国宇航局科学副局长尼基·福克斯说。

paras.en: NASA plans to establish a permanent human presence on the moon in the next decade. First steps along that way are the Artemis missions, each of which is designed to return humans to the moon as soon as 2028. Earlier this year four astronauts flew around the moon and back as part of Artemis II, going farther in space from Earth than any human has gone before.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局计划在未来十年内让人类在月球上永久存在。这条道路上的第一步是阿耳忒弥斯任务，每一项任务都旨在让人类最早在 2028 年重返月球。今年早些时候，作为阿耳忒弥斯二号的一部分，四名宇航员绕月飞行并返回，在太空中飞离地球的距离比人类以往任何时候都远。

paras.en: Next is Artemis III—currently slated for early 2027, the flight is designed to test two potential human landers for the moon. These are Blue Origin’s Blue Moon lander, and a version of SpaceX’s Starship; both spacecraft are still unproven as up for the job, an issue NASA’s Office of Inspector General has previously raised as a potential roadblock to the space agency’s moon ambitions. Artemis IV will be the first mission to put humans back on the moon in more than fifty years, in 2028.
paras.zh: 接下来是阿耳忒弥斯 III——目前定于 2027 年初进行，这次飞行旨在测试两个潜在的人类登月器。这些是 Blue Origin 的 Blue Moon 着陆器，以及 SpaceX 的 Starship 的一个版本；这两艘航天器是否能胜任这项工作尚未得到证实，美国宇航局监察长办公室此前曾提出这个问题，认为这是航天局登月雄心的潜在障碍。阿尔忒弥斯四号将于 2028 年成为五十多年来首次将人类送回月球的任务。

paras.en: At the same event, Moon Base program manager Carlos García-Galán said NASA and its industry partners have shifted the way they are thinking about moon missions to be a campaign made up of lunar landers, rovers and other hardware, as well as scientific instruments.
paras.zh: 在同一次活动中，月球基地项目经理卡洛斯·加西亚-加兰表示，美国宇航局及其行业合作伙伴已经改变了他们对月球任务的思考方式，将其转变为由月球着陆器、月球车和其他硬件以及科学仪器组成的活动。

paras.en: “From 2019 to the end of this year, we will have 22 task orders of landers that are going to go to the moon” as part of the Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) program, García-Galán said. Meanwhile, six new task orders have been awarded under the Venture Class Acquisition and Dedicated Rideshare Land Services (VADR), he added. These include awards for an orbital transfer vehicle that will take payloads to the moon’s surface and lunar orbit, and satellites by Intuitive Machines that will help set up communications, navigation and other digital infrastructure on the moon.
paras.zh: 加西亚-加兰表示，“从 2019 年到今年年底，我们将收到 22 个前往月球的着陆器任务订单”，作为商业月球有效载荷服务 (CLPS) 计划的一部分。他补充说，与此同时，根据风险类别收购和专用共享出行服务（VADR），已授予六项新任务订单。其中包括轨道转运飞行器的奖项，该飞行器将把有效载荷运送到月球表面和月球轨道，以及直观机器公司的卫星，这将有助于在月球上建立通信、导航和其他数字基础设施。

paras.en: There is also a plan to use a Blue Origin New Glenn rocket to help deliver “MoonFall” drones that will be deposited near the moon’s surface. These are designed to hop around the moon’s south pole and send data back to ground control prior to Artemis missions to deliver humans to that region, which is relatively unexplored.
paras.zh: 还有一项计划使用蓝色起源新格伦火箭来帮助运送“MoonFall”无人机，这些无人机将被放置在月球表面附近。这些卫星的设计目的是在阿耳忒弥斯任务之前绕月球南极跳跃并将数据发送回地面控制中心，将人类运送到该地区，而该地区相对尚未被探索。

paras.en: In the future, NASA may also tap Blue Origin’s Blue Ring spacecraft to help boost communication abilities at the moon, García-Galán said, but Blue Ring is very much still under development. SpaceX’s Starlink will also get involved, testing longer-range communications abilities, he said. “Eventually [SpaceX] could on-ramp into a commercial services contract in the future for Moon Base assets,” he added.
paras.zh: 加西亚-加兰说，未来美国宇航局还可能利用蓝色起源的蓝环航天器来帮助提高月球的通信能力，但蓝环很大程度上仍处于开发阶段。他说，SpaceX 的 Starlink 也将参与其中，测试更远距离的通信能力。 “最终，[SpaceX] 可能会在未来签订月球基地资产的商业服务合同，”他补充道。

paras.en: NASA is also pushing a new CLPS program phase, García-Galán said—“CLPS 2.0.” This will include a next generation of landers the agency anticipates needing once humans have started to return to the moon regularly. These landers will need to carry heavier loads of as much as six metric tons, he said. Companies tapped to do this include Blue Origin, Lockheed Martin, SpaceX, Voyager Technologies, Intuitive Machines, Northrop Grumman, Firefly Aerospace and ispace-U.S.
paras.zh: 加西亚-加兰说，NASA 还在推动新的 CLPS 计划阶段——“CLPS 2.0”。这将包括该机构预计一旦人类开始定期返回月球就需要的下一代着陆器。他说，这些着陆器需要承载多达六吨的重物。参与此项目的公司包括 Blue Origin、Lockheed Martin、SpaceX、Voyager Technologies、Intuitive Machines、Northrop Grumman、Firefly Aerospace 和 ispace-U.S.。

paras.en: “The increased science capabilities at Moon Base, though, are not just about the number of payloads we fly. It is about the quality of the payloads that we fly,” Fox said. She stressed that these science efforts, including the PROMISE rover, serve as ways to ensure humans can survive and thrive on the moon. The PROMISE mission will be led by project scientist James Keane, a planetary scientist at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory. The rover will have a drill and other instruments designed to study the lunar regolith and radiation, as well as observing the moon’s surface in ways similar to the Mars rovers, Fox added.
paras.zh: “不过，月球基地科学能力的提高不仅仅与我们飞行的有效载荷的数量有关。还与我们飞行的有效载荷的质量有关，”福克斯说。她强调，包括“承诺”漫游车在内的这些科学努力是确保人类能够在月球上生存和繁荣的方法。 PROMISE 任务将由项目科学家詹姆斯·基恩领导，他是美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的行星科学家。福克斯补充说，火星车将配备钻头和其他仪器，旨在研究月球风化层和辐射，并以类似于火星漫游车的方式观察月球表面。

paras.en: “This mission will kind of serve as a scout for the Moon Base operations, whilst also prospecting for resources near the lunar south pole,” Fox said. “Promise is just the beginning as we continue to lead the world into a new era of paradigm-shifting science and human space exploration for generations to come.”
paras.zh: 福克斯说：“这次任务将充当月球基地行动的侦察任务，同时也在月球南极附近勘探资源。” “承诺只是一个开始，我们将继续引领世界进入一个范式转变的科学和人类太空探索的新时代，造福子孙后代。”

paras.en: This is a developing story and may be updated.
paras.zh: 这是一个正在发展的故事，可能会更新。

articles.title: Why measles is spreading again, how hackers are targeting freezers, and whether cats fart

paras.en: Rachel Feltman: Happy Monday, listeners. For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman. You’re listening to our weekly science news roundup.
paras.zh: 雷切尔·费尔特曼：听众们，星期一快乐。我是《科学美国人》的《科学快报》的雷切尔·费尔特曼。您正在收听我们的每周科学新闻综述。

paras.en: Unfortunately, we have to start this week off with some deeply troubling public health news. Last Monday a child in upstate New York’s Lewis County died after contracting measles. This marks the state’s first death associated with the disease in three decades.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，本周我们必须从一些令人深感不安的公共卫生新闻开始。上周一，纽约州北部刘易斯县的一名儿童因感染麻疹而死亡。这标志着该州三十年来首次因该疾病死亡。

paras.en: Jeffery Tompkins, who is the coroner and district attorney of Lewis County, told the New York Times that the seven-month old was unvaccinated. While infants in high-risk communities or who are about to travel internationally can receive a dose of the measles, mumps and rubella, or MMR, vaccine as early as six months of age, it’s not generally recommended before 12 months. Unfortunately, due to their still-developing immune systems and organs, babies and young children are the people most vulnerable to complications from measles. The virus can lead to pneumonia and brain inflammation, both of which can prove deadly. And even the ones who recover can experience something called “immune amnesia,” That’s where the body loses its ability to fight other infections previously encountered via immunization or illness.
paras.zh: 刘易斯县验尸官兼地区检察官杰弗里·汤普金斯 (Jeffery Tompkins) 告诉《纽约时报》，这名七个月大的孩子没有接种疫苗。虽然高风险社区或即将出国旅行的婴儿最早可以在 6 个月大时接种一剂麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗（MMR），但通常不建议在 12 个月大之前接种。不幸的是，由于婴儿和幼儿的免疫系统和器官仍在发育，他们是最容易出现麻疹并发症的人。该病毒可导致肺炎和脑部炎症，这两种情况都可能致命。即使是康复的人也会经历一种叫做“免疫失忆症”的情况，这就是身体失去抵抗以前通过免疫或疾病遇到的其他感染的能力。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Infants too young to receive the MMR vaccine rely on herd immunity, which means the adults and older kids around them have to have high enough vaccination rates to keep measles from spreading through the community. But measles vaccination coverage has been declining annually, and the most recently available data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention shows that measles vaccination rates in U.S. kindergarteners have dropped below the threshold needed to prevent community spread.
paras.zh: 太小而无法接种 MMR 疫苗的婴儿依赖群体免疫，这意味着他们周围的成年人和年龄较大的孩子必须拥有足够高的疫苗接种率，以防止麻疹在社区中传播。但麻疹疫苗接种覆盖率逐年下降，美国疾病控制与预防中心的最新数据显示，美国幼儿园儿童的麻疹疫苗接种率已降至防止社区传播所需的阈值以下。

paras.en: The child who died in Lewis County lived in an Amish community. And while the Amish don’t have a religious mandate against vaccination and also it’s worth noting they are not one homogenous group, their vaccination rates are largely on the low end. About 100 miles away in New York’s Montgomery County, three small Amish schools have been fighting to regain the religious vaccine exemptions that the state eliminated in response to a 2019 measles outbreak.
paras.zh: 在刘易斯县死亡的孩子住在阿米什社区。尽管阿米什人没有反对疫苗接种的宗教信仰，而且值得注意的是，他们不是一个同质群体，但他们的疫苗接种率很大程度上处于低端。在约 100 英里外的纽约蒙哥马利县，三所小型阿米什学校一直在努力争取重新获得该州因 2019 年麻疹爆发而取消的宗教疫苗豁免权。

paras.en: The Associated Press reports that in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, where Amish and Mennonite communities have been the epicenter of the country’s worst measles outbreak in decades, community leaders and scholars suspect that strict COVID mandates stirred up negative sentiments around vaccination. But according to the AP’s reporting, it does seem that many members of the community simply see vaccines as unnecessary or too difficult to access. Some Pennsylvania health care workers are going door-to-door to reach those families.
paras.zh: 美联社报道称，在宾夕法尼亚州兰开斯特县，阿米什人和门诺派社区是该国数十年来最严重麻疹疫情的中心，社区领导人和学者怀疑严格的新冠病毒强制规定激起了围绕疫苗接种的负面情绪。但根据美联社的报道，社区中的许多成员似乎确实认为疫苗没有必要或太难获得。宾夕法尼亚州的一些医护人员正在挨家挨户地接触这些家庭。

paras.en: Back in New York, an executive order signed by New York governor Kathy Hochul last month, says that vaccines can now be administered by emergency medical technicians, midwives and pharmacists to try to improve access. Vaccine administrators are also no longer required to receive consent from people aged 19 and older to report these vaccinations to the state immunization information system. The order was originally set to expire after November 4 but has now been extended to December 4.
paras.zh: 回到纽约，纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔上个月签署的一项行政命令表示，疫苗现在可以由紧急医疗技术人员、助产士和药剂师进行管理，以努力改善疫苗接种的机会。疫苗管理人员也不再需要征得 19 岁及以上人群的同意才能向州免疫信息系统报告这些疫苗接种情况。该命令原定于 11 月 4 日后到期，但现已延长至 12 月 4 日。

paras.en: In less devastating but admittedly still troubling news, hackers have once again cranked up the heat on freezers in European supermarkets. As we reported in our October 19 news roundup, hundreds of French supermarkets were targeted by a cyberattack aimed at spoiling their wares just last month. That was the first known attack of its kind, but experts warned it would not be the last. And sure enough, a second wave struck shops in Sweden, Ireland, Estonia, Finland, the Netherlands, Italy, Luxembourg, Portugal, Germany, Belgium and Romania on the night of November 1. Of course, supermarket food isn’t the only thing that requires refrigeration. The national blood service of France, which prepares and distributes blood, plasma and platelets for hospitals around the country, has said three of the cold storage sites it contracts with were hit by the same attack or a similarly timed one. Fortunately, alarms alerted workers to the temperature fluctuation in time for them to intervene. Meanwhile, Pentagon officials now suspect that a string of freezer issues seen on U.S. military bases back in August may have actually been the result of a similar hack.
paras.zh: 这是一个虽然不那么具有破坏性但仍然令人不安的消息，黑客再次加大了欧洲超市冰柜的温度。正如我们在 10 月 19 日的新闻综述中报道的那样，就在上个月，数百家法国超市成为了旨在破坏其商品的网络攻击的目标。这是已知的第一起此类攻击，但专家警告说，这不会是最后一次。果然，11 月 1 日晚，第二波疫情袭击了瑞典、爱尔兰、爱沙尼亚、芬兰、荷兰、意大利、卢森堡、葡萄牙、德国、比利时和罗马尼亚的商店。当然，超市食品并不是唯一需要冷藏的东西。法国国家血液服务机构负责为全国各地的医院准备和分发血液、血浆和血小板，该机构表示，与该机构签约的三个冷藏站遭到了同一起或时间相似的袭击。幸运的是，警报及时提醒工作人员注意温度波动，以便他们及时进行干预。与此同时，五角大楼官员现在怀疑，八月份美国军事基地出现的一系列冰箱问题实际上可能是类似黑客攻击的结果。

paras.en: These attacks exploit the fact that many commercial freezers are connected to the Internet to enable remote troubleshooting and temperature monitoring. Theoretically, anything that accesses the Internet, including your own smart fridge, is opening a door that a hacker can get in through. In this case, they took advantage of heating elements that serve to periodically clear built-up frost on a freezer’s evaporator coil. Instead of briefly turning on as designed for their normal defrost cycle, these hacked heating elements brought freezer temperatures as high as 122 degrees Fahrenheit and kept them baking overnight.
paras.zh: 这些攻击利用了许多商用冰柜连接到互联网来实现远程故障排除和温度监控的事实。从理论上讲，任何访问互联网的东西，包括你自己的智能冰箱，都为黑客打开了一扇可以侵入的大门。在这种情况下，他们利用加热元件来定期清除冰箱蒸发器盘管上积聚的霜。这些被黑客攻击的加热元件并没有按照正常除霜周期的设计短暂开启，而是将冰箱温度提高到了 122 华氏度，并让它们烘烤过夜。

paras.en: One cybersecurity expert told Scientific American that it’s totally possible to protect these sorts of Internet connections from hackers. You just need proper firewalls and to keep your equipment updated. But as we explained in our September 2 episode focused on cyberattacks against the U.S. water supply, the problem is that many businesses and municipalities lack the time, money or information necessary to take those basic precautions.
paras.zh: 一位网络安全专家告诉《科学美国人》，完全有可能保护此类互联网连接免受黑客攻击。您只需要适当的防火墙并保持设备更新。但正如我们在 9 月 2 日针对美国供水系统的网络攻击的一集中所解释的那样，问题是许多企业和市政当局缺乏采取这些基本预防措施所需的时间、金钱或信息。

paras.en: We’ve covered some tough news items today, so we’ll end with a fun little animal story as a treat. And not just any sort of fun animal story: This one is a fun animal fart story. So, it's twice as fun.
paras.zh: 今天我们报道了一些艰难的新闻，所以我们将以一个有趣的小动物故事作为结束。这不仅仅是任何一种有趣的动物故事：这是一个有趣的动物放屁故事。所以，它的乐趣加倍。

paras.en: If you’ve spent literally any time at all with a dog, you should know that our canine companions can fart. In fact they can really let ’em rip. But have you ever heard a pussycat pass gas? Do felines flatulate? Can a cat crop dust? Do tabbies get the toots? Does a kitten ever cut the cheese?
paras.zh: 如果您确实和狗一起度过过任何时间，您应该知道我们的犬类伙伴会放屁。事实上，他们真的可以让他们撕裂。但你听过猫咪放屁吗？猫科动物会胀气吗？猫能吸食灰尘吗？虎斑猫会发出嘟嘟声吗？小猫切过奶酪吗？

paras.en: Scientific American breaking news reporter Jackie Flynn Mogensen recently embarked on a journalistic investigation to find out. Here she is with the full litter box scoop.
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》突发新闻记者杰基·弗林·摩根森最近展​​开了一项新闻调查来找出答案。她拿着满满的垃圾箱铲子。

paras.en: Jackie Flynn Mogensen: Hi Rachel! Yes, cats do fart!
paras.zh: 杰基·弗林·摩根森：嗨，瑞秋！是的，猫会放屁！

paras.en: I became interested in how cats could fart because I actually heard my cat fart the other day. It was a few weeks back. He climbs into his litter box, he scuffles around a bit and then there's this, like, squeaky fart that sounds just like a human fart. My boyfriend was in the other room,and I was like, “It couldn’t have been him.” And I was like, “Did my cat just fart?” And so this sent me on this quest for answers about “Do cats fart?” Thankfully, my editor actually approved this idea, and I was able to talk to some experts to kinda get to the bottom of “Why does it seem like cats don’t fart as much as dogs?”
paras.zh: 我对猫如何放屁感兴趣，因为前几天我确实听到了我的猫放屁。那是几周前的事了。他爬进垃圾箱，扭动了一下，然后就发出吱吱作响的屁声，听起来就像人类的屁一样。我男朋友在另一个房间，我当时想，“不可能是他。”我当时想，“我的猫刚刚放屁了吗？”因此，这促使我开始寻找“猫会放屁吗？”的答案。值得庆幸的是，我的编辑实际上批准了这个想法，而且我能够与一些专家交谈，以深入了解“为什么猫不像狗那样放屁？”

paras.en: I grew up with cats my whole life. I’d never heard one fart before. I’d never smelled a cat fart, but I’ve also lived with dogs who are farting all the time, it seems like. And so it got me real interested in this question of what’s going on in their bodies or with our nose that we aren’t picking up these farts.
paras.zh: 我一生都是和猫一起长大的。我以前从来没有听过一个屁。我从来没有闻过猫的屁味，但我也和狗住在一起，它们似乎一直在放屁。因此，这让我对这个问题非常感兴趣：他们的身体或我们的鼻子发生了什么，我们没有捡起这些屁。

paras.en: So what’s going on in cats’ bodies when they are farting? There are all these things that play a role in cats’ flatulence: diet, environment, health issues, medications. From what the experts I talked to said, is—there are two, kind of, primary sources for gas that comes out of a cat's anus, so that’s the definition of a fart, gas that comes out of the anus.
paras.zh: 那么猫放屁的时候身体里发生了什么？所有这些因素都会导致猫胀气：饮食、环境、健康问题、药物。据我采访过的专家所说，从猫的肛门排出的气体有两种主要来源，这就是屁的定义，从肛门排出的气体。

paras.en: In cats and dogs and us, the two, kind of, primary sources are swallowed air and gas produced by bacterial fermentation. So when we’re talking about swallowed air, one thing that experts told me is that cats might be farting less because they are swallowing less air. They’re just smaller, and they don’t eat with the same fervor, as one expert put it, as dogs do. Cats are, kind of, these grazers typically.
paras.zh: 对于猫、狗和我们来说，这两种主要来源是吞咽的空气和细菌发酵产生的气体。因此，当我们谈论吞咽的空气时，专家告诉我的一件事是，猫放屁的次数可能会减少，因为它们吞咽的空气较少。正如一位专家所说，它们只是体型较小，而且吃东西的热情不如狗。猫是典型的食草动物。

paras.en: And then the other thing that could be going on with swallowed air is breed. So one thing I heard from multiple people: Cats and dogs with flat faces, also known as brachycephalic breeds, Persian cats, Himalayan cats or French bulldogs, for instance, they have trouble breathing through their nose, and so they tend to take in a lot more air than other breeds. So that’s one of the factors that may influence how much a cat is farting based on how much air they’re swallowing.
paras.zh: 吞咽空气可能发生的另一件事是繁殖。我从很多人那里听到一件事：扁平脸的猫和狗，也称为短头品种，例如波斯猫、喜马拉雅猫或法国斗牛犬，它们通过鼻子呼吸有困难，因此它们往往比其他品种吸入更多的空气。因此，这是可能影响猫放屁数量的因素之一，具体取决于猫吞咽的空气量。

paras.en: The other factor is bacterial fermentation. Basically, food that gets to our colon that isn’t digested, that ends up in the colon, is broken down by bacteria. For carbohydrates, fibers, that can create gases like carbon dioxide and hydrogen, and the breakdown of proteins can create gases that contain sulfur, and those are the gases that stink and give farts their bad odor.
paras.zh: 另一个因素是细菌发酵。基本上，到达结肠的食物没有被消化，最终进入结肠，被细菌分解。对于碳水化合物、纤维来说，它们会产生二氧化碳和氢气等气体，而蛋白质的分解会产生含有硫的气体，这些气体会发出臭味，让屁发出难闻的气味。

paras.en: What this means for cat owners is maybe it’s worth paying a little bit closer attention to your cat’s flatulence. You know, one thing I heard over and over again is if your cat is farting a lot, that could be a sign of health problems. And it really made me think, “Hmm,” like this is such a silly topic. It’s kind of funny. I was giggling a lot as I was interviewing these researchers. It’s funny now even telling it to you. But if we treat it as this taboo topic that people don’t wanna talk about, we’re missing out on this opportunity to talk about our pets’ health, and I think that’s really important. And it’s not something we should shy away from.
paras.zh: 这对猫主人来说意味着也许值得更加关注猫的肠胃胀气。你知道，我一遍又一遍地听到的一件事是，如果你的猫放屁很多，这可能是健康问题的征兆。这真的让我觉得，“嗯，”这真是一个愚蠢的话题。这有点有趣。当我采访这些研究人员时，我咯咯地笑了很多。现在告诉你也很有趣。但如果我们将其视为人们不想谈论的禁忌话题，我们就会错过这个谈论宠物健康的机会，我认为这非常重要。这不是我们应该回避的事情。

paras.en: Feltman: That’s all for this week’s science news roundup. Tune in on Wednesday to find out why this year's El Niño is shaping up to be one for the record books.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：这就是本周科学新闻综述的全部内容。周三请收看节目，了解为什么今年的厄尔尼诺现象将成为创纪录的现象。

paras.en: For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, this is Rachel Feltman. Have a great week!
paras.zh: 我是《科学美国人》的《科学快报》的雷切尔·费尔特曼。祝你度过愉快的一周！

articles.title: How hawkmoths turned their genitals into bat-busting weapons
articles.author: Elie Dolgin

paras.en: When a bat closes in, some hawkmoths fight back with their genitalia. By rasping specialized scales on their sex organs against structures on their abdomens, the moths unleash bursts of ultrasound that can scramble the sonar a hungry bat uses to lock onto prey.
paras.zh: 当蝙蝠逼近时，一些天蛾会用生殖器进行反击。通过用它们的性器官上的特殊鳞片摩擦腹部的结构，飞蛾释放出超声波脉冲，可以扰乱饥饿的蝙蝠用来锁定猎物的声纳。

paras.en: But this acoustic counterattack is no evolutionary one-off. Relentless pressure from predators has pushed these otherwise tasty insects to reinvent this defensive tactic up to seven times throughout their evolution, with separate lineages arriving at distinct anatomical solutions to the same threat, researchers report November 4 in the Proceedings of the Royal Society B.
paras.zh: 但这种声学反击并不是进化上的一次性事件。研究人员 11 月 4 日在《英国皇家学会学报 B》上报告称，来自捕食者的无情压力迫使这些原本美味的昆虫在其整个进化过程中重新发明了这种防御策略多达七次，不同的谱系针对同一威胁得出了不同的解剖学解决方案。

paras.en: The findings suggest that the high-frequency acoustic skirmishes playing out overhead each night, beyond the range of human hearing, may be far more varied than scientists realized.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，每天晚上在头顶上空发生的超出人类听觉范围的高频声学冲突可能比科学家们意识到的要多样化得多。

paras.en: “Clearly the hawkmoths as a whole have more tricks up their sleeve,” says Marc Holderied, a sensory biologist and bioacoustics researcher at the University of Bristol in England who was not involved in the study.
paras.zh: “显然，天蛾作为一个整体还有更多的伎俩，”英国布里斯托大学的感觉生物学家和生物声学研究员马克·霍尔德里德（Marc Holderied）说，他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: The discovery builds on more than a decade of research by sensory ecologist Jesse Barber, now at the American Museum of Natural History in New York City, and entomologist Akito Kawahara of the Florida Museum of Natural History in Gainesville. Those scientists’ earlier work showed that moths across multiple families, from tiger moths and fruit-piercing moths to geometer moths and jewel caterpillar moths, produce ultrasound in response to bat attacks. Other insects, including some beetles and fireflies, do too.
paras.zh: 这一发现建立在纽约市美国自然历史博物馆的感官生态学家杰西·巴伯和盖恩斯维尔佛罗里达自然历史博物馆的昆虫学家川原明人十多年的研究基础上。这些科学家的早期工作表明，多个科的飞蛾，从虎蛾、穿果蛾到几何蛾和宝石毛虫蛾，都会产生超声波来应对蝙蝠的攻击。其他昆虫，包括一些甲虫和萤火虫，也会这样做。

paras.en: But among the most striking defenders are hawkmoths, a family of some 1,600 mostly nocturnal, torpedo-shaped speedsters, also known as sphinx moths, that hover at flowers like hummingbirds. Many fend off bats by scraping their genitalia like a fingernail dragged along a comb, producing ultrasonic clicks that can disrupt the predators’ sonar.
paras.zh: 但最引人注目的防御者是鹰蛾，这个家族约有 1,600 只，大多是夜间活动的鱼雷形飞蛾，也称为狮身人面像飞蛾，它们像蜂鸟一样盘旋在花朵上。许多蝙蝠通过刮擦蝙蝠的生殖器来抵御蝙蝠，就像用指甲沿着梳子拖动一样，产生超声波咔哒声，扰乱捕食者的声纳。

paras.en: The anatomical diversity of these sound-producing systems, however, and how they evolved remained poorly understood. So Barber, Kawahara and their team, including Florida museum colleague and evolutionary biologist Paul Masonick, combined audio recordings of male hawkmoths responding to bat calls with high-resolution imaging of preserved specimens from overlapping species. Although some females also produce ultrasound, the researchers focused on males because female sound creation remains too poorly documented for systematic analysis.
paras.zh: 然而，这些发声系统的解剖多样性以及它们如何进化仍然知之甚少。因此，巴伯、川原和他们的团队，包括佛罗里达博物馆的同事和进化生物学家保罗·马索尼克，将雄性天蛾响应蝙蝠叫声的录音与来自重叠物种的保存标本的高分辨率成像结合起来。尽管一些雌性也产生超声波，但研究人员将重点放在雄性上，因为雌性声音产生的记录仍然很少，无法进行系统分析。

paras.en: Among the 143 species tested, 77 produced ultrasound. They did so in three distinct ways. All three rely on a patch of enlarged, football-shaped scales on the male’s genital valves, which are paired structures used to clasp females during mating. But what those scales scrape against varies.
paras.zh: 在接受测试的 143 个物种中，有 77 个物种产生超声波。他们以三种不同的方式做到了这一点。这三种动物都依赖于雄性生殖瓣上的一块扩大的足球形鳞片，这些鳞片是成对的结构，用于在交配过程中紧握雌性。但这些天平所刮擦的东西各不相同。

paras.en: Some rub the scales against a row of corresponding scales near the rear of the abdomen. Others drag them across stiff spines jutting from the abdomen’s edge. Still others rasp them over a field of microscopic bumps on the insect’s underside, a previously unidentified part of the sound-making apparatus.
paras.zh: 有些会将鳞片与靠近腹部后部的一排相应的鳞片摩擦。其他人则将它们拖过从腹部边缘伸出的僵硬的刺。还有一些人用它们敲击昆虫下侧的微小凸起，这是以前未识别的发声装置的一部分。

paras.en: These mechanical differences are reflected in the sounds themselves. Moths that scrape their genital scales against spines or tiny bumps tend to make more continuous noise, with greater potential to jam bat sonar. Those that scrape scales against other scales produce irregular bursts, which may startle attackers or mimic the warning calls of foul-tasting prey.
paras.zh: 这些机械差异反映在声音本身上。飞蛾将生殖器鳞片刮到刺或微小的肿块上，往往会发出更连续的噪音，更有可能干扰蝙蝠声纳。那些鳞片与其他鳞片之间的刮擦会产生不规则的爆发，这可能会吓到攻击者或模仿恶臭猎物的警告叫声。

paras.en: Notably, moths that scrape against the newly identified bumpy surface have the broadest acoustic repertoire, with even close relatives sounding quite different. That flexibility could give them more options for evolving new defenses against bats, notes Nick Dowdy, an evolutionary biologist at the Milwaukee Public Museum who was not involved in the research. Other groups, by comparison, may be more constrained by their anatomy, he says, leaving them “locked into certain strategies.”
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，在新发现的凹凸不平的表面上刮擦的飞蛾具有最广泛的声学能力，即使是近亲，听起来也很不同。密尔沃基公共博物馆的进化生物学家尼克·道迪（未参与这项研究）指出，这种灵活性可以为它们提供更多选择来进化出针对蝙蝠的新防御措施。他说，相比之下，其他群体可能更容易受到身体结构的限制，从而让他们“陷入某些策略之中”。

paras.en: The authors estimate that genitalia-enabled ultrasound production evolved independently at least four and as many as seven times between roughly 5 million and 30 million years ago. According to Masonick, it is a vivid example of convergent evolution in which the same predatory menace repeatedly drove the moths to adapt similar behaviors through different anatomical routes.
paras.zh: 作者估计，在大约500万至3000万年前，生殖器超声波的产生至少独立进化了四次，甚至多达七次。根据Masonick的说法，这是一个趋同进化的生动例子，其中相同的掠夺性威胁反复驱使飞蛾通过不同的解剖路线适应类似的行为。

paras.en: But the evolutionary arms race was not a one-way street, he points out. Several hawkmoth lineages that shifted toward twilight or daytime activity subsequently lost their specialized sound-producing machinery.
paras.zh: 但他指出，进化军备竞赛并不是一条单行道。一些转向黄昏或白天活动的天蛾谱系随后失去了专门的发声机制。

paras.en: “It goes to show how intense bat predation is on insects,” Masonick says. “It’s been a major driver of insect evolution.”
paras.zh: “这表明蝙蝠对昆虫的捕食有多强烈，”梅索尼克说。 “它是昆虫进化的主要驱动力。”

articles.title: How octopuses squeeze through tiny openings, step by step
articles.author: Nora Bradford

paras.en: Octopuses have made many a great escape. Remember Inky, who fled from New Zealand’s national aquarium?
paras.zh: 章鱼帮助许多人成功逃脱。还记得逃离新西兰国家水族馆的 Inky 吗？

paras.en: The cephalopods can Houdini their way out of tanks and off boats by squeezing through narrow slits and incredibly tiny holes. Now researchers know exactly how some octopuses pull it off. These masterful getaways involve a consistent, step-by-step game plan, researchers report November 5 in the Journal of Experimental Biology.
paras.zh: 头足类动物可以通过狭窄的缝隙和极其微小的孔洞从坦克和船上逃脱。现在研究人员确切地知道一些章鱼是如何做到这一点的。研究人员在 11 月 5 日的《实验生物学杂志》上报告说，这些巧妙的度假活动需要一个一致的、循序渐进的游戏计划。

paras.en: Octopuses are mostly squishy muscle, allowing them to shape-shift, though they do have some rigid body parts. Not many scientists have studied how these animals squirm through small openings, says Robyn Crook, an evolutionary biologist at San Francisco State University who was not involved in the research. “It’s one of the most characteristic behaviors of octopuses in popular awareness, but the strategies octopuses use have not really been examined systematically.”
paras.zh: 章鱼主要是柔软的肌肉，使它们能够变形，尽管它们确实有一些坚硬的身体部位。旧金山州立大学的进化生物学家罗宾·克鲁克（Robyn Crook）没有参与这项研究，他说，没有多少科学家研究过这些动物如何在小开口中蠕动。 “这是公众意识中章鱼最具特色的行为之一，但章鱼使用的策略尚未真正得到系统的研究。”

paras.en: Sneaking through small spaces isn’t just a party trick for octopuses, says Michael Kuba, a biologist at the University of Naples Federico II in Italy. The animals use that skill to find hidden food and to avoid becoming food themselves.
paras.zh: 意大利那不勒斯费德里克二世大学的生物学家迈克尔·库巴说，潜入狭小的空间不仅仅是章鱼的聚会把戏。动物利用这种技能来寻找隐藏的食物并避免自己成为食物。

paras.en: Kuba and his colleagues observed how three common octopuses (Octopus vulgaris) and four Mayan octopuses (Octopus maya) approached small holes. For each individual, the team measured the distance between the octopus’s eyes as an indicator of the size of their most rigid cartilage around their brain. Then the researchers designed acrylic boxes with holes that were slightly smaller or larger than that eye-to-eye measurement. They plopped the octopuses inside and watched what happened.
paras.zh: 库巴和他的同事观察了三只普通章鱼（Octopus vulgaris）和四只玛雅章鱼（Octopus maya）如何接近小洞。对于每个章鱼，研究小组测量了章鱼眼睛之间的距离，作为其大脑周围最坚硬的软骨大小的指标。然后，研究人员设计了带有孔的丙烯酸盒子，这些孔比眼睛对眼睛的测量稍小或稍大。他们把章鱼放进去，观察发生了什么。

paras.en: Octopuses have slightly different escape how-tos, depending on the size of the hole they are squeezing through. Here, a common octopus (Octopus vulgaris) wriggles through a space just a little bit bigger than their most rigid body parts. It takes just three steps for the octopus to free itself from the acrylic box.
paras.zh: 章鱼的逃生方法略有不同，具体取决于它们挤过的洞的大小。在这里，一只普通章鱼（Octopus vulgaris）在一个比其最坚硬的身体部位稍大一点的空间中蠕动。章鱼只需三步就可以从亚克力盒子中解脱出来。

paras.en: Common octopuses used one of two escape strategies depending on the hole’s size. When the hole was wider than the distance between their eyes, the octopuses pushed themselves through it in three steps. First, they snuck one or two arms through the hole and then threaded a couple more arms through. Finally, they used the arms that they had already snaked through the hole to push against the box and yank their head and the rest of their arms through in one fell swoop. The whole operation took a few seconds.
paras.zh: 普通章鱼根据洞的大小使用两种逃跑策略中的一种。当洞比它们的眼睛之间的距离宽时，章鱼就分三步将自己推了进去。首先，他们将一只或两只手臂从洞里伸进去，然后再将几只手臂穿进去。最后，他们用已经从洞里钻出来的手臂推着箱子，把自己的头和剩下的手臂一下子拽了进去。整个操作持续了几秒钟。

paras.en: When the hole was narrower, common octopuses added a fourth step. They shoved all of their arms through the hole first and then squished their head and bulbous mantle through.
paras.zh: 当洞变窄时，普通章鱼会增加第四步。他们先把所有的手臂都塞进洞里，然后把头和球状的斗篷压进去。

paras.en: When a hole is smaller than their most rigid body parts, common octopuses add a fourth step to wrestle their bodies through an opening.
paras.zh: 当一个洞比它们最坚硬的身体部位还小时，普通章鱼会增加第四步，通过一个开口来扭动自己的身体。

paras.en: Mayan octopuses behaved more cautiously than the common octopuses. When confronted with the narrower hole, Mayan octopuses didn’t even attempt to fit inside of it. They usually ignored it. This difference between the species could stem from their biology or how they’ve adapted to their environments, Kuba says. Mayan octopuses live in sandy, rocky areas, so while they might disappear under rocks, they don’t often need to cram through holes, he says.
paras.zh: 玛雅章鱼的行为比普通章鱼更加谨慎。当面对较窄的洞时，玛雅章鱼甚至没有试图钻进去。他们通常会忽略它。库巴说，物种之间的这种差异可能源于它们的生物学特性或它们如何适应环境。他说，玛雅章鱼生活在沙地、岩石地区，因此虽然它们可能会消失在岩石下，但它们并不经常需要钻进洞里。

paras.en: The team hopes these escape artists will inspire new soft robots that can morph their shape to fit through tiny spaces, says Wenci Xin, a robotics researcher at the National University of Singapore. “This incredible capability could enable robots to overcome environmental limitations and enter spaces that are difficult to reach.”
paras.zh: 新加坡国立大学机器人研究员 Wenci Xin 表示，该团队希望这些逃脱艺术家能够激发新的软机器人的灵感，这些机器人可以改变自己的形状以适应狭小的空间。 “这种令人难以置信的能力可以使机器人克服环境限制并进入难以到达的空间。”

paras.en: Studying how octopuses navigate different types of holes may provide additional clues for robots, Crook says. For instance, the cephalopods may take a different tack for openings that are more like slits or tubes than holes.
paras.zh: 克鲁克说，研究章鱼如何穿过不同类型的洞可能为机器人提供更多线索。例如，头足类动物可能会采用不同的方法来处理更像狭缝或管子而不是孔的开口。

paras.en: Currently, robots built to fit through tiny holes tend to be snake-shaped, but further research on these eight-armed contortionists could unlock other configurations.
paras.zh: 目前，用于穿过小孔的机器人往往是蛇形的，但对这些八臂柔术演员的进一步研究可以解锁其他配置。

articles.title: Fossil fuel emissions are down in 2026. Green energy isn’t the reason
articles.author: Nikk Ogasa

paras.en: Scientists project that global carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuels will decrease by 0.4 percent this year, after having grown by 0.8 percent each year on average from 2019 to 2025.
paras.zh: 科学家预测，全球化石燃料二氧化碳排放量在 2019 年至 2025 年平均每年增长 0.8% 后，今年将减少 0.4%。

paras.en: But the dip may not last. The lower emissions are probably driven by high oil prices stemming from the Iran war, researchers report November 9 in Nature Climate Change.
paras.zh: 但这种下滑可能不会持续下去。研究人员 11 月 9 日在《自然·气候变化》杂志上报告称，排放量下降可能是由于伊朗战争引发的高油价所致。

paras.en: Global emissions probably would have grown again this year without the energy shock of the Iran war, says Glen Peters, a climate scientist at the Center for International Climate Research in Oslo, Norway. “So the energy transition that’s happening … it’s not quite big enough to get emissions heading downward yet.”
paras.zh: 挪威奥斯陆国际气候研究中心的气候科学家格伦·彼得斯表示，如果没有伊朗战争的能源冲击，今年全球排放量可能会再次增长。 “所以正在发生的能源转型……还没有大到足以使排放量下降。”

paras.en: For the study, Peters and his colleagues used data on countries’ electric vehicle stocks and wind and solar energy generation to project those technologies impacts on global fossil CO2 emissions through 2028. The team used the generative AI model Claude to source data and write code for analysis.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，Peters 和他的同事使用了各国电动汽车库存以及风能和太阳能发电的数据来预测这些技术对 2028 年全球化石二氧化碳排放的影响。该团队使用生成式人工智能模型 Claude 来获取数据并编写代码进行分析。

paras.en: By year’s end, global emissions will reach 38.24 gigatons, the researchers found, which is about 0.16 gigatons less than were emitted in 2025. For comparison, annual global emissions fell by nearly two gigatons in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic and by about 0.5 gigatons in 2009 because of the global financial crisis.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，到年底，全球排放量将达到 38.24 吉吨，比 2025 年的排放量减少约 0.16 吉吨。相比之下，由于 COVID-19 大流行，2020 年全球年排放量减少了近 2 吉吨，由于全球金融危机，2009 年全球年排放量减少了约 0.5 吉吨。

paras.en: If electric vehicle sales and solar and wind capacity continue growing at the rates they did in 2026, those technologies should counteract about 63 percent of the growth in emissions from 2025 to 2028 — or help avoid about 1.64 gigatons of added emissions.
paras.zh: 如果电动汽车销量以及太阳能和风能装机容量继续以 2026 年的速度增长，这些技术将抵消 2025 年至 2028 年排放量增长的约 63%，或者有助于避免约 1.64 吉吨的新增排放量。

paras.en: The results indicate that the energy transition needs to accelerate if humankind is to realize consistently declining emissions, though EVs, solar and wind are already having a large impact. Without the offset in emissions provided by those technologies, global emissions would have risen by 1.9 percent each year on average from 2019 to 2025, the researchers note.
paras.zh: 结果表明，尽管电动汽车、太阳能和风能已经产生了巨大影响，但如果人类要实现排放量持续下降，就需要加速能源转型。研究人员指出，如果没有这些技术带来的排放抵消，2019 年至 2025 年全球排放量将平均每年增加 1.9%。

paras.en: It’s very hard to say exactly how long it will take for humanity to reach peak emissions, Peters says. However, he notes, “the fact that we’re talking about this means that we’re close to that point.”
paras.zh: 彼得斯说，很难确切地说人类需要多长时间才能达到排放峰值。然而，他指出，“我们正在谈论这个事实意味着我们已经接近这一点。”

articles.title: Skin Regenerates Differently in Males And Females, Study in Mice Reveals
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Every 6–7 weeks, depending on age and body part, we get an entirely new outer layer (epidermis) of skin, due to the constant renewal of skin cells.
paras.zh: 每 6-7 周，根据年龄和身体部位，由于皮肤细胞的不断更新，我们就会获得全新的皮肤外层（表皮）。

paras.en: Now, new research suggests there are significant differences in how this happens in males and females.
paras.zh: 现在，新的研究表明，男性和女性的这种情况发生的方式存在显着差异。

paras.en: This has only been shown in mice so far, so we'll have to see whether it's the same in people, but the discovery could eventually lead to treatments that are better tailored depending on sex – for burns, wounds, skin conditions, and even skin cancers.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，这一现象只在老鼠身上得到了证实，所以我们必须看看它在人类身上是否也一样，但这一发现最终可能会导致根据性别更好地定制治疗方法——针对烧伤、伤口、皮肤病，甚至皮肤癌。

paras.en: The findings come from an international team of researchers, led by experts from the Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB) in Belgium and the University of Cambridge in the UK, who have published their work in Nature.
paras.zh: 该研究结果来自一个由来自比利时布鲁塞尔自由大学（ULB）和英国剑桥大学的专家领导的国际研究小组，他们的研究成果已发表在《自然》杂志上。

paras.en: Using a microscopy technique that enables living cells to be imaged through the skin, the researchers followed the stem cells that develop into epidermal skin cells across five months – an unusually long period for this kind of study.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用一种能够透过皮肤对活细胞进行成像的显微镜技术，对发育成表皮细胞的干细胞进行了五个月的跟踪——这对于此类研究来说是一个异常长的时间。

paras.en: "We initially set out to understand how the skin renews itself, and whether there is a hierarchy with stem cells at the top," says medical oncologist Dan Engelman from ULB.
paras.zh: ULB 的医学肿瘤学家 Dan Engelman 表示：“我们最初的目的是了解皮肤如何自我更新，以及干细胞是否处于顶层。”

paras.en: "We were surprised to discover strong differences in the way stem cells renew the skin in females and males."
paras.zh: “我们惊讶地发现女性和男性干细胞更新皮肤的方式存在巨大差异。”

paras.en: Stem cells act as source material for all kinds of different cell types in the body. In the bottom layer of the epidermis, stem cells multiply, forming both new stem cells and cells destined for the epidermis, where they act as a protective layer and are eventually shed.
paras.zh: 干细胞是体内各种不同细胞类型的来源材料。在表皮的底层，干细胞繁殖，形成新的干细胞和前往表皮的细胞，它们在表皮中充当保护层并最终脱落。

paras.en: Through their detailed, extended analysis, the researchers discovered there's also an intermediate stage, where division is limited – this helps to amplify cell production, and the presence or absence of this stage has long been debated by scientists.
paras.zh: 通过详细、扩展的分析，研究人员发现还有一个中间阶段，其中分裂受到限制，这有助于扩大细胞产量，而这个阶段是否存在长期以来一直受到科学家们的争论。

paras.en: Then there were the differences between the sexes.
paras.zh: 然后是性别之间的差异。

paras.en: "Critical to these conclusions was the discovery of sexual dimorphism in epidermal fate, with female mice showing a highly synchronized pattern of cell division, differentiation and delamination that contributes to accelerated wound healing," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“这些结论的关键是表皮命运中性别二态性的发现，雌性小鼠表现出高度同步的细胞分裂、分化和分层模式，有助于加速伤口愈合。”

paras.en: In plainer terms, female cells are renewed in a more synchronized, coordinated way, with divided cells working in pairs and making the same choices at the same time (to divide again or head for the outer layer). For males, cells act in a more individual way.
paras.zh: 更简单地说，雌性细胞以更加同步、协调的方式更新，分裂的细胞成对工作并同时做出相同的选择（再次分裂或前往外层）。对于男性来说，细胞以更加个体化的方式发挥作用。

paras.en: The researchers compare it to rowers synchronizing their strokes, and further tests on the mice suggested that it's partly why wounds heal faster in females (this is something scientists already know about, though the explanation isn't fully clear).
paras.zh: 研究人员将其与同步划水的划船者进行了比较，对小鼠的进一步测试表明，这就是雌性伤口愈合更快的部分原因（这是科学家已经知道的事情，尽管解释尚不完全清楚）。

paras.en: "It opens up a wide range of new questions, spanning from fundamental stem cell biology to clinical issues such as wound healing, cancer development, and autoimmune diseases," says developmental biologist Cédric Blanpain from ULB.
paras.zh: ULB 发育生物学家 Cédric Blanpain 表示：“它提出了一系列新问题，从基础干细胞生物学到伤口愈合、癌症发展和自身免疫性疾病等临床问题。”

paras.en: The researchers went further, removing the testes or ovaries from the mice to cut out testosterone or estrogen production, then replacing those hormones to see how it affected skin cell production.
paras.zh: 研究人员更进一步，切除了小鼠的睾丸或卵巢，以减少睾酮或雌激素的产生，然后替换这些激素，看看它如何影响皮肤细胞的产生。

paras.en: Manipulating the hormones showed testosterone sped up the rate at which new skin cells left the bottom layer – without it, the male skin cells behaved more like female ones. In the female mice, removing the estrogen removed most of the coordinated actions the researchers had previously observed.
paras.zh: 操纵激素显示睾酮加快了新皮肤细胞离开底层的速度——没有它，男性皮肤细胞的行为更像女性皮肤细胞。在雌性小鼠中，去除雌激素会消除研究人员之前观察到的大部分协调行为。

paras.en: Again, it's important to note that the study was in a small group of mice, though initial tests the team carried out on human skin cells in the lab suggest the same mechanisms are at play. More research will be needed to know for sure.
paras.zh: 再次值得注意的是，这项研究是在一小群老鼠身上进行的，尽管该团队在实验室中对人类皮肤细胞进行的初步测试表明，同样的机制正在发挥作用。需要更多的研究才能确定。

paras.en: Expanding the analysis of the human skin cells is the obvious next step for the researchers, to see if this really is another way the sexes differ.
paras.zh: 研究人员的下一步显然是扩大对人类皮肤细胞的分析，看看这是否真的是性别差异的另一种方式。

paras.en: "Sex is a parameter too often overlooked in biology and medicine," says Blanpain.
paras.zh: “性别是生物学和医学中经常被忽视的一个参数，”布兰潘说。

paras.en: "We will now investigate the differences between males and females during the formation and progression of skin cancers, as well as the molecular mechanisms responsible for these differences."
paras.zh: “我们现在将研究男性和女性在皮肤癌形成和进展过程中的差异，以及造成这些差异的分子机制。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然》杂志上。

articles.title: Scientists Simulated What Earth Would Be Like if Life Never Existed
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: We're here. We're not entirely sure how we got here, but we're here.
paras.zh: 我们到了。我们并不完全确定我们是如何到达这里的，但我们就在这里。

paras.en: That's the question scientists posed in a new study, simulating an alternative vision of Earth where life, uh, never found a way.
paras.zh: 这是科学家在一项新研究中提出的问题，模拟了地球的另一种景象，在那里生命，呃，从未找到出路。

paras.en: The findings, reported in The Planetary Science Journal, aren't just a surreal thought experiment.
paras.zh: 《行星科学杂志》报道的这一发现不仅仅是一个超现实的思想实验。

paras.en: It's also a serious scientific question, and a new investigation of the ideas behind the Gaia hypothesis.
paras.zh: 这也是一个严肃的科学问题，也是对盖亚假说背后的想法的新调查。

paras.en: The Gaia hypothesis – not to be confused with the mythologically similar-sounding Theia hypothesis – proposes that life on Earth interacts with the planet's physical environment in ways that help maintain a habitable world, producing a kind of planetary homeostasis.
paras.zh: 盖亚假说（不要与神话中听起来相似的忒亚假说混淆）提出，地球上的生命与地球的物理环境相互作用，有助于维持宜居世界，产生一种行星稳态。

paras.en: In the new research, led by astrobiologist Samantha Gilbert-Janizek at the University of Washington, scientists wound back the clock to see how Earth might develop over billions of years – devoid of any such hypothetical helping hand.
paras.zh: 在华盛顿大学天体生物学家萨曼莎·吉尔伯特·贾尼泽克领导的这项新研究中，科学家们将时间倒转，看看地球在没有任何此类假想的帮助的情况下会如何发展数十亿年。

paras.en: "An open question regarding Earth's evolution is whether or not it could be habitable over billion-year timescales without life's influence on the environment," the researchers write in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“关于地球演化的一个悬而未决的问题是，在没有生命对环境影响的情况下，它是否可以在数十亿年的时间尺度内适宜居住。”

paras.en: "Clearly, biology plays an important role in Earth's surface environment, which motivates our central question: Is life required to maintain the long-term habitability of a rocky planet?"
paras.zh: “显然，生物学在地球表面环境中发挥着重要作用，这引发了我们的核心问题：维持岩石行星的长期宜居性是否需要生命？”

paras.en: In their study, Gilbert-Janizek and colleagues developed a sophisticated computer model of an Earth without life, but incorporating everything else in its physical environment – including the planet's core, mantle, crust, atmosphere, oceans, and incoming solar flux – and calculated how chemicals would cycle between different parts of the planet.
paras.zh: 在他们的研究中，吉尔伯特·贾尼泽克和同事开发了一个没有生命的地球的复杂计算机模型，但将其物理环境中的其他一切（包括地核、地幔、地壳、大气、海洋和传入的太阳通量）结合起来，并计算了化学物质如何在地球不同部分之间循环。
