articles.title: England duo ruled out of rest of Nations Championship

paras.en: Nations Championship: England's Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry ruled out of rest of tournament
paras.zh: 国锦赛：英格兰选手伊曼纽尔·费伊·瓦博索和汤姆·库里被排除在剩余比赛之外

paras.en: Steve Borthwick's side have been hit by a raft of injuries ahead of their Nations Championship clash against Japan; Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry have been ruled out of the autumn series
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·博思威克的球队在与日本的国家锦标赛交锋之前遭遇了一系列伤病。伊曼纽尔·费伊-瓦博索和汤姆·库里已被排除在秋季系列赛之外

paras.en: England will be without Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry for the remainder of their Nations Championship campaign after both players were ruled out due to injury.
paras.zh: 英格兰队将缺席伊曼纽尔·费伊-瓦博索和汤姆·库里的国家锦标赛剩余比赛，此前两名球员均因伤缺席。

paras.en: It comes as Steve Borthwick's side has been hit with a series of injuries ahead of their clash against Japan on Saturday.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·博思威克的球队在周六对阵日本的比赛之前遭受了一系列伤病。

paras.en: Seb Atkinson, who came off in the second-half of England's 45-22 win against Australia, is set to miss the match with a hip injury, along with Ollie Chessum (shoulder) and George Furbank (groin).
paras.zh: 英格兰队以 45-22 战胜澳大利亚队的比赛中，塞布·阿特金森 (Seb Atkinson) 在下半场下场，他将因臀部受伤而缺席比赛，奥利·切森 (Ollie Chessum)（肩膀）和乔治·福班克 (George Furbank)（腹股沟）也将缺席比赛。

paras.en: England are optimistic the trio will be available for their clash against New Zealand at Allianz Stadium on Saturday, November 21.
paras.zh: 英格兰队乐观地认为这三人将能够参加 11 月 21 日星期六在安联球场对阵新西兰队的比赛。

paras.en: Feyi-Waboso sustained an injury to his right ankle during the first-half of England's clash against the Wallabies, following a hip-drop tackle by Australia prop Angus Bell.
paras.zh: 费伊-瓦博索在英格兰对阵小袋鼠队的上半场比赛中，因澳大利亚队球员安格斯·贝尔的臀部铲断而右脚踝受伤。

paras.en: Bell was later sent to the sin bin, with Henry Pollock coming on to replace Feyi-Waboso on the wing at half-time. Pollock would go on to score twice.
paras.zh: 贝尔后来被送进了垃圾箱，亨利·波洛克在半场结束时取代了边路的费伊-瓦博索。波洛克随后梅开二度。

paras.en: The Exeter winger's absence could see Borthwick call on Saracens fliers Noah Caluori or Tobias Elliott for England's clash against Japan.
paras.zh: 这位埃克塞特边锋的缺席可能会让博思威克在英格兰对阵日本的比赛中派上撒拉逊人球员诺亚·卡洛里或托比亚斯·埃利奥特。

paras.en: It would be Caluori's third cap for England, having made his senior debut during their Nations Championship clash against Fiji in July.
paras.zh: 这将是卡洛里第三次代表英格兰国家队出场，他在七月份对阵斐济的国家锦标赛上首次亮相。

paras.en: Centres Joe Marchant and Will Joseph could also be considered as wing options, while Fraser Dingwall or Max Ojomoh are likely to take the No 12 jersey in place of Atkinson.
paras.zh: 中锋乔·马钱特和威尔·约瑟夫也可以被考虑作为侧翼选择，而弗雷泽·丁沃尔或马克斯·奥乔莫可能会代替阿特金森穿上12号球衣。

paras.en: Curry did not feature in England's win over Australia after he sustained a hip injury during training last week.
paras.zh: 库里在上周训练中臀部受伤，没有参加英格兰队战胜澳大利亚队的比赛。

paras.en: Borthwick revealed after Sunday's win that his brother, Ben Curry, was unlikely to start against Japan, despite the openside enjoying an excellent outing against the Wallabies.
paras.zh: 博思威克在周日获胜后透露，尽管在对阵袋鼠队的比赛中表现出色，但他的兄弟本·库里不太可能在对阵日本队的比赛中首发。

paras.en: It is likely Borthwick could deploy Freddie Steward at full-back in place of Furbank and keep Marcus Smith on the bench as utility cover.
paras.zh: 博思威克很可能会用弗雷迪·斯图尔特代替弗班克担任边后卫，并让马库斯·史密斯坐在替补席上作为替补。

paras.en: England's 36-player squad returned to Pennyhill Park on Monday to prepare for this weekend's clash, with Jack Kenningham and Max Hicks both being drafted into the squad as back-row cover for Ben Curry and Chessum.
paras.zh: 英格兰队的 36 名球员周一返回彭尼希尔公园，为本周末的比赛做准备，杰克·肯宁汉姆和马克斯·希克斯都被选入球队，作为本·库里和切瑟姆的后排替补。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Archie McParland has returned to the training squad after recovering from a calf injury.
paras.zh: 与此同时，阿奇·麦克帕兰从小腿伤势恢复后回到了训练队。

paras.en: Rehabilitation: Seb Atkinson (Gloucester Rugby), Ollie Chessum (Leicester Tigers), George Furbank (Harlequins)
paras.zh: 康复：Seb Atkinson（格洛斯特橄榄球队）、Ollie Chessum（莱斯特老虎队）、George Furbank（丑角队）

articles.title: Sabalenka starts pursuit of WTA Finals title with opening win

paras.en: WTA Finals: Aryna Sabalenka battles past Karolina Muchova in her opening match at Indian Wells
paras.zh: WTA 总决赛：阿琳娜·萨巴伦卡 (Aryna Sabalenka) 在印第安维尔斯 (Indian Wells) 首场比赛中击败卡罗琳娜·穆乔娃 (Karolina Muchova)

paras.en: Aryna Sabalenka won her Group 2 opener against Karolina Muchova 7-6 (7-2) 7-5; the four-time Grand Slam champion is looking to win the WTA Finals for the first time; watch the WTA Finals from Indian Wells this week, live on Sky Sports Tennis
paras.zh: 阿琳娜·萨巴伦卡 (Aryna Sabalenka) 在第 2 组首场比赛中以 7-6 (7-2) 7-5 战胜卡罗琳娜·穆乔娃 (Karolina Muchova)；这位四届大满贯冠军希望首次赢得 WTA 总决赛冠军；观看本周在印第安维尔斯举行的 WTA 总决赛，天空体育网球直播

paras.en: Aryna Sabalenka got off to a winning start at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells, battling past Karolina Muchova 7-6 (7-2) 7-5 in the opening match in Group 2 on Monday.
paras.zh: 周一，阿琳娜·萨巴伦卡 (Aryna Sabalenka) 在印第安维尔斯举行的 WTA 年终总决赛第 2 组首场比赛中以 7-6 (7-2) 7-5 战胜卡罗琳娜·穆乔娃 (Karolina Muchova)，取得了胜利。

paras.en: A two-time beaten finalist in the WTA Finals - including going down last year to Elena Rybakina, who stole her No 1 ranking this season - Sabalenka is looking to win the tournament for the first time.
paras.zh: 萨巴伦卡曾两次在 WTA 总决赛中被击败进入决赛，去年输给了本赛季排名第一的埃琳娜·雷巴基娜 (Elena Rybakina)，萨巴伦卡有望首次赢得这项赛事。

paras.en: Rybakina's late withdrawal due to a viral illness and fatigue aids Sabalenka's hopes, as does her opening victory over Wimbledon finalist Muchova, who made her sweat for it in a hugely-absorbing contest that ran six minutes shy of two hours.
paras.zh: 雷巴基娜因病毒性疾病和疲劳而迟早退出，这让萨巴伦卡的希望更加渺茫，她在首场比赛中击败温布尔登决赛选手穆乔娃也为萨巴伦卡带来了希望，穆乔娃在一场引人入胜的比赛中挥汗如雨，这场比赛只用了六分钟，还差两小时。

paras.en: Sabalenka was first to blink on serve in the first set, Muchova breaking for a 3-2 advantage, and again to lead 5-4, only for her opponent to break back immediately on both occasions - the second time when the Czech world No 7 was serving to take the opener.
paras.zh: 首盘萨巴伦卡率先在发球局中闪现，穆乔娃破发以3-2领先，并再次以5-4领先，但两次都被对手立即破发——第二次是在捷克世界排名第七的发球局中拿下首盘。

paras.en: Sabalenka then spurned a couple of set points in Muchova's next service game, but dominated the resulting tiebreaker, dropping just two points.

paras.zh: 第二盘的走势与第一盘类似，不过这一次是萨巴伦卡两次破发，但四届大满贯冠军在发球局中取得决定性破发，以6-5领先，随后在第二个赛点上锁定胜局。

articles.title: Birmingham announce shock Brady departure

paras.en: Tom Brady leaves Birmingham: NFL legend and minority owner makes shock departure after three years
paras.zh: 汤姆·布雷迪离开伯明翰：NFL传奇人物和少数股东在三年后令人震惊地离开

paras.en: NFL legend and seven-time Super Bowl winner Tom Brady leaves Birmingham in surprise departure; Minority owner bought just over three per cent stake in St Andrew's club in August 2023 and leaves them top of Championship
paras.zh: NFL 传奇人物、七届超级碗冠军汤姆·布雷迪 (Tom Brady) 出人意料地离开伯明翰；少数股东于 2023 年 8 月购买了圣安德鲁俱乐部 3% 多一点的股份，使他们成为英冠冠军球队

paras.en: Birmingham have announced the shock departure of NFL legend Tom Brady as minority owner with the Bluenoses sitting top of the Championship table.
paras.zh: 伯明翰宣布 NFL 传奇人物汤姆·布雷迪（Tom Brady）作为少数股东的身份令人震惊地离开，蓝鼻队（Bluenoses）位居冠军榜榜首。

paras.en: In a statement, the club said: "Birmingham City Football Club expresses its sincere gratitude to Tom Brady for his involvement with and unwavering support for the club over the last three years.
paras.zh: 俱乐部在一份声明中表示：“伯明翰城足球俱乐部对汤姆·布雷迪在过去三年中对俱乐部的参与和坚定支持表示诚挚的感谢。

paras.en: "It was truly amazing to have someone with Tom's experience and passion associated with the club, and the club looks forward to continuing to build on that foundation from the training ground to the Birmingham community."
paras.zh: “拥有像汤姆这样的经验和热情的人与俱乐部联系在一起真是太棒了，俱乐部期待着在这个基础上继续发展，从训练场到伯明翰社区。”

paras.zh: 一个夏天的巨额支出，包括以创纪录的1500万英镑签下英格兰U21前锋杰伊·斯坦斯菲尔德（Jay Stansfield）的三级联赛，让他们在第一次提出要求时就重返英冠，然后俱乐部在回到第二级联赛的第一个赛季中取得了第10名的成绩。

paras.en: Brady leaves the club top of the table following Saturday's 2-1 win over Swansea following a run of seven wins from their last nine games.
paras.zh: 周六2-1战胜斯旺西后，布雷迪在过去九场比赛中取得了七场胜利，离开了俱乐部榜首。

articles.title: Gunman with far-right views who killed 6 in Poland shooting rampage dies in hospital
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: The man who killed six people and wounded 15 others in a suspected far-right terror attack in the Polish city of Kraków, has died, police said early Monday.
paras.zh: 警方周一早些时候表示，在波兰克拉科夫市发生的疑似极右翼恐怖袭击中，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤的男子已经死亡。

paras.en: Michał Oksiński, passed away at 4:30 a.m. local time (10:30 p.m. ET), authorities said. He had been in critical condition since the attack and had undergone several operations.
paras.zh: 当局称，米哈乌·奥克辛斯基 (Michał Oksiński) 于当地时间凌晨 4:30（美国东部时间晚上 10:30）去世。自袭击发生以来，他一直处于危急状态，并接受了多次手术。

paras.en: The 24-year-old was shot by police during Saturday’s midday rampage in Main Market Square, the historic center and major tourist destination in Poland’s second-largest city.
paras.zh: 周六中午，波兰第二大城市的历史中心和主要旅游目的地主集市广场发生骚乱，这名 24 岁的男子被警察开枪射杀。

paras.en: Four women and two men were killed in the shooting. Three of the women and one of the men were Polish, authorities said. A British man and an Austrian woman were among the dead, they said.
paras.zh: 四名妇女和两名男子在枪击事件中丧生。当局称，其中三名女性和一名男性是波兰人。他们说，死者中有一名英国男子和一名奥地利妇女。

paras.en: Two police officers were in “serious” condition after they were injured along with dozens of others during the attack, regional official Krzysztof Jan Klęczar said Sunday. Five foreigners, from the U.K., Portugal, Russia, Germany and Austria, were injured, officials said.
paras.zh: 地区官员克日什托夫·扬·克勒查周日表示，两名警察在袭击中与其他数十人一起受伤，伤势“严重”。官员称，来自英国、葡萄牙、俄罗斯、德国和奥地利的五名外国人受伤。

paras.en: The bodies of Oksiński’s sister, mother and father were found at the family home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, about 90 miles northeast of Kraków, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，奥克辛斯基的姐姐、母亲和父亲的尸体在位于克拉科夫东北约 90 英里的奥斯特罗维茨维托克日斯基 (Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski) 的家中被发现。

paras.en: Very little information has come out about Oksiński, but Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said Saturday he used an automatic rifle to carry out the attack and that he “was fascinated by far-right ideologies.” The shooter held “very radical” and “ultranationalistic” views, Kierwiński added.
paras.zh: 关于奥克辛斯基的信息很少，但内政部长马尔辛·基尔文斯基周六表示，他使用自动步枪进行了袭击，并且他“对极右意识形态着迷”。基尔文斯基补充说，枪手持有“非常激进”和“超民族主义”的观点。

paras.en: Authorities were still examining the evidence Monday.
paras.zh: 当局周一仍在审查证据。

paras.en: The nationalist opposition has questioned the grounds on which the motive was established, with Law & Justice party leader Jaroslaw Kaczynski saying the claims were a “blatant lie.”
paras.zh: 民族主义反对派质疑这一动机的成立依据，法律与正义党领导人雅罗斯瓦夫·卡钦斯基表示，这些说法是“公然的谎言”。

paras.en: And National Prosecutor’s Office spokesperson Przemyslaw Nowak told a news conference on Monday that investigators did not yet know what motivated the killer.
paras.zh: 国家检察官办公室发言人普热米斯瓦夫·诺瓦克在周一的新闻发布会上表示，调查人员尚不清楚凶手的动机。

paras.en: He said that a yellow flag with a snake and the words “Don’t tread on me” on it, known as the Gadsden flag, was found in his room.
paras.zh: 他说，在他的房间里发现了一面带有蛇的黄色旗帜，上面写着“别踩我”，被称为加兹登旗帜。

paras.en: First used during the American Revolution in the 18th century, Nowak said the flag was associated with “various meanings related to freedom or rebellion” but was not widely known as being linked to any form of extremism.
paras.zh: 诺瓦克在 18 世纪的美国革命期间首次使用该旗帜，他表示这面旗帜与“与自由或叛乱相关的各种含义”相关联，但并未被广泛认为与任何形式的极端主义有关。

paras.en: Interior Ministry spokesperson Karolina Galecka said there were many different emblems on the perpetrator’s clothing that had already been partially examined and interpreted.
paras.zh: 内政部发言人卡罗琳娜·加莱卡(Karolina Galecka)表示，肇事者的衣服上有许多不同的标志，这些标志已经过部分检查和解释。

paras.en: Separately, government spokesperson Adam Szlapka told Polish broadcaster TVN24 that it was “best to refrain from making comments” about Oksiński’s political views “until the matter is fully clarified and the authorities are in possession of complete information,” even if there were “some initial indications.”
paras.zh: 另外，政府发言人 Adam Szlapka 告诉波兰广播公司 TVN24，即使有“一些初步迹象”，“最好不要对奥克辛斯基的政治观点发表评论，直到事情完全澄清并且当局掌握完整信息”。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Justice Minister Waldemar Zurek told Radio Zet that the investigation would continue to establish if Oksiński acted alone or was inspired by any group.
paras.zh: 另一方面，司法部长瓦尔德马·祖雷克 (Waldemar Zurek) 告诉 Zet 广播电台，调查将继续确定奥克辛斯基是否单独行动或受到任何团体的启发。

paras.en: However, authorities have said they believed the attacker killed his family, possibly while they slept, before heading to Krakow.
paras.zh: 然而，当局表示，他们相信袭击者在前往克拉科夫之前杀死了他的家人，可能是在他们睡觉时杀害的。

paras.en: Seven weapons were found in the family home, bringing the total recovered to 11, prosecutors said. Four others, including two AR-15 semi-automatic rifles, were found on the attacker or in his car in Krakow. Dozens, if not hundreds, of shots were fired during the attack, they said.
paras.zh: 检察官称，在这家人的家中发现了 7 件武器，使查获的武器总数达到 11 件。在克拉科夫的袭击者身上或他的车里还发现了另外四支枪，其中包括两支 AR-15 半自动步枪。他们说，袭击期间开了数十枪，甚至数百枪。

paras.en: However, it has emerged that Oksiński and his father held gun permits and he had trained at a local shooting club, which said in a statement that he “was never trained in our club in the areas of dynamic, tactical or combat shooting.”
paras.zh: 然而，有消息称，奥克辛斯基和他的父亲持有枪支许可证，他曾在当地一家射击俱乐部接受过训练，该俱乐部在一份声明中表示，他“从未在我们的俱乐部接受过动态、战术或格斗射击领域的培训”。

paras.en: Poland had never experienced such a large mass shooting and the scenes of bodies and blood strewn across the heart of one of its most historic cities has shocked people in a nation that has long viewed itself as safer than its Western European neighbors.
paras.zh: 波兰从未经历过如此大规模的枪击事件，在其最具历史意义的城市之一的中心地带，尸体和血迹遍布的场景让这个长期以来一直认为自己比西欧邻国更安全的国家的人们感到震惊。

articles.title: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assaults
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: LONDON — British comedian and actor Russell Brand was sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for rape and sexual assault by a London court on Monday.
paras.zh: 伦敦——周一，英国喜剧演员兼演员拉塞尔·布兰德因强奸和性侵犯被伦敦一家法院判处 10 年零 6 个月监禁。

paras.en: The lengthy prison term completes a stunning fall from grace for Brand, 51, who found fame on both sides of the Atlantic chronicling his promiscuity and battles with addiction.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德因记录自己的滥交和与毒瘾的斗争而在大西洋两岸声名鹊起，漫长的监狱生涯让他彻底失宠。

paras.en: He was found guilty Thursday of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. He had pleaded not guilty to all counts and denied all of the allegations.
paras.zh: 周四，他被判犯有一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪。他对所有罪名均表示不认罪，并否认所有指控。

paras.en: Brand appeared in the London court Monday wearing a dark suit and at times making a sign of the cross, as the judge, Justice Joel Bennathan, called him a “sexual predator” before delivering his sentence. The judge had warned last week that Brand faced a “significant” prison term for his crimes.
paras.zh: 布兰德周一出现在伦敦法庭，身穿深色西装，有时还比划着十字，法官乔尔·本纳森(Joel Bennathan)在宣判前称他为“性掠夺者”。法官上周警告说，布兰德因其罪行将面临“重度”监禁。

paras.en: Stressing that he had to be careful not to punish Brand more “because you are famous,” the judge also paid tribute to the “determination and bravery” of the women who testified against him.
paras.zh: 法官强调，他必须小心，不要“因为你出名”而对布兰德进行更多惩罚，法官还赞扬了那些作证指控他的女性的“决心和勇敢”。

paras.en: “Whatever women wear, wherever they go, indeed whatever they drink, they retain the right to say no and to demand justice from the criminal courts when sexual predators like you, Russell Brand, act without their consent,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“无论女性穿什么，去哪里，喝什么，当像你拉塞尔·布兰德这样的性掠夺者未经她们同意的情况下采取行动时，她们都保留说不的权利，并要求刑事法庭伸张正义。”

paras.en: Under English law, the maximum sentence for rape is life imprisonment, and 10 years for one count of sexual assault, according to Britain’s sentencing council.
paras.zh: 英国量刑委员会表示，根据英国法律，强奸罪的最高刑罚是无期徒刑，而一项性侵犯罪的最高刑罚是十年监禁。

paras.en: Brand’s female victims told the court Monday — in person and in written statements — that they were still living with the trauma and effects in their daily lives.
paras.zh: 布兰德的女性受害者周一以亲自和书面陈述的形式告诉法庭，她们仍然生活在日常生活中的创伤和影响中。

paras.en: “I’ve been in shock and turmoil for years,” one woman told the sentencing hearing, while another said he appeared to show “no remorse.” Victims of alleged sexual offenses are granted anonymity for life under British law.
paras.zh: 一名女性在量刑听证会上表示，“多年来我一直处于震惊和混乱之中”，而另一名女性则表示，他似乎“没有悔意”。根据英国法律，涉嫌性犯罪的受害者可以终身匿名。

paras.en: Since Brand’s conviction, London’s Metropolitan Police said it had provided prosecutors with investigations into two more rape allegations against him.
paras.zh: 自布兰德被定罪以来，伦敦大都会警察局表示，已向检察官提供了对布兰德另外两起强奸指控的调查。

paras.en: Asked by reporters whether he had a message for the victims as he left court, Brand’s father Ron Brand said he didn’t care about them and suggested they had “chased and harassed” his son. He added that he didn’t believe in the justice system “on the basis of what I just watched.”
paras.zh: 当记者问他离开法庭时是否有什么话要对受害者说时，布兰德的父亲罗恩·布兰德表示，他并不关心他们，并暗示他们“追逐和骚扰”了他的儿子。他补充说，“根据我刚刚看到的情况”，他不相信司法系统。

paras.en: Brand’s case has renewed scrutiny on the ethics of the entertainment industry, through which Brand rose from a flamboyant British broadcaster and stand-up comedian to a star of Hollywood movies.
paras.zh: 布兰德案让娱乐业道德重新受到审视，布兰德从一位浮夸的英国播音员和单口喜剧演员一跃成为好莱坞电影明星。

paras.en: After the four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court in London, a jury of eight men and four women found Brand guilty of having raped a female fan at his home after she met him at one of his shows in 2009.
paras.zh: 在伦敦南华克皇家法院进行了为期四个星期的审判后，由八名男子和四名女子组成的陪审团裁定布兰德犯有在他家中强奸一名女粉丝的罪名，当时这名女粉丝是在 2009 年布兰德的一场演出中认识他的。

paras.en: He was also found guilty of sexually assaulting a woman whose breasts he grabbed at a party in 2004, and another woman who said he had kissed and groped her at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005.
paras.zh: 他还被判犯有2004年在一次聚会上性侵犯一名女子的罪名，后者曾在一次聚会上抓住她的胸部，以及2004年或2005年在伦敦一家广播电台亲吻并抚摸另一名女子的罪名。

paras.en: He was found not guilty of two other counts of rape and one count of attempted indecent assault.
paras.zh: 他被判犯有另外两项强奸罪和一项未遂猥亵罪。

paras.en: Prosecutors said the women do not know one another and that they separately went to police after a TV documentary was broadcast in Britain in 2023.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，这些妇女彼此不认识，2023 年一部电视纪录片在英国播出后，她们分别向警方报案。

paras.en: During the trial, prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones called Brand a ruthless, calculating, manipulative “sexual predator” who treated women as a “disposable commodity.”
paras.zh: 在审判期间，检察官里尔·卡米·琼斯称布兰德是一个冷酷无情、精于算计、善于操纵的“性掠夺者”，他将女性视为“一次性商品”。

paras.en: Brand admitted in his testimony to being sex-obsessed as a young and famous man. He denied ever having nonconsensual sex.
paras.zh: 布兰德在证词中承认，作为一名年轻的名人，他对性很痴迷。他否认曾发生过未经同意的性行为。

paras.en: At the height of his fame, Brand featured in several Hollywood movies, including “Forgetting Sarah Marshall” and “Get Him to the Greek.” His fame stateside was cemented when he briefly wed singer Katy Perry in a lavish ceremony in India in 2010. The couple divorced in 2012.
paras.zh: 在他的名声鼎盛时期，布兰德出演了多部好莱坞电影，包括《忘记莎拉·马歇尔》和《带他去希腊》。 2010 年，他在印度与歌手凯蒂·佩里 (Katy Perry) 举行了一场盛大的婚礼，短暂结婚后，他在美国的名声进一步巩固。两人于 2012 年离婚。

paras.en: Brand’s current wife, Laura Gallacher, was in the courtroom Monday and had previously testified that he was a “caring, kind and a wonderful father.” The couple married in 2017 and have three young children.
paras.zh: 布兰德现任妻子劳拉·加拉赫周一在法庭上，此前曾作证称布兰德是一位“有爱心、善良、很棒的父亲”。这对夫妇于 2017 年结婚，育有三个年幼的孩子。

paras.en: In recent years, Brand had moved away from mainstream media, becoming an anti-establishment commentator. He briefly relocated to Florida and has built a large online following with videos that discuss U.S. politics, wellness, conspiracy theories and his newfound Christian faith.
paras.zh: 近年来，布兰德逐渐远离主流媒体，成为一名反建制评论员。他短暂移居佛罗里达州，并通过讨论美国政治、健康、阴谋论和他新发现的基督教信仰的视频在网上建立了大批追随者。

paras.en: Speaking after the sentencing, Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy told reporters that the sentence marked “a significant milestone in our investigation and means Russell Brand has been held accountable for his crimes.”
paras.zh: 侦探警司安迪·弗菲在宣判后对记者表示，这一判决标志着“我们调查的一个重要里程碑，意味着拉塞尔·布兰德已被追究其罪行的责任”。

paras.en: Praising the victims, he said: “Reporting sexual offences can be incredibly difficult, and they have shown immense bravery, dignity and resilience throughout what has been a lengthy investigation and challenging trial process.
paras.zh: 他赞扬受害者说：“举报性犯罪可能非常困难，但在漫长的调查和充满挑战的审判过程中，他们表现出了巨大的勇气、尊严和韧性。

paras.en: “The victims have had to revisit deeply traumatic experiences and endure significant public and media attention. I hope today’s outcome provides some measure of closure and allows them to continue rebuilding their lives.”
paras.zh: “受害者不得不重新审视深深的创伤经历，并承受公众和媒体的广泛关注。我希望今天的结果能够在一定程度上结束，让他们能够继续重建自己的生活。”

paras.en: If you or someone you know has been sexually assaulted, call the National Sexual Assault Hotline at 1-800-656-4673. The hotline, run by the Rape, Abuse, & Incest National Network (RAINN), can put you in contact with your local rape crisis center. You can also access RAINN’s online chat service at rainn.org/get-help.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人遭到性侵犯，请拨打全国性侵犯热线 1-800-656-4673。该热线由全国强奸、虐待和乱伦网络 (RAINN) 运营，可以让您与当地的强奸危机中心取得联系。您还可以访问 Rainn.org/get-help 访问 RAINN 的在线聊天服务。

articles.title: Breaking: 81-year-old sci-fi writer becomes oldest-ever winner of $95k Booker Prize
articles.author: Hannah Story

paras.en: At 81 years old, M John Harrison has become the oldest winner of the Booker Prize, worth 50,000 British pounds ($95,000).
paras.zh: 81 岁的约翰·哈里森 (M John Harrison) 成为布克奖最年长的获奖者，奖金为 50,000 英镑（95,000 美元）。

paras.en: The English author, known for his sci-fi and fantasy books, won the award for his dystopian novel The End of Everything, about a man and his aunt living in the south of England in the decades after a mysterious invasion has led to society's collapse.
paras.zh: 这位以科幻和奇幻小说闻名的英国作家以其反乌托邦小说《一切的终结》赢得了该奖项，该小说讲述了一场神秘入侵导致社会崩溃后，一名男子和他的姨妈在英格兰南部生活了几十年的故事。

paras.en: The novel opens as scavenger Phillip Tennent finds a bundle on the beach. He takes the "artefact" — a "biological gadget" discarded by the invading iGhetti — to the home of his artist aunt Marnie, whose memory is failing.
paras.zh: 小说以拾荒者菲利普·坦南特在海滩上发现一个包裹开始。他把这个“人工制品”——入侵的伊盖蒂人丢弃的“生物装置”——带到了他的艺术家姨妈玛妮的家，玛妮的记忆正在衰退。

paras.en: But Marnie is immediately wary of the bundle, which, to her, seems to be growing in size as they speak.
paras.zh: 但玛妮立即对这个包裹感到警惕，在她看来，在他们说话的时候，这个包裹似乎在变大。

paras.en: First inspired to write The End of Everything by the 2008 global financial crisis, Harrison told the Booker Prize the book's themes and satire sprang from current affairs.
paras.zh: 哈里森最初受到 2008 年全球金融危机的启发，开始创作《一切的终结》，他在布克奖上表示，这本书的主题和讽刺都源于时事。

paras.en: "What happens when all of our expectations and explanations of the world become an ongoing disaster, but we still have to make a life?" he said.
paras.zh: “当我们对世界的所有期望和解释都变成一场持续的灾难，但我们仍然要谋生时，会发生什么？”他说。

paras.en: Accepting the award at a ceremony in London on Monday night, UK time, Harrison said the Booker is important in a "landscape of industrialised fiction".
paras.zh: 英国时间周一晚上，哈里森在伦敦举行的颁奖典礼上接受颁奖时表示，布克奖在“工业化小说领域”中具有重要意义。

paras.en: "I really didn't expect to be up here this evening," he said. "I honestly didn't, here at the end of everything."
paras.zh: “我真的没想到今晚会在这里，”他说。 “老实说，我没有，在一切结束的时候。”

paras.en: "You talk glibly about your life being changed but it's weird when it happens. I feel like a proper writer at last, totally lacking in confidence."
paras.zh: “你洋洋自得地谈论你的生活被改变了，但当它发生时，感觉很奇怪。我终于觉得自己像一个合适的作家了，完全缺乏自信。”

paras.en: He went on to thank his publisher Serpent's Tail and partner Casper for being patient with him, a self-described "complete lunatic".
paras.zh: 他接着感谢他的出版商《Serpent's Tail》和合作伙伴卡斯珀对他的耐心，他自称是“彻底的疯子”。

paras.en: "No-one writes a novel alone," he said. "I've had so much support across the last 40 or 50 years that at this point my input seems to be the least of it."
paras.zh: “没有人能独自写小说，”他说。 “在过去的 40 或 50 年里，我得到了如此多的支持，但在这一点上，我的投入似乎是最少的。”

paras.en: Asked on stage what kind of message he hopes readers take from The End of Everything, Harrison was frank.
paras.zh: 当在台上被问及他希望读者从《一切的终结》中得到什么样的信息时，哈里森很坦率。

paras.en: "It's a grim world and it will keep on being grim," he said. "And it's weird; there's something distinctly weird about it.
paras.zh: “这是一个严峻的世界，而且会继续严峻，”他说。 “这很奇怪；这里面有一些明显奇怪的东西。

paras.en: "But at the end of things there may be some kind of, I wouldn't say hope or closure, but there might be some kind of relief."
paras.zh: “但在事情结束时，可能会有某种，我不会说希望或结束，但可能会有某种缓解。”

paras.en: Chair of the Booker judges, classicist Mary Beard, described The End of Everything as "the politics of now seen through the lens of the future".
paras.zh: 布克评委主席、古典主义者玛丽·比尔德将《一切的终结》描述为“通过未来的镜头看到的现在的政治”。

paras.en: "One main point of the book is that if, or when, such an apocalypse comes it will be incomprehensible. And the old rules won't matter either," she said.
paras.zh: “这本书的一个要点是，如果或何时发生这样的灾难，那将是不可理解的。旧的规则也不再重要，”她说。

paras.en: "[The End of Everything is] a book that turns you upside down, raises a wry smile — and surprisingly, given the subject matter, leaves you with a twinge of optimism."
paras.zh: “《一切的终结》是一本让你天翻地覆、令人苦笑的书，而且令人惊讶的是，考虑到这个主题，它会让你感到一丝乐观。”

paras.en: Beard added the book was unanimously chosen by the judges — among them Booker-shortlisted writer Patricia Lockwood and Pulp frontman Jarvis Cocker — as the winner.
paras.zh: 比尔德补充说，这本书被评委们一致选为获胜者，其中包括布克奖入围作家帕特里夏·洛克伍德和纸浆乐队主唱贾维斯·科克。

paras.en: It bested the latest books from two previous Booker winners, Douglas Stuart and frontrunner Marlon James; two-time shortlistee Elizabeth Strout, and two other English authors, who are also poets, Luke Kennard and Rebecca Perry.
paras.zh: 它击败了前两位布克奖得主道格拉斯·斯图尔特和领跑者马龙·詹姆斯的最新书籍；两次入围的伊丽莎白·斯特劳特，以及另外两位英国作家，同时也是诗人，卢克·肯纳德和丽贝卡·佩里。

paras.en: While Harrison has never been shortlisted for the Booker Prize before, he was a judge in 2022, the year Shehan Karunatilaka won for his political satire The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida.
paras.zh: 虽然哈里森之前从未入围布克奖，但他在 2022 年担任评委，同年谢汉·卡鲁纳提拉卡 (Shehan Karunatilaka) 凭借政治讽刺小说《马利·阿尔梅达的七个月亮》获奖。

paras.en: In his speech he acknowledged the judges' efforts: "I know from my own experience in 2022 that judging is as tiring as it is fun. Indeed, sometimes more timing than it is fun."
paras.zh: 他在致辞中认可了评委们的努力：“从我自己2022年的经验来看，评判既累又有趣。确实，有时时机比乐趣更多。”

paras.en: The win for Harrison, who is known for his 2006 novel Nova Swing, which won both the Arthur C Clarke and Philip K Dick Awards for science fiction, demonstrates how the Booker Prize has expanded to be more inclusive of genre fiction over its 60-year history.
paras.zh: 哈里森因其 2006 年小说《新星摇摆》而闻名，该小说同时获得了阿瑟·C·克拉克奖和菲利普·K·迪克科幻小说奖，他的获奖展示了布克奖在其 60 年的历史中如何扩大到对类型小说的包容性。

paras.en: Yet Harrison didn't set out to write a "typical science fiction novel" with The End of Everything.
paras.zh: 然而，哈里森并没有打算用《一切的终结》来写一部“典型的科幻小说”。

paras.en: At a Booker shortlist event in London ahead of the announcement, he explained: "Every time I was tempted to make a rationale [for the dystopian setting], I would say to myself, 'If you put an explanation here, you will be writing science fiction', and that's the last thing I wanted to do."
paras.zh: 在宣布这一消息之前，在伦敦举行的布克入围活动中，他解释道：“每次我想为反乌托邦背景提出一个理由时，我都会对自己说，‘如果你在这里给出解释，你就会写科幻小说’，而这是我最不想做的事情。”

paras.en: Still, the Booker is important recognition for Harrison, who told the BBC last month he has spent his career trying to "shift the balance" between genre and literary fiction.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，布克奖仍然是对哈里森的重要认可，他上个月告诉英国广播公司，他的职业生涯一直在努力“改变类型和文学小说之间的平衡”。

paras.en: "Why shouldn't a well-written [work of] SF [science fiction] be considered to be literary fiction?" he said.
paras.zh: “为什么写得好的 SF（科幻小说）[作品]不应该被视为文学小说？”他说。

paras.en: Beard told ABC Arts the Booker judges did not deliberately set out to acknowledge speculative fiction as "this kind of literature to be rewarded where it hasn't generally in mainstream literary prizes before".
paras.zh: 比尔德告诉美国广播公司艺术频道，布克奖评委们并没有刻意承认推理小说是“这种文学作品，以前在主流文学奖项中一般都没有获得过奖励”。

paras.en: Instead, she said: "It's a recognition of what some people would see as the blindingly obvious: you find great books in every genre."
paras.zh: 相反，她说：“这是对一些人认为显而易见的事实的认识：你可以在每种类型中找到很棒的书籍。”

paras.en: Gaby Wood, who has been chief executive of the Booker Prize Foundation since 2015, described Harrison as "the first Booker winner to have emerged from the bona fide SF world".
paras.zh: 自 2015 年起担任布克奖基金会首席执行官的盖比·伍德 (Gaby Wood) 将哈里森描述为“第一个从真正的科幻世界中脱颖而出的布克奖得主”。

paras.en: She told ABC Arts: "It's interesting to think about whether [the book is] science fiction or whether [Harrison] is a thinker who has come through the world of science fiction and created something that doesn't have to be categorised."
paras.zh: 她告诉美国广播公司艺术频道：“思考[这本书是]科幻小说还是[哈里森]是否是一位穿越科幻世界并创造了一些不必归类的东西的思想家，这很有趣。”

articles.title: Animal welfare campaigner dobbed into council for having five rescue cats
articles.author: Kenji Sato

paras.en: Animal welfare campaigner Lisa Roberts-Daintree has been dobbed into council for exceeding the city's cat limit.
paras.zh: 动物福利活动家丽莎·罗伯茨-丹特里因超出该市养猫限制而被进入市议会。

paras.en: Redland City Council allows only two cats per household in its local by-laws.
paras.zh: 雷德兰市议会在其当地章程中只允许每户养两只猫。

paras.en: The council has given her until November 23 to surrender the cats.
paras.zh: 委员会要求她在 11 月 23 日之前交出这些猫。

paras.en: A Queensland animal welfare campaigner has been threatened with fines for owning five rescue cats.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州一名动物福利活动家因拥有五只救援猫而受到罚款威胁。

paras.en: Lisa Roberts-Daintree received a compliance notice from Redland City Council after a neighbour reported her for exceeding Redland's two cat maximum rule.
paras.zh: 丽莎·罗伯茨-戴恩特里 (Lisa Roberts-Daintree) 在邻居举报她超出了雷德兰最多养两只猫的规定后，收到了雷德兰市议会的合规通知。

paras.en: Council documents obtained by 612 ABC show there were no other concerns about welfare, hygiene or containment following an inspection of the property.
paras.zh: 612 ABC 获得的市议会文件显示，在检查该房产后，没有其他关于福利、卫生或收容的问题。

paras.en: However, the council told her via letter that owning more than two cats was a violation of its by-laws.
paras.zh: 然而，该委员会通过信告诉她，拥有两只以上的猫违反了其章程。

paras.en: "While I recognise that this situation has arisen from compassionate action, Council must also ensure that Local Law No. 2 (Animal Management) 2015 is applied consistently and fairly across the community," the letter said.
paras.zh: 信中说：“虽然我认识到这种情况是由同情行动引起的，但市议会还必须确保 2015 年第 2 号地方法（动物管理）在整个社区得到一致和公平的实施。”

paras.en: "The prescribed limits on the number of animals permitted on a property are in place to protect animal welfare, maintain community amenity and ensure fairness and equity for all residents."
paras.zh: “对房产内允许饲养的动物数量进行规定限制是为了保护动物福利、维护社区便利并确保所有居民的公平和公正。”

paras.en: The letter said if she did not comply by November 23, the council could issue a fine, enter her house and seize her cats.
paras.zh: 信中称，如果她在 11 月 23 日之前不遵守规定，市议会可能会处以罚款，并进入她的房子并没收她的猫。

paras.en: Ms Roberts-Daintree is the spokesperson for Cats Assistance to Sterilise (CATS), a charity which desexes cats to control feral populations.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨-戴恩特里女士是猫绝育援助组织 (CATS) 的发言人，该组织是一家为猫绝育以控制野生动物数量的慈善机构。

paras.en: She said four of her cats had been rescued from a "traumatic" home, and they had medical and socialisation issues which made them difficult to rehome.
paras.zh: 她说她的四只猫是从一个“受过创伤”的家中被救出来的，它们有医疗和社交问题，这使得它们很难重新回家。

paras.en: The Russell Island resident said it was therefore highly likely they would eventually be euthanised if they were impounded by the council.
paras.zh: 这位拉塞尔岛居民表示，因此，如果他们被议会扣押，他们最终很可能会被安乐死。

paras.en: She said she had only been trying to keep the animals off the street where they would breed and kill native wildlife.
paras.zh: 她说她只是想让这些动物远离街道，因为它们会在那里繁殖和杀死本地野生动物。

paras.en: Ms Roberts-Daintree said all five cats were now desexed.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨-丹特里女士说，所有五只猫现在都已绝育。

paras.en: The council said she could get a special permit to keep a third cat, but no more.
paras.zh: 该委员会表示，她可以获得饲养第三只猫的特别许可，但不能再养更多了。

paras.en: Ms Roberts-Daintree said she did not know how to choose which cats would get to stay, and which two would be surrendered.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨-丹特里女士说，她不知道如何选择哪些猫可以留下来，以及哪些两只猫可以被交出。

paras.en: "That's not fair to the cats," Ms Roberts-Daintree said.
paras.zh: “这对猫来说不公平，”罗伯茨-丹特里女士说。

paras.en: "How do you choose which of your children to save?"
paras.zh: “你如何选择拯救哪个孩子？”

paras.en: Her partner, Juergen Holscher, said he had sent dozens of letters to local, state and federal politicians pleading with them for help.
paras.zh: 她的伴侣尤尔根·霍尔舍尔(Juergen Holscher)表示，他已向地方、州和联邦政界人士发出了数十封信，恳求他们提供帮助。

paras.en: The traffic controller said he had installed cat netting around the entire house and backyard to make sure the cats did not leave the property.
paras.zh: 交通管制员说，他在整个房子和后院周围安装了猫网，以确保猫不会离开房子。

paras.en: Mr Holscher said he felt the council was being rigid and uncompromising in enforcing the rules, even though the cats were well looked after and not harming anyone else.
paras.zh: 霍尔舍先生表示，尽管这些猫得到了很好的照顾并且没有伤害其他任何人，但他认为该委员会在执行规则方面是严格且毫不妥协的。

paras.en: He said he felt as though they were effectively being asked to kill the cats in order to protect their welfare.
paras.zh: 他说，他觉得他们实际上是被要求杀死这些猫以保护它们的福利。

paras.en: "They've got no compassion, no sympathy, no critical thinking skills," Mr Holscher said.
paras.zh: “他们没有同情心，没有同情心，没有批判性思维能力，”霍尔舍先生说。

paras.en: "I'm a traffic controller and fair dinkum, I think I'm brighter than these people."
paras.zh: “我是一名交通管制员，而且很纯粹，我认为我比这些人更聪明。”

paras.en: A Redland City Council spokesperson said the matter was ongoing.
paras.zh: 雷德兰市议会发言人表示，此事正在进行中。

paras.en: "Redland City Council is unable to comment on an active investigation," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “雷德兰市议会无法对正在进行的调查发表评论，”发言人说。

paras.en: "Under Council's Subordinate Local Law No. 2 (Animal Management) 2015, residents can keep up to two cats over the age of three months without an approval, and may apply for an approval to keep three cats."
paras.zh: “根据 2015 年议会第 2 号附属地方法（动物管理），居民可以在未经批准的情况下饲养最多两只三个月以上的猫，并可以申请批准饲养三只猫。”

articles.title: NT Labor pledges to build new Royal Darwin Hospital if it wins 2028 election
articles.author: Matt Garrick

paras.en: NT Labor has committed to building a new Royal Darwin Hospital if it wins the next territory election in 2028.
paras.zh: 北领地工党承诺，如果赢得 2028 年下一次领地选举，将建造一座新的皇家达尔文医院。

paras.en: The Australian Medical Association NT (AMA NT) has welcomed the promise, saying a replacement for Darwin hospital is sorely needed.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚医学协会 NT (AMA NT) 对这一承诺表示欢迎，表示迫切需要更换达尔文医院。

paras.en: Labor has conceded it doesn’t have a firm commitment from the Commonwealth for funding.
paras.zh: 工党承认英联邦没有提供坚定的资金承诺。

paras.en: The Northern Territory Labor Opposition has promised to build a new Royal Darwin Hospital (RDH) if it wins government in 2028, revealing new details about how and where it could be built.
paras.zh: 北领地工党反对党承诺，如果 2028 年赢得政府，将建造一座新的皇家达尔文医院 (RDH)，并透露了有关建造方式和地点的新细节。

paras.en: The current RDH, the NT's biggest and busiest hospital, is deteriorating and in a near perpetual state of crisis, with rolling code yellows, overcrowded wards and stretched staff.
paras.zh: 目前的 RDH 是北领地最大、最繁忙的医院，其状况正在恶化，几乎处于永久的危机状态，黄色代码不断滚动，病房人满为患，工作人员捉襟见肘。

paras.en: Shadow Health Minister Chansey Paech said Labor was "committed to delivering a new Royal Darwin Hospital here, for everyone".
paras.zh: 影子卫生部长 Chansey Paech 表示，工党“致力于为所有人建造一座新的皇家达尔文医院”。

paras.en: "We're working with our medical professionals, we're working with architects, we're working with Territorians to understand what a future hospital needs to look like here in Darwin.
paras.zh: “我们正在与医疗专业人员合作，我们正在与建筑师合作，我们正在与领地人合作，以了解达尔文未来的医院需要是什么样子。

paras.en: "So that when we do come into government we don't have to wait around … we can get to the business of getting a hospital built."
paras.zh: “这样，当我们进入政府时，我们就不必等待……我们可以着手建造医院。”

paras.en: While NT Labor has been alluding to this promise over recent weeks, today marks the first time the party has publicly outlined the extent of its planning.
paras.zh: 虽然北领地工党最近几周一直在暗示这一承诺，但今天标志着该党首次公开概述其计划的范围。

paras.en: The pledge also marks the first major election pitch from NT Labor since it lost government in a landslide to the Country Liberal Party (CLP) in 2024.
paras.zh: 这一承诺也标志着北领地工党自 2024 年以压倒性优势败给乡村自由党 (CLP) 以来首次在大选中进行重大竞选宣传。

paras.en: The promise has been welcomed by the Australian Medical Association NT (AMA NT).
paras.zh: 这一承诺受到了澳大利亚医学协会 NT (AMA NT) 的欢迎。

paras.en: AMA NT vice president Dayna Duncan said the current RDH "is ageing to a point where it can't be patched up anymore".
paras.zh: AMA NT 副总裁 Dayna Duncan 表示，目前的 RDH“已经老化到无法再修补的程度”。

paras.en: "We do need a brand new hospital from scratch," she said.
paras.zh: “我们确实需要从头开始建设一座全新的医院，”她说。

paras.en: While no exact cost has been cited, health officials have previously floated that a new RDH would likely exceed $1 billion.
paras.zh: 虽然没有给出确切的成本，但卫生官员此前曾表示，新的 RDH 可能会超过 10 亿美元。

paras.en: Mr Paech said NT Labor was currently looking at two possible locations: the site of the current hospital in Tiwi or on Defence land earmarked for divestment in Berrimah.
paras.zh: Paech先生表示，北领地工党目前正在考虑两个可能的地点：位于提维的现有医院所在地或位于Berrimah指定用于撤资的国防土地上。

paras.en: "We believe … the Berrimah barracks presents the greatest opportunity to build a new premiere tertiary hospital for the Territory, one that is close to the airport for aerial retrieval services, it's in between Palmerston and Darwin," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们相信……贝里马军营提供了为北领地建造一所新的一流三级医院的最佳机会，该医院靠近提供空中救援服务的机场，位于帕默斯顿和达尔文之间。”

paras.en: Dr Duncan said while a future hospital location was still to be negotiated, "the Berrimah site certainly has benefits".
paras.zh: 邓肯博士表示，虽然未来的医院选址仍有待协商，但“Berrimah 选址肯定有好处”。

paras.en: The current eight-storey RDH opened in 1980 in the wake of Cyclone Tracy from existing plans for Canberra's identical Woden Hospital.
paras.zh: 目前的八层楼高的 RDH 于 1980 年在飓风“特雷西”袭击后开业，堪培拉同一沃登医院的现有计划。

paras.en: Mr Paech said under Labor, a new construction would likely look very different.
paras.zh: 佩奇先生表示，在工党的领导下，新建筑可能看起来会非常不同。

paras.en: "We're hearing from people that it shouldn't be a multi-storey tower, that it should be something that takes in the tropical climate," Mr Paech said.
paras.zh: 佩奇先生说：“我们从人们那里听说，它不应该是一座多层塔楼，而应该是能够适应热带气候的建筑。”

paras.en: CLP government Health Minister Steve Edgington criticised NT Labor's track record on spending in government and questioned why it hadn't made the promise in its last term.
paras.zh: CLP政府卫生部长Steve Edgington批评了北领地工党在政府支出方面的记录，并质疑其为何没有在上一届任期内做出承诺。

paras.en: He also said the CLP was "not ruling in or ruling out" building a new RDH, but that his government had embarked on planning for new health infrastructure across the NT.
paras.zh: 他还表示，CLP“不排除”建设新的 RDH，但他的政府已开始规划在北领地建立新的卫生基础设施。

paras.en: "We're looking at the needs of the future and that includes the Royal Darwin Hospital," he said.
paras.zh: “我们正在考虑未来的需求，其中包括皇家达尔文医院，”他说。

paras.en: "We're not here to make political headlines.
paras.zh: “我们来这里不是为了成为政治头条新闻。

paras.en: "We want to do the responsible thing for Territorians, and that's to do the proper planning … look at the clinical needs right across the territory so that we can plan for the future."
paras.zh: “我们希望为北领地人民做负责任的事情，那就是做出适当的规划……了解整个领地的临床需求，以便我们能够为未来做好规划。”

paras.en: The Commonwealth has never publicly committed to helping fund a future RDH, with Prime Minister Anthony Albanese recently watering down the prospect.
paras.zh: 英联邦从未公开承诺为未来的 RDH 提供资金，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 最近淡化了这一前景。

paras.en: But Mr Paech said he believed they would come onboard.
paras.zh: 但佩奇表示，他相信他们会加入。

paras.en: "We have had a very welcoming reception with our federal colleagues to begin the conversation about the future health care needs of Territorians," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们与联邦同事进行了非常热情的接待，开始讨论领土人未来的医疗保健需求。”

paras.en: "We are … going to remain committed to this, and we're going to keep talking to the federal government about this important need for a new hospital here in the Top End."
paras.zh: “我们……将继续致力于此，我们将继续与联邦政府讨论在北端地区建立新医院的重要需求。”

paras.en: In a statement, an Albanese government spokesperson put the onus on the NT government as the entity "responsible for the planning, funding and delivery of capital" for a new RDH.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚政府发言人在一份声明中将责任归于北领地政府，因为该实体“负责新 RDH 的规划、融资和资金交付”。

paras.en: The spokesperson said "any decision to provide funding to support progression of a new tertiary hospital would need to be contemplated" in context of current funding arrangements between the NT and the Commonwealth.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，“任何提供资金支持新三级医院发展的决定都需要考虑”，以北领地和联邦之间目前的资金安排为背景。

paras.en: When asked if a future NT Labor government would go it alone without federal support, Mr Paech said "the Territory Labor Opposition is going to work through that" possibility.
paras.zh: 当被问及未来的北领地工党政府是否会在没有联邦支持的情况下单打独斗时，佩奇表示，“北领地工党反对党将解决这种可能性”。

paras.en: Independent economist Saul Eslake said building a new hospital would be "incredibly expensive for the territory government especially considering its current financial position".
paras.zh: 独立经济学家索尔·埃斯莱克(Saul Eslake)表示，建设一座新医院“对于领地政府来说将极其昂贵，尤其是考虑到其目前的财务状况”。

paras.en: "For a government that is looking at net debt of over $10 billion … that would be a big bite to swallow,"
paras.zh: “对于一个净债务超过 100 亿美元的政府来说……这将是一笔难以承受的巨额债务，”

articles.title: U.S. House Republican moves to force vote on impeaching Pete Hegseth

paras.en: U.S. House Republican moves to force vote on impeaching Pete Hegseth
paras.zh: 美国众议院共和党采取行动强制投票弹劾皮特·赫格斯

paras.en: Secretary of War says he is happy to litigate military actions of the administration 'all day long'
paras.zh: 陆军部长表示，他很高兴“整天”对政府的军事行动提起诉讼

paras.en: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie moved Monday to force a vote to impeach Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, putting pressure on his fellow Republicans to decide whether to remove one of the Trump administration's most prominent figures following sweeping election losses.
paras.zh: 共和党众议员托马斯·马西周一采取行动，强制投票弹劾战争部长皮特·赫格斯，给共和党同僚施加压力，要求他们决定是否在大选惨败后罢免特朗普政府最著名的人物之一。

paras.en: The impeachment resolution largely focuses on the war in Iran. It also includes references to Hegseth's role in carrying out military actions in Yemen and Venezuela.
paras.zh: 弹劾决议主要关注伊朗战争。它还提到了赫格塞斯在也门和委内瑞拉开展军事行动中所扮演的角色。

paras.en: Massie said the secretary's actions amount to "high crimes and misdemeanours" and his leadership at the Pentagon "thus warrants impeachment."
paras.zh: 马西表示，国务卿的行为构成“重罪和轻罪”，他在五角大楼的领导“因此值得弹劾”。

paras.en: A vote in the House could come by mid-week, putting pressure on Republicans — many of whom blamed their election wipeout on the Iran war — but next steps are highly uncertain.
paras.zh: 众议院可能会在周中进行投票，这会给共和党人带来压力——其中许多人将选举失败归咎于伊朗战争——但下一步行动高度不确定。

paras.en: House Speaker Mike Johnson had tried to prevent this outcome, and warned lawmakers against impeaching Hegseth while the U.S. is engaged in military actions in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 众议院议长迈克·约翰逊曾试图阻止这一结果，并警告议员在美国在中东采取军事行动时不要弹劾赫格塞斯。

paras.en: "Impeaching a cabinet secretary right now, especially the Department of War in the middle of hostilities abroad would be a terrible, terrible look, a terrible thing for our allies and our enemies to see that," Johnson, a Republican, said as he opened the chamber.
paras.zh: 共和党人约翰逊在打开会议厅时说道：“现在弹劾内阁部长，特别是在国外敌对行动中弹劾战争部，这对我们的盟友和敌人来说都是非常非常可怕的事情。”

paras.en: "We don't impeach cabinet secretaries for political gain or for cheap tricks, and I think that's what this is and I think everybody knows it."
paras.zh: “我们不会为了政治利益或廉价伎俩而弹劾内阁部长，我认为这就是事实，我想每个人都知道这一点。”

paras.en: Speaking to reporters Monday afternoon, Massie said Hegseth has violated international norms and the U.S.'s own conventions of war in Iran.
paras.zh: 马西周一下午对记者表示，赫格塞斯违反了国际准则和美国自己在伊朗的战争惯例。

paras.en: "It's to the disadvantage and the dishonour of our country, and to the danger of our soldiers in future conflict," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这对我们国家不利，有损我们的荣誉，也会让我们的士兵在未来的冲突中面临危险。”

paras.en: Hegseth said earlier Monday he's eager to litigate the military actions that he and U.S. President Donald Trump have taken against Iran, Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels and Venezuela's previous leaders.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯周一早些时候表示，他渴望对他和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普针对伊朗、也门伊朗支持的胡塞叛军和委内瑞拉前领导人采取的军事行动提起诉讼。

paras.en: "If you want to take issue with what we did in Epic Fury or Rough Rider or nabbing Nicolás Maduro, you're taking issue with the troops and what they accomplished, which is historic," Hegseth told reporters Monday, using the military code names for the Iran war and campaign of strikes to halt the Houthis' attacks on shipping in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯周一对记者表示：“如果你想对我们在《史诗狂怒》或《狂暴骑士》中所做的事情或抓获尼古拉斯·马杜罗提出异议，那么你就是在对军队和他们所取得的历史性成就提出异议。”他使用了伊朗战争和打击胡塞武装对中东航运的袭击行动的军事代号。

paras.en: Hegseth also announced that he would hold a rare news conference on Tuesday — his first in more than 180 days — on the impeachment threat. His last briefing was in May, and he has not held one on the Iran war, strikes on alleged drug-trafficking boats or other U.S. military actions since then.
paras.zh: 赫格斯还宣布，他将于周二就弹劾威胁举行罕见的新闻发布会，这是他 180 多天以来的第一次新闻发布会。他的最后一次简报会是在五月份，此后他就没有就伊朗战争、打击涉嫌贩毒船只或其他美国军事行动举行简报会。

paras.en: The Pentagon chief is bearing the brunt of anger and calls for his ouster after the Iran war and its economic impact contributed to severe Republican losses in the midterm elections that cost the party control of Congress. Massie pushed forward an impeachment resolution over the objections of House Republican leadership as momentum grows to hold Hegseth accountable for the conflict.
paras.zh: 伊朗战争及其经济影响导致共和党在中期选举中惨败，导致该党失去了对国会的控制权，五角大楼负责人首当其冲地承受着愤怒和要求他下台的呼声。随着要求赫格斯对冲突负责的势头增强，马西不顾众议院共和党领导层的反对，推动了一项弹劾决议。

paras.en: Hegseth gave a State of the Force address at Marine Corps Base Quantico, Sept. 30, but has not held a media availablity since May. (Alex Wong/Pool/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 9 月 30 日，赫格斯在海军陆战队匡蒂科基地发表了部队状况演讲，但自 5 月以来一直没有接受媒体采访。 （亚历克斯·黄/普尔/美联社）

paras.en: Hegseth waves off impeachment push as 'noise'
paras.zh: 赫格斯将弹劾推动视为“噪音”

paras.en: Hegseth, after giving a speech at the Naval War College in Rhode Island, brushed aside the possible impeachment push.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯在罗德岛海军战争学院发表演讲后，对可能的弹劾推动置之不理。

paras.en: "There's a lot of politically motivated people who may have substantial policy disagreements, but their disagreements are with success," he told reporters. He added that "if we want to litigate" the military actions that the Trump administration has taken, "I'm happy to do it all day long."
paras.zh: “有很多出于政治动机的人可能在政策上存在重大分歧，但他们的分歧是成功的，”他告诉记者。他补充说，“如果我们想对特朗普政府采取的军事行动提起诉讼，我很乐意整天这样做。”

paras.en: "My team, we're not worried about the noise — it's what I told the troops, too — don't worry about the noise," he said.
paras.zh: “我的团队，我们并不担心噪音——这也是我告诉部队的——不要担心噪音，”他说。

paras.en: Asked about U.S. Vice-President JD Vance blaming the Iran war for the massive Republican losses in the election, Hegseth noted that Trump said he would do it again, and "I agree."
paras.zh: 当被问及美国副总统万斯将共和党在选举中惨败归咎于伊朗战争时，赫格斯指出，特朗普表示他会再次这样做，“我同意”。

paras.en: He largely repeated a line that Secretary of State Marco Rubio said to reporters a day earlier: "It doesn't have to be necessarily popular, but it can be necessary."
paras.zh: 他基本上重复了国务卿马可·卢比奥一天前对记者说的一句话：“它不一定很受欢迎，但可能是必要的。”

paras.en: Hegseth argued that the war was necessary because "someone had to confront the Iranian regime's pursuit of a nuclear weapon" and said "the choice was don't act and wish it away or take a bold move."
paras.zh: 赫格斯认为，这场战争是必要的，因为“必须有人面对伊朗政权对核武器的追求”，并表示“选择是不采取行动并希望它消失，或者采取大胆的行动。”

paras.en: Iran has long maintained that its nuclear program is peaceful. According to the International Atomic Energy Agency, Iran has 440.9 kilograms of uranium that is enriched up to 60 per cent purity, a short, technical step from weapons-grade levels of 90 per cent.
paras.zh: 伊朗长期以来坚称其核计划是和平目的。据国际原子能机构称，伊朗拥有 440.9 公斤浓缩铀，纯度高达 60%，距离武器级 90% 的水平仅几步之遥。

paras.en: Trump defended Hegseth to reporters on Sunday night.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，特朗普向记者为赫格斯辩护。

paras.en: "He's guilty of two things, basically winning two wars," Trump said. "I believe we saved the Middle East and Israel combined. And it's awfully hard to say let's impeach somebody who did that."
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“他犯了两件事，基本上是赢得了两场战争。” “我相信我们联合起来拯救了中东和以色列。很难说让我们弹劾这样做的人。”

paras.en: On Monday, he told reporters he would stand by Hegseth even if he is impeached.
paras.zh: 周一，他告诉记者，即使赫格斯被弹劾，他也会支持他。

paras.en: Hegseth reiterated that "Iran is devastated," even though the Islamic Republic has been able to keep striking military bases in the Middle East that are used by the United States, causing billions of dollars in damage, as well as commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯重申，“伊朗遭到了毁灭性打击”，尽管伊朗伊斯兰共和国能够持续袭击美国在中东使用的军事基地，造成数十亿美元的损失，以及霍尔木兹海峡的商船。

paras.en: Disruptions to shipping in the waterway, where one-fifth of the world's oil passed before the war, have led to higher energy prices that hit voters' pocketbooks.
paras.zh: 战前全球五分之一的石油都经过这条水道，运输中断导致能源价格上涨，影响了选民的钱包。

paras.en: He said the next steps on the war are up to Trump, including telling Iran: "Hey, we're done, and we're going to watch your nuclear material. You better not move it."
paras.zh: 他说，战争的下一步取决于特朗普，包括告诉伊朗：“嘿，我们已经完成了，我们将监视你的核材料。你最好不要移动它。”

paras.en: With anger in Congress rising, Hegseth has been on a social media blitz, posting a video last week acknowledging the threat of impeachment. He said it would be "all about the politics of personal destruction" and insisted that "won't work with me. You can rest assured of that."
paras.zh: 随着国会的愤怒情绪不断高涨，赫格赛斯在社交媒体上掀起了热潮，他上周发布了一段视频，承认弹劾的威胁。他说这“完全是为了个人毁灭的政治”，并坚称“这对我不起作用。你可以放心。”

paras.en: Since then, scores of political appointees within the Pentagon have posted images of Hegseth emblazoned with the words, "Stand. Fight. Defend the Republic." The White House also posted a video to social media that featured praise from Trump.
paras.zh: 从那时起，五角大楼内的数十名政治任命人员都发布了赫格斯的照片，上面印有“站立。战斗。保卫共和国”的字样。白宫还在社交媒体上发布了一段视频，其中包含特朗普的赞扬。

articles.title: Judge clears way for Lindsay Clancy to face potential 2nd trial

paras.en: Judge clears way for Lindsay Clancy to face potential 2nd trial
paras.zh: 法官为林赛·克兰西面临第二次审判扫清道路

paras.en: Mistrial was declared in Clancy's 1st trial after jurors could not reach unanimous verdict
paras.zh: 由于陪审团未能达成一致裁决，克兰西的第一次审判被宣布无效

paras.en: WARNING: This article contains details about violence against children and attempted suicide.
paras.zh: 警告：本文包含有关暴力侵害儿童和自杀未遂的详细信息。

paras.en: A Massachusetts judge cleared the way on Monday for Lindsay Clancy to be tried again on murder charges for killing her three young children at her home in 2023, saying a retrial would not unconstitutionally subject her to a double prosecution for the same crime.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州一名法官周一为林赛·克兰西 (Lindsay Clancy) 因谋杀罪再次接受审判扫清了道路，她因 2023 年在家中杀害了自己的三个年幼的孩子而被指控谋杀，称重审不会违反宪法，导致她因同一罪行而受到双重起诉。

paras.en: Judge William Sullivan in Plymouth, Mass., rejected a bid by Clancy's attorneys to have the case against her dismissed. The judge on Sept. 4 declared a mistrial after the jury reported that a holdout juror was preventing it from reaching a unanimous verdict.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州普利茅斯市的威廉·沙利文法官拒绝了克兰西律师提出的驳回针对她的案件的请求。 9 月 4 日，在陪审团报告一名坚持不懈的陪审员阻止陪审团达成一致裁决后，法官宣布审判无效。

paras.en: The ruling means a second trial can occur next year. Sullivan has scheduled a Nov. 16 hearing to discuss when to hold that trial, which he has suggested could occur in March.
paras.zh: 该裁决意味着明年可能会进行第二次审判。沙利文已安排 11 月 16 日举行听证会，讨论何时举行审判，他建议可能在 3 月份进行审判。

paras.en: Defence lawyers had argued that such a retrial would violate Clancy's protection under the U.S. Constitution's Fifth Amendment against being tried twice for the same crime, known as double jeopardy. They said Sullivan acted prematurely in declaring a mistrial and it was not manifestly necessary.
paras.zh: 辩护律师辩称，这样的重审将违反美国宪法第五修正案对克兰西的保护，禁止他因同一罪行而受到两次审判，即双重危险。他们表示，沙利文宣布无效审判的行为过早，而且显然没有必要。

paras.en: Citing jury notes that stated the holdout juror was not following the law on reasonable doubt despite the judge's instructions, defence lawyers said Sullivan should have instead questioned the holdout and potentially removed the juror.
paras.zh: 辩护律师援引陪审团的记录称，尽管有法官的指示，但坚持不懈的陪审员并未遵守合理怀疑的法律，沙利文应该对坚持不懈的人提出质疑，并可能将陪审员开除。

paras.en: But Sullivan said the notes did not indicate the holdout had announced he was refusing to follow the law, but instead suggested a disagreement among the jurors. Questioning the holdout in the midst of their deliberations would have as a result been "impermissibly coercive," Sullivan wrote.
paras.zh: 但沙利文表示，这些笔记并没有表明抵制者已经宣布他拒绝遵守法律，而是表明陪审员之间存在分歧。沙利文写道，在审议过程中对坚持不懈的人提出质疑将是“不允许的强制行为”。

paras.en: "Because the court concludes that there was a manifest necessity for a retrial based on the jury's deadlock, a retrial on the murder indictments does not violate Clancy's right not to be placed in double jeopardy," Sullivan wrote.
paras.zh: 沙利文写道：“由于法院根据陪审团的僵局得出结论，显然有必要进行重审，因此对谋杀起诉书进行重审并不侵犯克兰西不陷入双重危险的权利。”

paras.en: In a related decision, the judge declined to conduct a limited inquiry into the holdout, saying he saw no point in examining the juror under oath at this stage in the proceedings.
paras.zh: 在一项相关决定中，法官拒绝对抵制行为进行有限调查，称他认为在诉讼程序的现阶段没有必要对陪审员进行宣誓审查。

paras.en: Martin Weinberg, a lawyer for Clancy, said he anticipated the defence would pursue an appeal. A spokesperson for Plymouth County District Attorney Timothy Cruz did not respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 克兰西的律师马丁·温伯格表示，他预计辩方将提出上诉。普利茅斯县地方检察官蒂莫西·克鲁兹的发言人没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: No one at Clancy's initial trial disputed that she strangled daughter Cora, 5; son Dawson, 3; and 8-month-old son Callan with exercise bands on Jan. 24, 2023, in the basement of their home in the Boston suburb of Duxbury.
paras.zh: 在克兰西的初审中，没有人对她勒死 5 岁的女儿科拉这一事实提出异议。儿子道森，三岁； 2023 年 1 月 24 日，波士顿郊区达克斯伯里的家中地下室里，带着健身带的 8 个月大的儿子卡兰 (Callan)。

paras.en: She then cut herself with a knife and jumped from a second-storey window in an attempt to end her own life, leaving her paralyzed.
paras.zh: 随后，她用刀割伤了自己，并从二楼的窗户跳下，试图结束自己的生命，导致她瘫痪。

paras.en: Her lawyers have argued Clancy was in the throes of postpartum psychosis and should be found not guilty by reason of insanity, known in Massachusetts as lack of criminal responsibility.
paras.zh: 她的律师辩称，克兰西正处于产后精神病的痛苦之中，应该因精神错乱而被判无罪，在马萨诸塞州被称为缺乏刑事责任。

paras.en: Some of the jurors in televised interviews later said that, but for one holdout juror, they had been prepared to find Clancy not guilty by reason of insanity.
paras.zh: 一些陪审员在电视采访中表示，但对于一名坚持不懈的陪审员来说，他们已经准备好以精​​神错乱为由判定克兰西无罪。

paras.en: Such a verdict would have resulted in her commitment to a state psychiatric hospital, subject to regular court review. In Massachusetts, a conviction on first-degree murder charges carries a mandatory sentence of life in prison without parole.
paras.zh: 这样的判决将导致她被送往州立精神病院，并接受定期的法庭审查。在马萨诸塞州，一级谋杀罪一旦定罪，将被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

paras.en: If you or someone you know is struggling, here's where to look for help:
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人遇到困难，可以在此处寻求帮助：

paras.en: - Canada's Suicide Crisis Helpline: Call or text 988.
paras.zh: - 加拿大自杀危机求助热线：致电或发短信 988。

paras.en: - Provincial and territorial mental health support.
paras.zh: - 省和地区的心理健康支持。

paras.en: - Kids Help Phone: 1-800-668-6868. Text 686868. Live chat counselling on the website.
paras.zh: - 儿童帮助电话：1-800-668-6868。短信 686868。网站上的实时聊天咨询。

paras.en: - This guide from the Centre for Addiction and Mental Health outlines how to talk about suicide with someone you're worried about.
paras.zh: - 成瘾和心理健康中心的这份指南概述了如何与您担心的人谈论自杀问题。

articles.title: Tyler Robinson, man accused of shooting Charlie Kirk, to face trial in 2028

paras.en: Tyler Robinson, man accused of shooting Charlie Kirk, to face trial in 2028
paras.zh: 泰勒·罗宾逊 (Tyler Robinson)，被控枪杀查理·柯克 (Charlie Kirk)，将于 2028 年接受审判

paras.en: Utah judge sets trial date for June 2028
paras.zh: 犹他州法官将审判日期定为 2028 年 6 月

paras.en: A Utah judge on Monday set a June 2028 trial date for Tyler Robinson, the man accused of murdering prominent right-wing activist Charlie Kirk last year.
paras.zh: 周一，犹他州一名法官将泰勒·罗宾逊 (Tyler Robinson) 的审判日期定为 2028 年 6 月，泰勒·罗宾逊被指控去年谋杀了著名右翼活动人士查理·柯克 (Charlie Kirk)。

paras.en: Robinson, 23, has pleaded not guilty to seven counts, including aggravated murder, in the shooting of Kirk as the conservative held one of his trademark debates at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah.
paras.zh: 23 岁的罗宾逊对枪杀柯克的七项罪名表示不认罪，其中包括严重谋杀，当时保守派在犹他州奥勒姆的犹他谷大学举行一场标志性辩论。

paras.en: Utah District Court Judge Tony Graf set jury selection for the trial for June 21, 2028, after Robinson's attorneys requested a late 2029 date to give them time to challenge Utah's request for the death penalty, gather additional evidence and seek a change of venue. Robinson's lawyers expect a six-to-seven-month trial.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊的律师要求推迟 2029 年的日期，以便让他们有时间质疑犹他州的死刑请求、收集更多证据并寻求变更审判地点，之后犹他州地方法院法官托尼·格拉夫 (Tony Graf) 将审判的陪审团选择定于 2028 年 6 月 21 日进行。罗宾逊的律师预计审判将持续六到七个月。

paras.en: Prosecutors had sought a date of January 31, 2028 to start what they expect to be a 17-week trial for the shooting death of Kirk, an ally of U.S. President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 检察官寻求在 2028 年 1 月 31 日开始对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的盟友柯克枪杀案进行为期 17 周的审判。

paras.en: In a separate filing, Erika Kirk, Kirk's widow, requested the trial to start in 2027 to speed what she described as a painful legal process.
paras.zh: 柯克的遗孀埃里卡·柯克 (Erika Kirk) 在另一份文件中要求于 2027 年开始审判，以加快她所描述的痛苦的法律程序。

paras.en: Trump last month slammed Graf's handling of the case, saying the trial should start within a month and the judge was asking "questions that people already know the answer to."
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月猛烈抨击格拉夫对此案的处理方式，称审判应在一个月内开始，法官提出的问题是“人们已经知道答案的问题”。

paras.en: Charlie Kirk is seen in a file photo taken March 17, 2025, when he was speaking at a town hall in Oconomowoc, Wis. (Jeffrey Phelps/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 查理·柯克 (Charlie Kirk) 摄于 2025 年 3 月 17 日，当时他在威斯康星州奥科诺莫沃克的市政厅发表讲话。（杰弗里·菲尔普斯/美联社）

paras.en: Kirk was a polarizing figure in U.S. politics. He was admired by conservatives for mobilizing young voters around his Christian and right-wing views. Civil rights advocates criticized Kirk for rhetoric they called racist, anti-immigrant, transphobic and misogynist, citing his public remarks denigrating Black Americans, LGBTQ communities, Muslims and immigrants.
paras.zh: 柯克是美国政坛一个两极分化的人物。他因动员年轻选民支持他的基督教和右翼观点而受到保守派的钦佩。民权倡导者批评柯克的言论是种族主义、反移民、恐惧跨性别者和厌女症，并引用柯克公开言论诋毁美国黑人、LGBTQ 群体、穆斯林和移民。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege Robinson targeted Kirk for his opposition to same-sex marriage and transgender rights. Defence attorney Richard Novak has said in court that Kirk spoke "hatefully" about people who did not have traditional gender identities or were not heterosexual, but Robinson's defence say there was no evidence Robinson opposed those views.
paras.zh: 检察官指控罗宾逊因为柯克反对同性婚姻和变性人权利而针对柯克。辩护律师理查德·诺瓦克在法庭上表示，柯克“充满仇恨”地谈论那些没有传统性别认同或非异性恋的人，但罗宾逊的辩护人表示，没有证据表明罗宾逊反对这些观点。

articles.title: Fake news in Africa: In an age of disinformation, who decides what's true?

paras.en: Misinformation poses a threat to democracy worldwide: An exaggerated WhatsApp message, a manipulated TikTok video or an apparent breaking news alert on Facebook can all misguide people in Africa and beyond — particularly in the run-up to elections.
paras.zh: 错误信息对全球民主构成威胁：夸大的WhatsApp消息、操纵的TikTok视频或Facebook上明显的突发新闻警报都可能误导非洲及其他地区的人们，尤其是在选举前夕。

paras.en: As artificial intelligence is making it increasingly easy to manipulate images, voices and videos, more and more countries are trying to equip their populations with skills to identify and counter fake news.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能使操纵图像、声音和视频变得越来越容易，越来越多的国家正在尝试为其民众提供识别和反击假新闻的技能。

paras.en: But are these efforts really about raising awareness, or are certain governments using this fight to control public opinion, silence dissident voices and misguide the populace — from both within and outside of these respective nations?
paras.zh: 但这些努力真的是为了提高人们的认识吗？还是某些政府利用这场斗争来控制舆论、压制异见声音并误导民众——无论是国内还是国外？

paras.en: Civil society groups fill gaps left by governments
paras.zh: 民间社会团体填补政府留下的空白

paras.en: Journalism lecturer Dani Madrid-Morales at the University of Sheffield believes that African governments must significantly step up their efforts to combat sources of disinformation and misinformation.
paras.zh: 谢菲尔德大学新闻学讲师丹尼·马德里-莫拉莱斯认为，非洲各国政府必须加大力度打击虚假信息和错误信息的来源。

paras.en: He told DW that "there are very few countries — if any — that are actually doing a good job" to beat the influence of fake news.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声，“很少有国家——如果有的话——在打击假新闻的影响方面真正做得很好”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, he points out that there also are civil society initiatives in various African nations, which help inform people about the dangers of such false narratives.
paras.zh: 同时，他指出，非洲各国也有民间社会的倡议，帮助人们了解这种虚假叙述的危险。

paras.en: For instance in South Africa, organizations like Africa Check and Media Monitoring Africa work together to highlight the impact of fake news on elections. Similar coalitions also exist in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Senegal.
paras.zh: 例如，在南非，Africa Check 和 Media Monitoring Africa 等组织共同努力，强调假新闻对选举的影响。刚果民主共和国（DRC）和塞内加尔也存在类似的联盟。

paras.en: However, these initiative mostly focus on fighting disinformation during election periods; the rest of the time, they typically lack funding and sustained engagement with civil society to continue to make a change.
paras.zh: 然而，这些举措主要侧重于打击选举期间的虚假信息；在其余时间，他们通常缺乏资金和与民间社会的持续接触来继续做出改变。

paras.en: When African governments become part of the problem
paras.zh: 当非洲政府成为问题的一部分时

paras.en: There also are deliberate efforts by certain governments not to battle fake news; some let it happen while others engage in deliberately spreading this kind of disinformation.
paras.zh: 某些政府也刻意不与假新闻作斗争；有些人让它发生，而另一些人则故意传播这种虚假信息。

paras.en: Madrid-Morales distinguishes between three types of disinformation in this context: There are scams and similar schemes, which some governments, he says, fail to sufficiently fight, leaving people susceptible to financial losses and other problems.
paras.zh: 马德里-莫拉莱斯在这种情况下区分了三种类型的虚假信息：他说，有些政府未能充分打击诈骗和类似计划，导致人们容易遭受经济损失和其他问题。

paras.en: Secondly, he adds that there also are certain foreign influence operations trying to impact public opinion from outside a country and, in many instances, outside of the continent.
paras.zh: 其次，他补充说，还有某些外国影响力活动试图影响国外的公众舆论，在许多情况下，影响非洲大陆之外的公众舆论。

paras.en: Finally, there are political disinformation campaings which originate from within a country that are intended to deliberately derail impartial views, he explains.
paras.zh: 最后，他解释说，有些政治虚假信息运动源自一个国家内部，旨在故意破坏公正的观点。

paras.en: "Governments are particularly interested in the third category," says Madrid-Morales, adding that this is especially prevalent in the Sahel region.
paras.zh: 马德里-莫拉莱斯说：“各国政府对第三类特别感兴趣。”他补充说，这种情况在萨赫勒地区尤其普遍。

paras.en: He highlights how in nations like Burkina Faso and Mali, military governments have shut down media outlets, prosecuted journalists and expelled foreign correspondents in order to silence free speech.
paras.zh: 他强调了在布基纳法索和马里等国家，军政府如何关闭媒体机构、起诉记者并驱逐外国记者，以压制言论自由。

paras.en: In his view, these junta governments are primarily concerned with preventing negative or false information about themselves from circulating rather than actively recruiting followers.
paras.zh: 在他看来，这些军政府主要关心的是防止有关自己的负面或虚假信息传播，而不是积极招募追随者。

paras.en: Do outside forces shape public opinion in Africa?
paras.zh: 外部力量会影响非洲的舆论吗？

paras.en: Foreign powers meanwhile also appear to play a considerable role in shaping public opinion across the continent.
paras.zh: 与此同时，外国势力似乎也在塑造整个非洲大陆的舆论方面发挥着相当大的作用。

paras.en: Afrobarometer, a pan-African research network, examined the influence of international actors in terms of their influence across Africa — including those suspected of sharing fake news.
paras.zh: 泛非研究网络“非洲晴雨表”研究了国际行为者在整个非洲的影响力，其中包括那些涉嫌传播假新闻的人。

paras.en: The study found that over 60% of respondents viewed China's political and economic influence positively; this was followed by 52% for the United States.
paras.zh: 研究发现，超过60%的受访者对中国的政治和经济影响持积极态度；其次是美国，占 52%。

paras.en: Both countries have no past colonial history in Africa, although they are now competng for economic gains while focusing otherwise on furthering infrastructure projects — partly to maintain this largely benevolent perception towards them.
paras.zh: 这两个国家在非洲都没有殖民历史，尽管它们现在在争夺经济利益的同时，还专注于推进基础设施项目——部分是为了维持对它们的这种基本上是仁慈的看法。

paras.en: However, perceptions of other former colonial powers vary notably in some cases, depending mainly on factors such as the impact of past injustices: For example, in French-speaking countries, only 34% of respondents viewed France's ongoing influence positively.
paras.zh: 然而，在某些情况下，对其他前殖民国家的看法存在显着差异，主要取决于过去不公正现象的影响等因素：例如，在法语国家，只有 34% 的受访者对法国持续的影响持积极态度。

paras.en: Komi Amewonou from Afrobarometer told DW that such attitudes are not necessarily the outcome of targeted propaganda campaigns for or against certain nations outside the continent but rather the result of African governments letting negative perceptions simply run their course.
paras.zh: 《非洲晴雨表》的科米·阿梅沃努 (Komi Amewonou) 告诉德国之声，这种态度不一定是支持或反对非洲大陆以外某些国家的有针对性的宣传活动的结果，而是非洲各国政府任由负面看法自然发展的结果。

paras.en: The mixed role of media literacy initiatives
paras.zh: 媒体素养举措的混合作用

paras.en: In some countries, there are media development project trying to educate people and animate them to think for themselves and thus fight sources of fake news and disinformation.
paras.zh: 在一些国家，有一些媒体发展项目试图教育人们并激发他们独立思考，从而打击假新闻和虚假信息的来源。

paras.en: In Ghana, the NGO Penplusbytes runs the "Caravan of Hope" initiative — a project supported by the German development agency GIZ and by DW Akademie.
paras.zh: 在加纳，非政府组织 Penplusbytes 发起了“希望大篷车”倡议，该项目得到了德国发展机构 GIZ 和 DW Akademie 的支持。

paras.en: This mobile campaign brings media literacy training to rural communities through theater, role-playing exercises, public discussions and videos in local languages. The initiative has managed to reach 3,000 people in five districts to date.
paras.zh: 这项移动活动通过戏剧、角色扮演练习、公共讨论和当地语言视频为农村社区带来媒体素养培训。迄今为止，该倡议已成功惠及五个地区的 3,000 人。

paras.en: The campaign also involves trusted community figures, as studies show that locals most trust people they know personally — particularly traditional village leaders and community representatives.
paras.zh: 该活动还涉及值得信赖的社区人物，因为研究表明当地人最信任他们认识的人，尤其是传统的村庄领导和社区代表。

paras.en: Rebecca Avusu from Penplusbytes, who helped develop the project, told DW that "information must be verified before people believe it or pass it on. This is particularly important for those without smartphones or with limited formal education."
paras.zh: 帮助开发该项目的 Penplusbytes 的丽贝卡·阿武苏 (Rebecca Avusu) 告诉德国之声，“信息必须经过验证，然后人们才会相信或传播。这对于那些没有智能手机或受过有限正规教育的人来说尤其重要。”

paras.en: Initiatives in South Africa take a similar approach: The country is home to Africa Check — one of the continent's best-known fact-checking initiatives.
paras.zh: 南非的举措采取了类似的方法：该国是“非洲检查”的所在地，这是非洲大陆最著名的事实核查举措之一。

paras.en: The organization visits schools and teaches classes how to identify manipulated images, verify sources, and deal with misinformation circulating on WhatsApp groups.
paras.zh: 该组织访问学校并教授班级如何识别被篡改的图像、验证来源以及处理 WhatsApp 群组中传播的错误信息。

paras.en: However, Madrid-Morales says that there can be a downside to such media literacy programs as well; pointing to research conducted in South Africa, he highlights that while some young people do become more discerning consumers of information, others eventually lose trust in almost every source, resulting in a complete lack of knowledge about important developments.
paras.zh: 然而，马德里-莫拉莱斯表示，此类媒体素养计划也可能存在负面影响。他在谈到在南非进行的研究时强调，虽然一些年轻人确实成为了更有洞察力的信息消费者，但其他人最终对几乎所有来源都失去了信任，导致完全缺乏对重要发展的了解。

paras.en: In countries elsewhere in Africa, there's greater resistance against such media literacy initiaves — chiefly by their own governments.
paras.zh: 在非洲其他国家，此类媒体素养举措面临更大的阻力——主要是来自本国政府。

paras.en: In 2026, the International Media and Information Literacy Institute (IMILI) was opened in the Nigerian capital Abuja under the auspices of UNESCO, with a mission to promote research, training and international cooperation across media literacy initiatives.
paras.zh: 2026年，在联合国教科文组织的支持下，国际媒体和信息素养研究所（IMILI）在尼日利亚首都阿布贾成立，其使命是促进媒体素养倡议的研究、培训和国际合作。

paras.en: This came after the Nigerian government announced that it aimed to play a leading international role in Africa in the fight against fake news; however, civil rights groups say the state often blurs the line between genuinely battling disinformation and silencing public dissent in the country.
paras.zh: 此前，尼日利亚政府宣布其目标是在非洲打击假新闻方面发挥国际领导作用；然而，民权组织表示，国家经常模糊真正打击虚假信息和压制公众异议之间的界限。

paras.en: In Kenya, there are similar concerns: The Media Council of Kenya has been tasked with supporting journalists and boosting fact-checking initiatives.
paras.zh: 在肯尼亚，也存在类似的担忧：肯尼亚媒体委员会的任务是支持记者和推动事实核查举措。

paras.en: However, its scope of operations is limited, as the organization abides by the country's laws to remain in operation — in particular legislation supposedly designed to target the spreading of false information.
paras.zh: 然而，其业务范围有限，因为该组织必须遵守该国的法律才能继续运营——特别是旨在打击虚假信息传播的立法。

paras.en: Conversely, these laws have come under increased scrutiny, as they can also be abused to silence views against the government.
paras.zh: 相反，这些法律受到了越来越严格的审查，因为它们也可能被滥用来压制反对政府的观点。

paras.en: Madrid-Morales says that in such contexts, there need to be independent oversight bodies to ensure that people do not refrain from expressing themselves publicly for fear of reprisal.
paras.zh: 马德里-莫拉莱斯表示，在这种情况下，需要有独立的监督机构，以确保人们不会因为担心遭到报复而避免公开表达自己的意见。

paras.en: Mozambique: Fighting disinformation as a tool of control
paras.zh: 莫桑比克：打击虚假信息作为控制工具

paras.en: Meanwhile in Mozambique, the media institute MISA has also launched a series of media initiatives such as MISACheck. The program is designed to train young journalists and social activists in fact-checking techniques.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在莫桑比克，媒体机构MISA也推出了MISACheck等一系列媒体举措。该计划旨在培训年轻记者和社会活动家事实核查技术。

paras.en: Olivia Massango, the vice-president of MISA, says however that the efforts of such civil society groups may seem like a drop in the ocean; Massango is particularly critical of how state authorities deal with misinformation.
paras.zh: 然而，MISA 副主席奥利维亚·马桑戈 (Olivia Massango) 表示，此类民间社会团体的努力似乎只是沧海一粟；马桑戈对国家当局处理错误信息的方式尤其批评。

paras.en: "When something becomes inconvenient, the government ... invokes public interest, but ultimately often ends up protecting only what suits it," she told DW.
paras.zh: “当事情变得不方便时，政府......会援引公共利益，但最终往往只保护适合它的东西，”她告诉德国之声。

paras.en: "Combating disinformation must not mean criminalizing opinions, criticism or journalistic work," she warns.
paras.zh: “打击虚假信息绝不意味着将观点、批评或新闻工作定为犯罪，”她警告说。

paras.en: Guidance from Europe — with limited safeguards
paras.zh: 来自欧洲的指导——保障措施有限

paras.en: More and more African nations meanwhile are turning to Europe in hopes of adopting useful mechanisms to fight fake news.
paras.zh: 与此同时，越来越多的非洲国家转向欧洲，希望采取有用的机制来打击假新闻。

paras.en: Morocco and Senegal are among the examples where proposed disinformation legislation is widely inspired by EU standards. Madrid-Morales however stresses that while following strong EU legislation in the battle against disinformation can be a success, there also need to be independent oversight and enforcement mechanisms to make them work.
paras.zh: 摩洛哥和塞内加尔就是拟议的虚假信息立法广泛受到欧盟标准启发的例子。然而，马德里-莫拉莱斯强调，虽然在打击虚假信息的斗争中遵循强有力的欧盟立法可能会取得成功，但还需要独立的监督和执行机制才能使其发挥作用。

paras.en: In the cases of Senegal and Morocco, these are yet to be established, he explains, stressing that both nations have repeatedly had to deal with various forms of political instability influenced by fake news.
paras.zh: 他解释说，就塞内加尔和摩洛哥而言，这些尚未确定，并强调两国都多次不得不应对受假新闻影响的各种形式的政治不稳定。

paras.en: Rebecca Avusu says she is also concerned about such efforts maintaining loopholes to suit governments if and as needed: "We do not want laws designed to combat disinformation to become instruments for silencing people who question government decisions or express legitimate opinions," Avusu warns.
paras.zh: 丽贝卡·阿武苏 (Rebecca Avusu) 表示，她还担心此类努力会留下漏洞，以适应政府的需要：“我们不希望旨在打击虚假信息的法律成为压制那些质疑政府决策或表达合法意见的人的工具，”阿武苏警告说。

articles.title: India’s demonetization: 10 years on, promises remain unfulfilled

paras.en: On November 8, 2016, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced in a televised address to the nation that he was withdrawing all 500- and 1,000-rupee banknotes from circulation at midnight.
paras.zh: 2016 年 11 月 8 日，总理纳伦德拉·莫迪在向全国发表的电视讲话中宣布，他将于午夜停止流通所有 500 卢比和 1,000 卢比纸币。

paras.en: The surprise move invalidated 86.9% of the value of currency in circulation in a single stroke.
paras.zh: 这一出人意料的举动一下子使流通货币价值的86.9%失效。

paras.en: Modi asked Indians to make a "grand sacrifice for cleansing our country."
paras.zh: 莫迪要求印度人“为净化我们的国家做出巨大牺牲”。

paras.en: He promised that the hardship would help eliminate black money, corruption, counterfeit currency and terrorist financing. The exercise was presented as a major step towards a cleaner and more transparent economy.
paras.zh: 他承诺，这一困难将有助于消除黑钱、腐败、假币和恐怖主义融资。这项工作被认为是迈向更清洁、更透明的经济的重要一步。

paras.en: Millions of Indians rushed to banks to exchange their savings. Long queues formed outside banks and ATMs, with people waiting for hours, sometimes without knowing when they would get their money.
paras.zh: 数百万印度人涌向银行兑换储蓄。银行和自动取款机外排起了长队，人们等待了几个小时，有时甚至不知道什么时候才能拿到钱。

paras.en: Workers missed wages, small businesses struggled to pay employees and families found it difficult to buy everyday essentials. Reports of people dying during the cash crisis added to the distress.
paras.zh: 工人们拖欠工资，小企业难以支付员工工资，家庭发现很难购买日常必需品。有关现金危机期间有人死亡的报道加剧了人们的痛苦。

paras.en: "I still remember my domestic help's father," businessman Prakash Patra from Jaipur city told DW. "He panicked, collapsed, and passed away right there, standing in a long queue just trying to exchange his family's life savings. It wasn't just cash that was lost in those lines. It was human lives."
paras.zh: 来自斋浦尔市的商人普拉卡什·帕特拉（Prakash Patra）告诉德国之声：“我仍然记得我家佣的父亲。” “他惊慌失措，崩溃了，当场去世，排着长队，只是想兑换家人毕生的积蓄。在这些队伍中损失的不仅仅是现金。还有人的生命。”

paras.en: For India's most vulnerable, particularly rural women and people without bank accounts, the sudden cash shortage made savings difficult to access. Money set aside for family weddings, medical emergencies and basic survival was suddenly compromised.
paras.zh: 对于印度最弱势群体，特别是农村妇女和没有银行账户的人来说，突然的现金短缺使得储蓄变得困难。用于家庭婚礼、医疗紧急情况和基本生存的资金突然受到损害。

paras.en: Joe Athialy, executive director of the New Delhi-based Center for Financial Accountability, a financial watchdog, says the impact fell disproportionately on the poor and the informal economy.
paras.zh: 总部位于新德里的金融监管机构金融问责中心执行主任乔·阿蒂亚利表示，穷人和非正规经济受到的影响尤为严重。

paras.en: "Demonetization destroyed livelihoods, disrupted small businesses and pushed millions into deeper economic insecurity. The poor and those dependent on the informal sector bore the greatest cost," Athialy told DW.
paras.zh: 阿蒂亚利告诉德国之声：“废钞令破坏了生计，扰乱了小企业，并使数百万人陷入更深的经济不安全之中。穷人和依赖非正规部门的人承受着最大的损失。”

paras.en: Arun Kumar, former professor of economics at Jawaharlal Nehru University and author of "The Black Economy in India," shared a similar assessment. The government wrongly assumed that illicit wealth was primarily held in cash, he said.
paras.zh: 贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学前经济学教授、《印度的黑色经济》一书的作者阿伦·库马尔也有类似的评估。他说，政府错误地认为非法财富主要以现金形式持有。

paras.en: "And it penalized the cash-dependent informal sector while leaving the real engines of the black economy untouched," Kumar told DW.
paras.zh: 库马尔对德国之声表示：“它惩罚了依赖现金的非正规部门，但并未触及黑色经济的真正引擎。”

paras.en: The first major setback came in 2018, when the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) reported that 99.3% of the demonetized currency had returned to the banking system.
paras.zh: 第一次重大挫折发生在 2018 年，当时印度储备银行 (RBI) 报告称，99.3% 的非纸币已返回银行系统。

paras.en: Only a small fraction of the withdrawn money had failed to come back, undermining the expectation that large amounts of undeclared cash would be extinguished.
paras.zh: 只有一小部分提取的资金未能返还，这削弱了大量未申报现金将被消灭的预期。

paras.en: A decade later, there is little evidence that demonetization made a significant dent in black money or corruption. Economists have long pointed out that much illicit wealth in India is held in property, gold and other assets rather than cash.
paras.zh: 十年后，几乎没有证据表明废钞令对黑钱或腐败产生了重大影响。经济学家长期以来一直指出，印度的许多非法财富是房地产、黄金和其他资产，而不是现金。

paras.en: Some supporters of the policy argued that forcing cash into the banking system would help formalize the economy and widen the tax base. But the extent to which these changes could be attributed to the currency withdrawal remains contested.
paras.zh: 该政策的一些支持者认为，迫使现金进入银行系统将有助于经济正规化并扩大税基。但这些变化在多大程度上可以归因于货币撤回仍然存在争议。

paras.en: Lekha Chakraborty, a professor at the National Institute of Public Finance and Policy, said research after the exercise pointed to limited success in achieving its stated objectives.
paras.zh: 国家公共财政与政策研究所教授莱卡·查克拉博蒂 (Lekha Chakraborty) 表示，演习后的研究表明，在实现既定目标方面取得的成功有限。

paras.en: She draws on studies that examined both the immediate economic shock and its longer-term effects.
paras.zh: 她借鉴了对直接经济冲击及其长期影响进行检验的研究。

paras.en: "The research points to modest gains against demonetization's primary objectives, alongside temporary but real economic costs. The impact was particularly severe in the informal sector, where cash remains central to everyday transactions," Chakraborty told DW.
paras.zh: 查克拉博蒂告诉德国之声：“研究表明，废钞令的主要目标取得了适度的成果，同时也付出了暂时但实际的经济成本。这种影响在非正规部门尤其严重，因为现金仍然是日常交易的核心。”

paras.en: "The economic shock was real, even if much of it faded over time. But there is little to suggest that demonetization produced a lasting change in the way black wealth is generated or concealed."
paras.zh: “经济冲击是真实存在的，尽管其中大部分会随着时间的推移而消退。但几乎没有迹象表明废钞令对黑人财富的产生或隐藏方式产生了持久的改变。”

paras.en: Athialy argues that the policy was based on a flawed understanding of how illicit wealth is held in India.
paras.zh: 阿蒂亚利认为，该政策是基于对印度如何持有非法财富的错误理解。

paras.en: "Cash is only an insignificant part of the black economy. Much of India's unaccounted wealth is held in assets such as real estate and in tax havens, not currency," he said.
paras.zh: “现金只是黑色经济中微不足道的一部分。印度大部分下落不明的财富都存放在房地产和避税天堂等资产中，而不是货币，”他说。

paras.en: He also questions the absence of accountability for the disruption and its institutional consequences.
paras.zh: 他还质疑对破坏及其制度后果缺乏问责。

paras.en: "Nobody has been held accountable for the economic disruption or the undermining of institutions such as the RBI."
paras.zh: “没有人对经济混乱或印度储备银行等机构的破坏负责。”

paras.en: Digital payments have expanded rapidly since 2016. The Unified Payments Interface (UPI), launched in August that year, has become a major part of India's retail payment system today.
paras.zh: 自 2016 年以来，数字支付迅速扩张。当年 8 月推出的统一支付接口 (UPI) 已成为当今印度零售支付系统的主要组成部分。

paras.en: In 2025-26, UPI processed 241.6 billion transactions, worth 314.2 trillion rupees (approximately €2.95 trillion), according to the RBI.
paras.zh: 据印度储备银行称，2025-26 年，UPI 处理了 2416 亿笔交易，价值 314.2 万亿卢比（约合 2.95 万亿欧元）。

paras.en: Yet the growth of digital payments has not reduced the amount of physical currency in circulation.
paras.zh: 然而，数字支付的增长并没有减少流通中的实物货币数量。

paras.en: RBI data show that the value of banknotes in circulation stood at 43.15 trillion rupees (about €405 billion) on October 23, 2026, compared with 17.97 trillion rupees (€169 billion) in November 2016.
paras.zh: 印度央行数据显示，2026 年 10 月 23 日流通纸币价值为 43.15 万亿卢比（约合 4050 亿欧元），而 2016 年 11 月为 17.97 万亿卢比（约合 1690 亿欧元）。

paras.en: The figures show that Indians are increasingly using digital platforms for everyday payments, but cash remains firmly in circulation.
paras.zh: 数据显示，印度人越来越多地使用数字平台进行日常支付，但现金仍然稳定流通。

paras.en: Chakraborty cautions against attributing the growth of digital payments to demonetization. "Digital payments largely continued a trend that was already under way before the currency ban," she said.
paras.zh: 查克拉博蒂警告不要将数字支付的增长归因于非货币化。 “数字支付在很大程度上延续了货币禁令之前已经存在的趋势，”她说。

paras.en: A decade after the unprecedented move, the gap between the government's promises and what demonetization ultimately delivered remains central to its legacy.
paras.zh: 在这一史无前例的举措发生十年后，政府的承诺与废钞令最终带来的结果之间的差距仍然是其遗产的核心。

articles.title: Russia: Independent Novaya Gazeta shuts its Moscow newsroom

paras.en: The Novaya Gazeta newspaper closed its Moscow office on Monday, saying it was not able to continue reporting amid a campaign of state pressure in Russia.
paras.zh: 《新报》周一关闭了莫斯科办事处，称由于俄罗斯政府施压，该报无法继续报道。

paras.en: The investigative outlet, co-founded by late USSR chief Mikhail Gorbachev, had long been a thorn in the Kremlin's side. In recent years, it ran into increasing roadblocks amid its critical coverage of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这家由已故苏联领导人米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫（Mikhail Gorbachev）共同创立的调查机构长期以来一直是克里姆林宫的眼中钉。近年来，它在对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的批评报道中遇到了越来越多的障碍。

paras.en: It was branded a "foreign agent," a Soviet-era term resuscitated by President Vladimir Putin's administration, with officials ordering it to vacate its Moscow offices.
