paras.zh: 在天空体育 (Sky Sports) 上观看 2026 年 NFL 赛季直播，包括 2027 年 2 月 14 日星期日季后赛和第 61 届超级碗 (Super Bowl LXI) 的每一分钟。 获取天空体育 (Sky Sports) 或通过 NOW 进行无合约直播。

articles.title: Baumgardner outclasses Turhan to win lightweight world title

paras.en: Alycia Baumgardner outclasses Elif Nur Turhan to become two-weight world champion, winning IBF lightweight title
paras.zh: 阿莉西亚·鲍姆加德纳 (Alycia Baumgardner) 击败埃利夫·努尔·图尔汗 (Elif Nur Turhan) 成为两量级世界冠军，赢得 IBF 轻量级冠军

paras.en: Alycia Baumgardner dominated Elif Tur Nurhan to win the IBF world lightweight title; her war of words with British rival Caroline Dubois continued after the fight; Baumgardner is now a two-weight world champion after beating a hard puncher who had never lost before
paras.zh: 阿莉西亚·鲍姆加德纳 (Alycia Baumgardner) 力压埃利夫·图尔·努尔汉 (Elif Tur Nurhan) 夺得 IBF 轻量级世界冠军；比赛结束后，她与英国竞争对手卡罗琳·杜波依斯的口水战仍在继续。鲍姆加德纳击败了一位以前从未输过的重拳手，现在成为了两重量级世界冠军

paras.en: Alycia Baumgardner, an undisputed world champion at super-featherweight, moved up to lightweight to capture the IBF world title when she shut out Elif Tur Nurhan in Texas.
paras.zh: 阿莉西亚·鲍姆加德纳 (Alycia Baumgardner) 是无可争议的超羽量级世界冠军，在德克萨斯州击败艾利夫·图尔·努尔汉 (Elif Tur Nurhan) 后，她晋升到轻量级，夺得了 IBF 世界冠军。

paras.en: Baumgardner won a unanimous decision after 10 rounds as she overcame Nurhan at College Park Center in Arlington.
paras.zh: 鲍姆加德纳在阿灵顿大学公园中心击败努尔汉，经过 10 轮比赛一致判定获胜。

paras.en: The American won 100-90 on all three cards, beating a hard puncher who had never lost before.
paras.zh: 美国人三张牌都以100-90获胜，击败了一位从未输过的重拳手。

paras.en: Baumgardner hurt Turhan at times, shaking her up in the third and seventh rounds.
paras.zh: 鲍姆加德纳有时会伤害图尔汗，在第三轮和第七轮中让她摇晃。

paras.en: She poured in punches, with Nurhan feeling the weight of those attacks in the ninth round. Nurhan went the distance but, despite her punch power, could not threaten Baumgardner.
paras.zh: 她猛烈地出拳，努尔汗在第九回合中感受到了这些攻击的重量。努尔汉打出了很远的距离，但尽管她的拳力强劲，但无法威胁到鲍姆加德纳。

paras.en: Now the IBF champion, Baumgardner looks to be on a collision course with Caroline Dubois, who fights Stephanie Han for the WBA, WBC and WBO 135lb titles on February 20, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 现在已是 IBF 冠军的鲍姆加德纳看起来将与卡罗琳·杜波依斯展开对决，卡罗琳·杜波依斯将于 2 月 20 日在天空体育直播中与斯蒂芬妮·汉争夺 WBA、WBC 和 WBO 135 磅冠军头衔。

paras.en: Baumgardner and Dubois have clashed before and the Briton was ringside in Texas. Their war of words continued after the American's latest win. "Are we going to fight?" Dubois demanded.
paras.zh: 鲍姆加德纳和杜波依斯之前曾发生过冲突，英国人当时就在德克萨斯州的场边。在美国人最近获胜后，他们的口水战仍在继续。 “我们要打架吗？”杜波依斯问道。

paras.en: "You've got a champ right there in front of you," Baumgardner warned.
paras.zh: “冠军就在你面前，”鲍姆加德纳警告说。

paras.en: Ramla Ali took a contentious split-decision victory over Mikiah Kreps to win the WBO and IBF super-bantamweight titles.
paras.zh: 拉姆拉·阿里（Ramla Ali）以争议性的分歧判定战胜了米基亚·克雷普斯（Mikiah Kreps），赢得了 WBO 和 IBF 超轻量级冠军。

paras.en: Ali started sharply and knocked Kreps down with a right hook right on the chin in the third round. From then on, though, Kreps maintained real pressure on Ali and the two finished trading punches before the final bell.
paras.zh: 阿里起步迅速，在第三回合中用一记右勾拳打倒了克雷普斯的下巴。不过，从那时起，克雷普斯继续对阿里施加真正的压力，两人在终场钟声前完成了对打。

paras.en: Kreps won widely, 98-91, for one judge but Ali took it 96-93 and 97-92 on the other two cards.
paras.zh: 克雷普斯在一名裁判中以 98-91 获胜，但阿里在另外两张牌上以 96-93 和 97-92 获胜。

paras.en: It was an emotional victory for Ali, whose family had to flee Somalia when she was a child and settled in London. She dedicated the victory to the memory of her father who passed away earlier this year.
paras.zh: 对于阿里来说，这是一次情感上的胜利，当她还是个孩子的时候，她的家人不得不逃离索马里并定居在伦敦。她将这场胜利献给了今年早些时候去世的父亲。

paras.en: Skye Nicolson defended the WBC super-bantamweight title, beating Japan's Miyo Yoshida, winning a unanimous decision on a dominant display.
paras.zh: 斯凯·尼科尔森击败日本选手吉田美代，以压倒性的优势赢得了一致判定，卫冕了WBC超轻量级拳王头衔。

paras.en: Nicolson took the victory 100-90, 99-91 and 98-92.

Unbeaten prospect Albina Moldazhanova knocked out former European champion Kirstie Bavington, subjecting her to heavy punishment before landing a right hook in the fourth round to finish it inside the distance. Moldazhanova has a 100 per cent knockout ratio after six pro fights.
paras.zh: 不败的新星阿尔比娜·莫尔达扎诺娃（Albina Moldazzanova）淘汰了前欧洲冠军基尔斯蒂·巴文顿（Kirstie Bavington），她受到了严厉的惩罚，然后在第四轮中右勾拳将球打入远距离。摩尔达扎诺娃在六场职业比赛后拥有 100% 的击倒率。

paras.en: Watch Caroline Dubois vs Stephanie Han on February 20, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 观看 2 月 20 日天空体育直播的 Caroline Dubois 对阵 Stephanie Han 的比赛。

articles.title: Gauff survives Pegula test to win all-American thriller at WTA Finals

paras.en: WTA Finals: Coco Gauff defeats Jessica Pegula in thriller at Indian Wells as Linda Noskova beats Marta Kostyuk
paras.zh: WTA 决赛：可可·高芙 (Coco Gauff) 在印第安维尔斯 (Indian Wells) 惊悚片中击败杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula)，琳达·诺斯科娃 (Linda Noskova) 击败玛塔·科斯图克 (Marta Kostyuk)

paras.en: Coco Gauff overcomes Jessica Pegula with a dominant third-set display to open her WTA Finals campaign with victory as Linda Noskova beats Marta Kostyuk; you can watch the WTA Finals from Indian Wells this week on Sky Sports Tennis
paras.zh: 可可·高芙 (Coco Gauff) 在第三盘中凭借统治力的表现战胜了杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula)，琳达·诺斯科娃 (Linda Noskova) 击败了玛尔塔·科斯特尤克 (Marta Kostyuk)，以胜利开启了她的 WTA 总决赛征程；您可以在天空体育网球频道观看本周印第安维尔斯举行的 WTA 总决赛

paras.en: Coco Gauff shredded her shoes but stayed one step ahead of Jessica Pegula to defeat her compatriot 6-4 6-7 (5-7) 6-2 on the opening day of the WTA Finals at Indian Wells, while Czech Linda Noskova got the better of Marta Kostyuk 6-2 6-4.
paras.zh: 在印第安维尔斯举行的 WTA 总决赛首日，可可·高芙 (Coco Gauff) 撕碎了鞋子，但仍领先杰西卡·佩古拉 (Jessica Pegula) 一步，以 6-4 6-7 (5-7) 6-2 击败了同胞，而捷克琳达·诺斯科娃 (Linda Noskova) 以 6-2 6-4 击败了玛塔·科斯特尤克 (Marta Kostyuk)。

paras.en: Gauff had beaten Pegula three months ago in Cincinnati and had the right formula once again, as the 2024 winner showed superb versatility in a round-robin clash between the top two Americans in the season-ending championship.
paras.zh: 高夫三个月前在辛辛那提击败了佩古拉，并再次拥有了正确的公式，这位 2024 年冠军在季末锦标赛中美国排名前两名的循环赛中展现了出色的多才多艺。

paras.en: World No 4 Gauff took the opener and recovered from 5-1 down in the second to come within a point of winning in straight sets.
paras.zh: 世界排名第四的高夫率先拿下首盘，并在第二局从1-5落后的情况下追平比分，直落两盘获胜。

paras.en: - Download Sky Sports app for analysis, news and video 📺

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW📱
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播现在📱

paras.en: But it was Pegula's turn to dig in from 5-6, saving a match point and then playing a terrific tie-break to extend the contest at Indian Wells.
paras.zh: 但5-6轮到佩古拉发力，挽救一个赛点，然后打出精彩的抢七，将印第安维尔斯的比赛延长。

paras.en: Gauff took charge of the match in the third set, breaking to lead 3-0 before earning her sixth win against Pegula after two hours and 39 minutes.
paras.zh: 高夫在第三盘中掌控了比赛，以3-0领先，并在耗时2小时39分钟后第六次战胜佩古拉。

paras.en: Pegula would probably have been grateful to get the tennis under way after her viral and awkward 'hot mic' moment when disparaging comments she made about fellow player Mirra Andreeva to her coach during a training session were picked up on a livestream.
paras.zh: 佩古拉可能会很感激能够让网球比赛重新开始，因为她在训练课上向教练发表的对队友米拉·安德烈娃的贬低言论在直播中被拍到，当时她的“热麦克风”瞬间被疯传，尴尬的“热麦克风”时刻也开始了。

paras.en: That prompted a grovelling apology from the WTA, which admitted it had not told players the microphones were on, and damage control behind the scenes from Pegula.
paras.zh: 这促使 WTA 卑躬屈膝地道歉，并承认自己没有告诉球员麦克风已经打开，而佩古拉则在幕后进行了损害控制。

paras.en: The world No 5 had compared Andreeva's mentality unfavourably with Gauff's in her indiscreet comments, and the two-time Grand Slam champion set about showing her competitive grit, clawing her way back with five games in a row, including saving three set points.
paras.zh: 世界排名第五的安德烈耶娃在不检点的评论中将安德烈耶娃的心态与高夫进行了不利的比较，这位两届大满贯冠军开始展现出她的竞争勇气，连续五场比赛扳回一城，其中包括挽救三个盘点。

paras.en: Sometime doubles partners Gauff and Pegula had shared their 10 previous meetings, while this was the fourth year in a row they were meeting at the WTA Finals.
paras.zh: 有时双打搭档高夫和佩古拉曾有过10次交锋，而这是他们连续第四年在WTA年终总决赛上交锋。

paras.en: "Honestly, I was having a lot of fun today. I took a little break, it was my first match in a month," said Gauff, who was last in action at the China Open in early October.
paras.zh: “说实话，我今天玩得很开心。我休息了一会儿，这是我一个月来的第一场比赛，”高夫说，他最后一次参加中国公开赛是在十月初。

paras.en: "To play a tournament like this with no preparation is something I've never done in my career. I'm just really happy to get through today. It was a tough match."
paras.zh: “在没有任何准备的情况下参加这样的比赛是我职业生涯中从未做过的事情。我真的很高兴今天能够通过。这是一场艰难的比赛。”

paras.en: The 22-year-old said she had to be aggressive to deal with Pegula's game.
paras.zh: 这位 22 岁的球员表示，她必须积极进攻才能应对佩古拉的比赛。

paras.en: "I also had to run a lot," she added. "My shoes are pretty torn up now. Some of my shoes are like somewhere on the court there, so I'm going to have to change shoes tomorrow."
paras.zh: “我还必须经常跑步，”她补充道。 “我的鞋子现在已经破烂了。我的一些鞋子就像球场上的某个地方一样，所以我明天必须换鞋。”

paras.en: Earlier, Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova marked her debut by beating alternate Marta Kostyuk 6-2 6-4 in her opening round-robin game.
paras.zh: 此前，温网冠军琳达·诺斯科娃在首场循环赛中以 6-2 6-4 击败替补选手玛塔·科斯特尤克，完成了自己的首秀。

paras.en: Kostyuk is standing in for No 1 seed Elena Rybakina after the Kazakh withdrew a day before the tournament citing a medical issue, and got off to an understandably slow start, as Noskova broke her serve at the second time of asking before winning four of the next five games in a dominant first-set performance.
paras.zh: 科斯秋克将接替一号种子埃琳娜·雷巴基娜，哈萨克人在比赛前一天因健康问题退赛，开局缓慢是可以理解的，诺斯科娃在第二次发球时破发，随后在首盘占据统治地位的表现中赢得了接下来五场比赛中的四场。

paras.en: Kostyuk made a stronger start in the second set, wining her first two games on serve, but a Noskova break put the No 8 seed ahead 4-2, and her Ukranian opponent's missed opportunity to break back at 4-3 down proved costly, with the Czech winning her next two service games and securing the straight-sets victory.
paras.zh: 科斯特尤克在第二盘中取得了强势，赢得了前两场发球局，但诺斯科娃的破发让八号种子以4-2领先，而她的乌克兰对手在4-3落后的情况下错失了破发机会，代价高昂，捷克人赢得了接下来的两个发球局并确保了直落两盘的胜利。

paras.en: "My main focus was myself," Noskova told Sky Sports. "Marta is a very difficult opponent, because she never gives up, but I felt like I had the match under control the whole time.
paras.zh: “我主要关注的是我自己，”诺斯科娃告诉天空体育。 “玛塔是一个非常难对付的对手，因为她从不放弃，但我感觉比赛一直在我的掌控之中。

paras.en: "I've played against Marta a few times now, so I know that I have to be as aggressive as possible against Marta. She is very fast, plays a lot of great volleys and tricky points. Against her, it's very tough to get that last point over the net."
paras.zh: “我已经和玛塔交手过几次了，所以我知道我必须尽可能地对玛塔表现出侵略性。她速度非常快，打出了很多精彩的截击和棘手的得分。对阵她，要在网前获得最后一分是非常困难的。”

articles.title: U.S. Marine dies in Japan during training, military says
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: A U.S. Marine has died in Japan following a “training incident,” the military said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 军方周三在一份声明中表示，一名美国海军陆战队员在日本发生“训练事件”后死亡。

paras.en: The unnamed Marine was undertaking training at Camp Schwab in Okinawa, Japan’s southernmost prefecture, the statement said. The area is home to a large U.S. military presence and bases that serve as a regional hub in the Indo-Pacific.
paras.zh: 声明称，这名未透露姓名的海军陆战队员正在日本最南端冲绳县的施瓦布军营接受训练。该地区拥有大量美国军事存在和基地，是印度-太平洋地区的区域中心。

paras.en: The Marine, who was with the 3rd Marine Division, died Tuesday and will not be named until 24 hours after the individual’s family has been notified, the 3rd Marine Division said in a statement Wednesday.
paras.zh: 海军陆战队第三师周三在一份声明中表示，这名海军陆战队士兵于周二去世，在通知其家人 24 小时后，他的姓名才会被公布。

paras.en: “It is with heavy hearts that 3rd Marine Division announces the death of a Marine following a training incident at Camp Schwab, Okinawa, Japan, on Nov. 3, 2026,” the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“海军陆战队第三师怀着沉重的心情宣布一名海军陆战队员在 2026 年 11 月 3 日日本冲绳施瓦布军营发生训练事件后死亡。”

paras.en: “The circumstances surrounding the incident remain under investigation,” it added. “We express our deepest condolences to the family and loved ones of our Marine.”
paras.zh: “事件相关情况仍在调查中，”它补充道。 “我们向我们海军陆战队的家人和亲人表示最深切的哀悼。”

paras.en: Okinawa was under U.S. occupation following World War II until it was handed back to Japan in 1972. Today, the U.S. population on the island is nearly 80,000, with nearly 30,000 being active-duty troops from all four branches of the armed forces, though the Marines make up the bulk of the forces.
paras.zh: 冲绳岛在第二次世界大战后一直处于美国占领之下，直到 1972 年被交还给日本。如今，岛上的美国人口接近 80,000 人，其中近 30,000 人是来自武装部队所有四个军种的现役军人，不过海军陆战队占了部队的主体。

paras.en: Separately, Secretary of State Marco Rubio last month pledged to cooperate with Japanese authorities investigating allegations that a U.S. Marine murdered a woman in Okinawa. The case sparked widespread protests and led to a U.S. military curfew and mandatory training in standards and discipline.
paras.zh: 另外，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥上个月承诺与日本当局合作，调查一名美国海军陆战队员在冲绳谋杀一名妇女的指控。此案引发了广泛的抗议，并导致美国实行军事宵禁以及强制标准和纪律培训。

paras.en: Lt. Gen. Benjamin Watson, commander of the III Marine Expeditionary Force, said at the time that serving on the Japanese island “comes with responsibility.”
paras.zh: 美国海军陆战队第三远征军司令本杰明·沃森中将当时表示，在日本岛上服役“伴随着责任”。
